source.japanese: 外側から弾けて砕けて飛散して、室内に撒き散らす硝子の雨霞、星雲のようにさんざめいても一つ一つが微細な棘、刃、まともに受けては傷の一つや二つでは済まない筈なのに、青年は女客が粉一つ被らず、そればかりか驚いた気振も匂わせず、ただ鬱陶しげに僅かに眉をひそめたのを目の当たりにした。
source.english: It shattered inward, showering the cabin with glass. The fragments shimmered like a nebula, but every one was a tiny thorn, a blade. Anyone caught in that shower ought to have suffered far more than a scratch or two. Yet he saw that not so much as a speck had touched the woman. She showed no surprise. target.text: From the outside it burst open, was smashed to bits, flew apart, a hazy rain of glass scattering inside the room, shimmering like a nebula, each and every shard a delicate thorn, a blade, and even though it should have resulted in much worse than a scratch or two were it taken head on, the female passenger was not covered in a speck of dust; in fact, she showed not the slightest indication of being surprised, and all he saw was her brows slightly furrowed in vexation.

source.japanese: これはきっと窓枠の位置関係とか、窓硝子に叩きつけられた衝撃角度の問題とか、物理的な要因が重なったせいだろうと言い聞かせても、彼自身信じきれぬ。女客の濃密な退廃はその程度の騒ぎでは乱されない、そうと受け取った方がまだ納得がいく。
source.english: He tried telling himself that it must be the position of the window frame, or the angle at which the force had struck the pane, or some convergence of physical causes. He could not quite make himself believe it. It was easier to accept that no disturbance so paltry could ruffle the woman passenger’s concentrated decadence.

source.japanese: そしてすぐに女客の事など気に病むどころではなくなる青年の、窓から入りこんだのは清爽と海風、こちらは部屋の媚毒潜[ひそ]ませた空気を払う効果はあったが、当然それだけで終わらず、一人二人と、次々に侵入してくる凶漢達の、こちらの方が自らたたき割った硝子窓の破片に引っかかって切り傷などをこさえている。
source.english: Almost at once, however, the young man had more to concern him than the woman passenger. A clean sea breeze came in through the window; this at least swept away some of the seductive poison secreted in the room’s air. Naturally, the breeze was not all that entered. One ruffian clambered through, then a second, then others in succession—and they, unlike the woman, managed to cut themselves on the shards of the very window they had smashed.

source.japanese:
だがその程度の切り傷から流した血潮程度で鎮まる殺意であるものか、凶漢は室内の女客を見て野卑に唇吊り上げ、青年を睨[ね]めつけて青筋立てた、この時点で既に女と青年に対しての扱いの差が発生しており、青年が逃げるはおろか口をきく隙さえ与えず、銃口突きつけたとみるや、ためらいなく───また爆ぜた。

source.english:
A few cuts’ worth of blood was hardly going to cool such murderous intent. At the sight of the woman, the ruffians’ lips curled in lewd grins; at the young man they glared, veins standing out. Already there was a marked difference in the treatment intended for the two.
They allowed him no chance to flee, nor even time to get a word out. The muzzle was thrust at him and, without the least hesitation—another burst.
This time it was the wall immediately behind the young man that exploded.

target.text: This surely must have been related to the position of the window frame, or a question of the angle of the impact the glass was struck by, but even as he tried to persuade himself that it must have been some combination of physical factors, he couldn't quite bring himself to believe it. The rich decadence enveloping this female passenger would simply not be disturbed in the slightest by a commotion of this caliber: that was an interpretation of events he found more convincing.

And then, the young man had to stop fretting over the female passenger at once, for from the window came a refreshing ocean wind, and while it had the effect of dispelling the room's air laden with poisonous aphrodisiac, it obviously didn't end there, as one, then two, one after the other, ruffians invaded the cabin, their skin pulling on the fragments of glass from the window they themselves had crushed into pieces, resulting in cuts and other such injuries.

But the amount of blood flowing from such trifling cuts could never hope to quell their bloodthirst, and as the outlaws caught sight of the room's female passenger, their lips curled in a vulgar manner, glaring at the young man with veins bulging from beneath their skin, and in this moment, a clear difference in their treatment of the young man and the woman had already manifested; without even giving the young man the chance to make his escape or mediate, a gun was pointed in his face, no hesitation─── another explosion rang out. This time, it came from the wall right behind the young man.

source.japanese:
【青年】
「うわ、わわわわっっ」
source.english: “Wah! W-w-whoa!”

source.japanese: また壁に穴が開いてから情けない悲鳴を漏らしてしゃがみこむあたり、この青年どうにも危機感が足らない。凶漢どもが侵入してきた時点で廻れ右するべきなのに、また期を逸している。
source.english: Once again he gave his pathetic scream and crouched only after the hole had appeared in the wall. This young man had a woefully inadequate sense of danger. He ought to have turned and run the moment the thugs entered. Once again, he had missed his chance.

target.text: 【Young man】 「Wah, WAAAAAH!」

As another hole opened in the wall, he let out a pitiful scream and crouched down with his face between his knees; truly, this young man was lacking any sense of danger. Even though he should have turned tail the moment these outlaws had intruded, he missed his chance once more.

source.japanese:
【凶漢】
「ようし動くな、手を上げろ。
　手を上げてそのままくたばりやがれ、な？」
source.english:
“Right. Don't move. Hands up.
Put your hands up and fucking die, eh?”

source.japanese: 擬されていたのは青竜刀、青年の鼻面が映るくらいにぴかぴかではあっても、切っ先がいつめりこむか知れたものでないときては、鏡のように光っていようがいまいが青年には大差ない。一方の手にはたった今ぶっ放された拳銃が、女客の船室にはなんとも不粋に鼻を灼く硝煙の筋細く引いていたが、この凶漢は刃物で叩き切る事が好みらしく、ベルトにねじこまれた。
source.english: A Chinese saber pointed at him, polished enough to reflect his nose. Since its tip might plunge into him at any moment, he cared little whether it shone like a mirror. The pistol in the man's other hand still smoked, drawing a thin, acrid line through the cabin's sensuous air. But this thug apparently preferred chopping people up. He shoved the pistol into his belt.

source.japanese:
反射的に両手を挙げて降伏の意を示したというのに、相手の言葉は情けとか容赦が一切無い。
　動いても動かなくとも同じでも、せめて切っ先から離れたいとの切なる望みに後退ってみたものの、それにも意味がなかった。後頭部にごりりと、なんだか熱いような冷たいような硬質の感触が降りた。
source.english:
The young man raised both hands in reflexive surrender. There was not a shred of mercy in the man's words.
Moving or standing still would make no difference. Even so, he desperately wanted to get away from that point, and tried backing up. That did no good, either. Something hard pressed against the back of his head, feeling oddly hot and cold at once.

target.text: 【Outlaw】 「Alright, don't move, get those hands in the air. Keep your hands up and just drop dead where you stand, got it?」

Pressed against his face was a green dragon crescent blade, so shiny he could see the reflection of his own nose, but as he had no way of knowing when, or if, the tip would be lodged inside him, the blade shining like a mirror hardly made a difference to the young man. In his other hand was a pistol that had been fired just moments ago, drawing a thin line of gunpowder smoke that stung the nose and made a rather boorish mismatch with the female passenger's stateroom, but it seemed this rogue much preferred to hack and slice with his blade, for he jammed the gun back into his waistband.

Even though he had instinctively thrust both hands in the air to show his intent to surrender, the words he was met with were utterly lacking in pity or mercy. The result was the same whether he moved or not, and earnestly wishing to at least gain some distance from the point of the sword, he attempted to back away, but that, too, was futile. Something scraped against the back of his head, and the sensation of coming into contact with something hard that was somehow both warm and cold struck him.

source.japanese: 目を離した途端にざくりと殺られるのではないかと気が気でないけれど、背後からも強烈な殺気が押し寄せており、出来る限り前の凶漢を刺激しないように振り返ると、盆の窪あたりにまたごりり、大口径の散弾銃の銃口と知った時には、もとより萎縮していた青年の睾丸が更に股間の中にめりこんで、引き攣[つ]って痛いくらい。
source.english:
He feared that the instant he looked away, the man in front would slash him. But a fierce murderous presence bore down on him from behind as well. He turned as carefully as he could, trying not to provoke the thug before him. The hard object ground against the hollow at the back of his skull again.
When he realized it was the muzzle of a large-bore shotgun, his already shrunken testicles retreated farther into his groin, drawing up so tight they hurt.

source.japanese:
【背後の凶漢】
「動くなって言ってるだろうがっ。
　動くと手元が狂って引き金落ちるぞ、
　ああん？」
source.english:
“I said don't move! You move,
my hand might slip and pull the trigger.
You hear me?”

source.japanese:
【背後の凶漢】
「そうやって大人しく立ってりゃ、一発で頭吹っ飛ばしてあっさり死なせてやっからな？」
source.english: “Stand nice and quiet, and I'll blow your head off in one shot. Make it quick for you.”

source.japanese:
【青年】
「こっちも動こうがなんだろうが選択肢なしかよう」
source.english: “So I'm screwed whether I move or stand still on this end, too?”

source.japanese:
【青年】
「なんだってあんた達ゃそう殺る気満々なんだ。俺はこの船に乗りこんだばっかで日が浅い」
source.english: “Why are you so determined to kill me? I've only just joined this ship. I haven't been here long.”

source.japanese:
【青年】
「あんた達の恨みを買うような真似はしたことないだろうに……」
source.english: “I haven't done anything to make you hate me…”

source.japanese:
【前の凶漢】
「新米だろうがなんだろうが殺す。
　この船に乗ってる奴なら全員同罪だ」
source.english:
“New boy or not, you're dead.
Everyone on this ship's guilty.”

source.japanese:
【背後の凶漢】
「この腐れ船に乗りこんでいるなら、たとえ実の親だろうとぶっ殺す」
source.english: “I'd kill my own fucking parents if they were aboard this rotten ship.”

target.text: While he was concerned that he would be murdered the moment he took his eyes off the blade, a fiercely murderous presence closed in on him from behind as well, and as he turned around while trying his utmost to provoke the villain in front of him as little as possible, something scraped against the nape of his neck once more; the moment he realized it was the large-bore muzzle of a shotgun, the already contracting testicles of this young man crawled even higher into his crotch, tautening to the point of causing pain.
【The Rear Outlaw】 「Think we already told you not to move. If you do, my fingers might slip and pull the trigger, hmm?」
【The Rear Outlaw】 「If you can be a good boy and stand still for me, I'll blow your head off in a single shot and give you a quick death, okay?」
【Young man】 「Doesn't really sound like you're giving me a choice whether I move or not here.」
【Young man】 「Why do you even wanna kill me that badly? It hasn't even been that long since I boarded this ship.」
【Young man】 「I'm pretty sure I haven't done anything to incur any grudges from you, so……」
【The Front Outlaw】 「Newcomer or not, doesn't matter, we're still killing you. All the scum on this ship are equally guilty.」
【The Front Outlaw】 「If they were sailing with this rotten ship, I'd even beat my own ma and pa to death.」

source.japanese:
【青年】
「そんな、俺だって無理矢理乗せられたっていうのに……」
source.english: “But I was forced aboard…”

source.japanese:
【前の凶漢】
「うるせえ、クソ野郎！
　こんなクソ船にとっ捕まったてめえが悪いんだよ」
source.english:
“Shut up, you piece of shit!
Your own fucking fault for getting caught by a shithole like this.”

target.text: 【Young man】 「Come on, I was forced aboard this ship, can't you be a little……」
【The Front Outlaw】 「Shut up, you piece of shit! You only have yourself to blame for getting pressganged onto this hellhole of a ship.」

source.japanese: こんな、生まれた時から鉄火場の酒で産湯を遣い、育ちも箸より先にドス・ヤッパを握って叩き殺してきた犠牲者数知れずの、いかにもな殺人鬼どもをしてここまで恨み骨髄に叩きこむほどの、どんな真似をしでかしてくれたというのかこの呪われた船の面々は。事情も知らずに死ぬのは厭だぁと、青年は既に涙と鼻水で顔をどろどろにしつつも知りたがりの心が動くも、それを口にさせたらこの凶漢ども、余計に怒り狂うのではないか。
source.english:
These men looked as though they had been bathed at birth in gambling-den liquor, had learned to handle knives before chopsticks, and had butchered more victims than anyone could count. What had the crew of this accursed ship done to plant such hatred in the very marrow of such killers?
I don't want to die without even knowing why, he thought, his face already a mess of tears and snot. Curiosity stirred in him. But if he asked, wouldn't these thugs only grow angrier?

source.japanese: ろくなものでない青年の好奇心を封じこめて黙らせるくらいに、眼前の鏡と光る青竜刀と後頭部の大口径二連の存在感は、圧倒的な暴威そのもの。
source.english: The mirror-bright saber before his face and the large-bore double-barreled shotgun against the back of his head were overwhelmingly persuasive. They silenced even his worthless curiosity.

source.japanese:
【前の凶漢】
「こっちゃお前だけにかかずらあっていられねえ。
　そんでそっちの姉ちゃんよう、
　こいつ片づけたら、俺らにつきあえや」
source.english:
“We haven't got all day to waste on you.
And you, sweetheart—once we've dealt with him,
you can come have some fun with us.”

source.japanese:
【背後の凶漢】
「ああ、こんなイカレ船でくすぶってるより、俺らと来た方が色々良い想いできっぜぇ？
　シモの方だって、こんな弱っちい奴より、俺らのがイイに決まってッからさぁ」
source.english:
“Yeah, better than wasting away on this crazy ship. We'll show you a good time.
And down below, we're bound to be better than a weak little fuck like him.”

source.japanese:
【前の凶漢】
「ひいひい言うくらい喜ばせてヤッからよ。
　な、な、姉ちゃんよう。
　だからてめえ、ちゃっちゃっとくたばれや」
source.english:
“We'll have you squealing with pleasure,
sweetheart. Won't we? Won't we?
So hurry up and fucking die, you.”

source.japanese:
この二人は鈎付きロープを投げてくる連中とは別に、短艇で接近してきた別働隊と見えたが、虐殺の歓びよりも女の肉を貪る快美を選んで、女客を口説きにかかる。恐らく彼女を見るなり催したのだろう、ズボンの股間は木の根でも飲んだように膨れあがって、女客が応じようが応じまいが、問答無用で犯しつくす獣欲を雄弁に見せつけていた。
　まともな女性なら、耳を塞ぎたくなるほどの下卑て浅ましい口舌を、しかしさらりと流してのけるのが、この女客なのである。
source.english:
Unlike the men throwing grappling lines, these two seemed to belong to a separate party that had approached in a boat. They turned their attentions to the woman, choosing the pleasure of devouring her flesh over the joy of slaughter. Apparently the mere sight of her had aroused them. Their crotches bulged as though they had swallowed tree roots, eloquent testimony to a beastly lust that would rape her senseless whether she agreed or not.
Any ordinary woman would have wanted to cover her ears against their vile, degrading words. This passenger, however, brushed them aside with perfect ease.

source.japanese:
【女客】
「わたくし、わきがの方は嫌いなの」
source.english: “I don't care for men with body odor.”

source.japanese:
冷めていても、紅茶の香のほうが余程安らぐと、カップの中の金輪に目を伏して一目だにくれず、男どもに言い切ったのが、彼らのただ卑猥なばかりの文句より切れ味鋭い言葉の暴力で、凶漢達は愕然と色を失った。
　前と後から押し寄せる異臭は青年とて既に嗅ぎ分けて閉口ものだったのだが、この命の危機にそれだけは口にしないようにしていたのにと、恐れていた台詞をそんな軽く放ってしまっては───青年は眼前の凶漢の全身から、激昂のあまりの湯気が立つを見た。背後からも同様の怒気が押し寄せた。
source.english:
Even cold, the fragrance of the tea was infinitely more soothing. She kept her eyes lowered to the golden surface in her cup and delivered her verdict without granting the men so much as a glance. The verbal violence of that single remark had a keener edge than all their merely obscene propositions. The ruffians stared aghast, the color draining from their faces.
The young man had already distinguished the separate stenches pressing in upon him from front and rear, and found both intolerable. With his life at stake, however, he had taken particular care not to mention them. And now she had tossed out, as lightly as that, the very words he had dreaded hearing—
He saw steam all but rising from the body of the thug before him in the extremity of his rage. The same furious heat bore down upon him from behind.

source.japanese:
【女客】
「ねえ。済ませるのなら、早くして下さらない。わたくし、さっきからずぅっと待っているのだけれど」
source.english: “Do hurry up if you're going to finish. I've been waiting all this time.”

target.text: Scoundrels baptized in the booze of gambling dens, raised with hands gripping a stiletto instead of chopsticks, beating who knows how many unfortunate souls to death: to so thoroughly incur the wrath of cold-blooded murderers like these, a grudge seated so deeply it has settled in the marrow of their bones, what in the world had all the people on this accursed ship even done to them? Unwilling to die without at least understanding the situation, with a face already slimy from the rivers of tears and snot running down it, he could still find it in himself to be nosy, and had he expressed as much verbally to the outlaws, would it not only have sent these thugs into a wilder rage?

The presence emanating from the green dragon crescent blade glinting with a mirror-like sheen in front of his eyes and the large-bore double barrel pointed at the back of his head promised such overwhelming violence that it was enough to keep this young man's worthless curiosity contained, leaving him silent.
【The Front Outlaw】 「But just dealing with you isn't gonna be enough. So lady over there, yeah, you, once we've dealt with this guy, you'll be keeping us company.」

【The Rear Outlaw】 「Yeah, you'll have a great time with us, much better than wasting away on this rusted madhouse, y'know? Cause even below the belt, we've obviously got way better equipment than what this pathetic shrimp's packing.」
【The Front Outlaw】 「We'll leave you so pleased you'll be heaving for breath. Hey, hey, come on, lady. That's the why of it, buddy, so hurry up and die.」

These two seemed to be from a detached force moving separately from the group throwing the hooked ropes, instead going alongside in a dinghy, and having chosen to indulge in the sweet sensations of a woman's flesh over the rapture of slaughter, they attempted to chat up the female passenger. They had likely been in the mood for this since the instant they first laid eyes on her, for the crotches of their pants bulged like they housed gnarled tree roots, and it eloquently spoke of their bestial desire to utterly violate her whether she would respond in kind or not.
Were she a regular woman, this vulgar, despicable manner of speaking would make her want to block her ears, but to instead instantly brush it off, that was undoubtedly this female passenger's way.
【Female passenger】 「I am not fond of people with body odour.」

Even cooled as it was, the fragrance of the black tea was greatly soothing, and lowering her eyes to the metal band in the cup without sparing them a glance, she declared that to the men; faced with the force of her words, clad with a far sharper edge than their own simply laden in obscenity, the scoundrels deflated in astonishment.

The young man had already scented out the foul smell bearing down on him from the front and the back, revolting enough to make him stifle a gag and his commentary both, but even though that was the one thing you really shouldn't say in this life-threatening situation, she casually threw out that dreaded line───the young man could see the steam produced by his seething rising from the entire body of the outlaw in front of him. A similar wrath closed in on him from the back.
【Female passenger】 「Come now. If you're going to finish this, could you make it quick? I have been waiting for this to be done with for a while now.」

source.japanese:
こちらはこちらでまた勝手な台詞しか吐かない始末さ、きっとこの怒りの矛先、間違いなく自分に向かうはず、青年の喉の奥から抑えきれない絶叫がこみあげて、絞め殺される豚のように歪んだ顔の前にだった。
　目前の凶漢の脳天を唐竹割りにして、血糊絡みつかせた刀身が出現したのは。
source.english:
Even now she thought of nothing but herself. And surely, surely all that anger would fall on him. An uncontrollable scream rose in his throat. His face twisted like a pig being strangled.
Then, before his eyes, a blood-clotted blade appeared, cleaving the thug's skull straight down the middle.

target.text: This woman had made nothing but self-centred statements, and as a consequence, the brunt of the anger would undoubtedly be directed at none other than himself; an irrepressible scream forced its way up from the depths of the young man's throat, and just as he was about to make an expression like a pig being strangulated. Cleaving the brains of the front outlaw in two, a blade appeared, covered in sticky clots of blood.

source.japanese: 先程まで男は殺し女は犯す、暴力衝動を意のままに吹き荒らしていた肉体は、一撃の下に絶命して、断末魔すらなく噴き上げたは凄まじい血煙、頽れる凶漢の背後から、蒼い双眸が呆れたように青年を覗きこむ。
source.english:
A moment before, this body had given free rein to its urge to kill men and rape women. Now it died under a single stroke. There was not even a death cry, only a ghastly eruption of blood.
As the thug crumpled, a pair of blue eyes peered past him at the young man with weary disbelief.

source.japanese:
【和服の男】
「あのなあお前。誰かに殺されるくらいなら、
　俺に殺られろっていってんだろうが……」
source.english:
“Look. I told you,
if you're going to let someone kill you, let it be me…”

source.japanese: 何か言おうとするより先に、顔面にまともに浴びた返り血の熱さに青年の舌は縺れ、肌にかかってたちまち冷えてぬるついていく温度に、ますます度を失った。だがとりあえず前からの危機からは逃れたものの、背後の散弾銃はいまだ厳然とした脅威であり、凶漢の引き金一つで青年ごと殺し屋を蜂の巣にするであろう、の、一瞬の間境を殺し屋は無造作にまたぎ越す。
source.english:
Before he could shape a word, the heat of the blood that had struck him full in the face tangled the young man's tongue. It cooled at once upon his skin, turning clammy, and robbed him of what little composure remained.
For the moment he had escaped the danger before him, but the shotgun behind him remained an absolute threat: one twitch of the thug's finger could riddle both the young man and the assassin with shot. The assassin crossed that vanishing instant of danger as casually as a threshold.

source.japanese: 構えもなくのこのこと青年を回りこんだとしか見えない挙動、なのに殺し屋の運足は見事に生き残った凶漢の反応に先んじており、引き金を引くという僅かな動きを許す間もなく、刀身が弧に奔る。
source.english: He seemed merely to stroll around the young man, without even taking a stance. Yet his footwork was well ahead of the surviving thug's reactions. Before the man could make the tiny movement needed to pull the trigger, the sword raced through an arc.

target.text: This corporeal flesh, just moments ago ready to murder a man and rape a woman, letting its violent impulses run rampant, breathed its last in a single stroke, spared the agonies of death as an awesome spray of blood spouted into the air; emerging from behind the collapsing villain was a pair of azure eyes, peering into the young man's own in exasperation.
【Man in Japanese clothes】 「Listen here, man. Pretty sure I already told you, if you're gonna get killed by somebody, let it be me……」
【Young man】 「……Nh, ……!?」

Before he could attempt to say anything, the heat of the blood that washed all over his face entangled with his tongue, it stuck to his skin, and the rapidly cooling and clammy temperature only made him lose his composure all the more. But despite having escaped the danger looming in front of him, the shotgun at his back still presented a grave threat, and at the mere pull of the trigger, both the young man and the murderer alike would be riddled with holes, but the murderer casually stepped through the gap between one blink and the next.

His conduct made it look as if he had merely brazenly walked around the young man, and yet his footwork completely forestalled the yet-living outlaw's reaction, not even permitting him the tiny action of pulling the trigger, his blade flashing in an arc.

source.japanese: ───逆風の一刀───
source.english: —A rising stroke, against the wind—

source.japanese: 下から跳ね上がった切っ先はやすやすと凶漢の腹を割いて、今度は青年の背中に血飛沫をぶちまける。
source.english: The point swept upward and opened the thug's belly with ease. This time the spray of blood struck the young man's back.

source.japanese: 腸は、凶漢が倒れ伏した後に斬り口から溢れ出した。それくらい鋭利な切断面だった。
source.english: The entrails did not spill from the wound until after the thug had fallen. That was how cleanly the blade had cut.

target.text: ──Ascending Vertical Stroke──
The blade rising sharply from below easily split the outlaw's stomach, and this time, it was the young man's back that was sprayed all over with blood.
After the outlaw collapsed, his innards spilled out from the incision. So razor-sharp a cut was it.

source.japanese:
【青年】
「ひ、ひとごろしだーーっ」
source.english: “M-Murderer!”

source.japanese:
【和服の男】
「あのなあ。お前、何を今更。
　だから俺は殺し屋だっつってんだろが……」
source.english:
“Oh, come on. You're only noticing now?
I told you I'm an assassin…”

target.text: 【Young man】 「Mu-, murdererーー」
【Man in Japanese clothes】 「Come on. Buddy. It's a little late for that. I already told you myself that I'm a murderer……」

source.japanese: ぶんぶんと、傘の水を払うような無造作な血降りの動作なりに、絨毯に円弧の血が散って汚して、一呼吸有ったかどうかの間に死屍累々、部屋の中は一大酸鼻、女客は人死によりも部屋が汚れた事の方が気に障るようで、
source.english:
He shook the blood from his sword as casually as water from an umbrella, spattering arcs across the carpet. In scarcely the space of a breath, bodies had fallen and the room had become a scene of carnage.
The woman seemed more offended by the mess than by the deaths.

source.japanese:
【女客】
「貴方、カードは今度にしましょう。
　興が削がれちゃった。
　それより今は、お部屋を綺麗にしていって」
source.english:
“We'll play cards another time.
My mood's quite spoiled.
For now, clean my room before you go.”

source.japanese: 青年にそう命じたりするのだが───
source.english: That was her order to the young man—but—

target.text: Shaking off the blood, a nonchalant gesture as though he were ridding his umbrella of water, the carpet stained in scattered arcs of blood, corpses all around him within the time it took to heave a single breath, the room absolutely ghastly; still, it seemed like the female passenger was far less bothered by the corpses than the fact her room had been dirtied so,
【Female passenger】 「Dear, let us leave the cards for another occasion. My good mood has been killed. More importantly, clean this room.」
She ordered the young man thus, but───

source.japanese:
【恐ろしい顔の男】
「何やってやがる新前、さっさと上がってきて手伝えこっちをっ」
source.english: “What the hell are you doing, new boy? Get back up here and give us a hand!”

target.text: 【Man with a terrifying face】 「What the hell are you doing here, green hand? Get back up already and help out, this way─」

source.japanese: 上で待ちくたびれたのか、業を煮やして駆け下りてきた水夫長に耳捻りあげられ女客の船室から引きずり出され───
source.english: The boatswain, having apparently tired of waiting above, came charging down in a fury, twisted the young man’s ear, and dragged him out of the woman passenger’s cabin—

target.text: He must have gotten fed up of waiting up above, lost his temper, then ran down here, for the Bosun grabbed him by the ear and dragged him out of the female passenger's stateroom───

source.japanese:
【アルビノの女の子】
「うあああん、
　中でおまるがひっくり返ったのぅ……っ」
source.english:
“Waaaaah!
The potty tipped over in here…!”

source.japanese: 通路奥の『船長の箱』の中からは、そんな末期的な泣き声が漏れ聞こえ───
source.english: From the captain's box at the far end of the passage came that final, catastrophic wail—

source.japanese: 相手が暴漢とはいえその惨死を目の当たりにし、顔中血みどろになって、そして女客からは急かされ水夫長からは怒鳴られ船長はぐずり、青年は命冥加に生きのびた事を喜ぶ暇もなく、盛大に後悔した事である。
source.english: Violent thugs though the men had been, the young man had still witnessed their hideous deaths; his face was drenched in blood; the woman passenger hurried him, the boatswain roared at him, and the captain bawled. He had no leisure even to rejoice in the providence that had spared his life. Instead, he regretted—magnificently and with all his heart:

target.text: 【Albino Girl】 「Waaaah, the chamber pot tipped over inside……」
From inside the 『Captain's Box』 in the depths of the passageways, one could hear that fateful death-knell of a whimper leaking out───

Ruffians they may be, he had still just witnessed their violent deaths, his face was covered with blood, and then he'd been rushed by the female passenger, yelled at by the Bosun, and now the captain was sobbing; the young man was not even given a moment to rejoice in the providential protection that had spared his life, no, he merely regretted all of it greatly.

source.japanese: ───ああ本当に───
source.english: —Oh, honestly—

source.japanese: ───一体全体なんだってこんな───
source.english: —Why in God's name—

source.japanese: ───地獄みたいな船に───
source.english: —Had I ended up—

source.japanese: ───乗りこむことに───
source.english: —Aboard a ship—

source.japanese: ───なっちまったんだろう───
source.english: —Straight out of hell?—

target.text: ───Aah, truly───
───How in the world───
───Did I end up───
───Sailing aboard a ship───
───This hellish───

source.japanese:
何度後悔してもしきれない、心はあの日あの晩へと、未練がましく遡っていく。
　あの、雑踏の中の、水鳥のような、飛び魚のような、後ろ姿を見かけ、ついつい追いかけて雑踏の中に踏み込んでしまったその晩へ。
source.english:
No amount of regret could ever be enough. His mind drifted stubbornly back to that day, that evening.
The evening when he had glimpsed the figure in the crowd, like a waterbird, like a flying fish—and, unable to help himself, stepped into the throng to follow it.

target.text: He could never regret it enough, and his mind wandered back to that day, that evening, heart full of ruefulness. In the midst of the hustle and bustle, like a seabird, like a flying fish, when he saw that back. To that evening, when he chased after it against his better judgment, stepping into that crowd of people.

source.japanese:
さて。
　この青年、名を朔屋直正という。旧幕時代の幕臣めいた大層なお名前とは裏腹の、だらけたその人となりは一端とはいえ前段から窺えよう。
source.english:
Now then.
This young man's name was Naomasa Sakuya. It was a grand name, fit for a retainer of the old shogunate. His character was rather less grand; the preceding episode should have given some hint of his fecklessness.

source.japanese: つまり基本的に怠惰でいい加減で女にだらしなく、これといった特技も持たず足が速いとか膂力に秀でるとかの体の強みもなく、さりとておつむの方もまずまず日々の暮らしに差し障りがないという程度、要するになんの取り柄もない凡骨、というにもいささか足らない、これらの身上に加えて躁鬱の気があったりするので、鬱期に転がりこんだ時なぞは完全に人並み以下に成り下がる。
source.english: He was, in short, lazy, careless, and hopeless where women were concerned. He had no particular skill, no fleetness of foot or exceptional strength. His brains were sufficient to get him through the ordinary business of living, and little more. One might have called him an undistinguished mediocrity, but even that was slightly too generous. For on top of all these qualities, he had a tendency toward manic highs and depressive lows. Whenever he slipped into a depressive phase, he fell well below the ordinary run of men.

source.japanese:
こういう無能力者がこの年まで長じてこられたのは、実家がそこそこの旧家であったかららしい。とはいえ跡取りでもない次男坊、兄の方は申し分のない優秀人で、家督の憂いはなく、朔屋は大して期待もされず一族からは空気の如き扱いを受けてきた。
　空しい境遇と言えば言えるが、同様の立場に生まれついた者など世にはいくらでも転がっており、中には発憤して独力で身を立てる者だって珍しくはない。要は本人の志次第なのだが、この朔屋に関しては、そういった向上心とか気概というのが一切欠けていた。
source.english:
Apparently, such an incompetent had survived to his present age because he came from an old family of some standing. But he was the second son, not the heir. His elder brother was an exemplary young man, and the succession gave no cause for concern. Little was expected of Sakuya. His relatives treated him as though he were air.
A hollow existence, perhaps. But there were plenty of people born into the same position, and no shortage of those who took it as a spur to make their own way. It came down to a person's ambition. Sakuya had no ambition whatever, nor any spirit of self-improvement.

source.japanese: それまでも穀潰しの兆しは見えていたのだが、一五の年に、ついうっかりと女の味を覚えてしまったのが決定的な契機となる。
source.english: Signs that he was a freeloader had been visible even before then, but the decisive turning point came in the year he turned fifteen, when he inadvertently discovered the pleasures of women.

source.japanese:
勉学も運動も人並みの以下のくせ、性的好奇心だけは旺盛で日々悶々と、せっかくの思春期の気力を家族に隠れて自涜に費やすばかりであった朔屋だからして、一度女の肌に味を占めてしまえばもういけない。
　当時の彼の相手というのは、実家に通いの年上の手伝い娘で、ひょんな経緯から朔屋の自慰の現場に遭遇してしまい、主家の坊ちゃまの秘密踏んでしまった気まずさと（もっともこの頃の朔屋は隙さえあらば逸物いじりに溺れていたから、いずれ誰かに知られる事は必然だったのだが）、日頃良く懐いてきていた彼への情にほだされて（実のところこれとて春機に目覚めた朔屋が、じゃれる振りして彼女の尻に抱きついていた、というのが真相なのだが）、ついつい閨の秘め事を手解きしてしまったのであった。
source.english:
Sakuya was below average at both study and sport, but in sexual curiosity he yielded to no one. Day after tormented day, he spent the precious vigor of adolescence masturbating in secret from his family; once he had acquired a taste for a woman's skin, there was no saving him.
His partner then was an older maid who came in to work at the family home. By some chance she caught Sakuya masturbating and found herself awkwardly burdened with the young master's secret—though at the time he fondled himself whenever he saw an opening, so discovery was inevitable. Affection for the boy who had grown so attached to her got the better of her—though in truth that attachment consisted largely of the newly awakened Sakuya pretending to horse around while clinging to her backside. Before long, almost despite herself, she was teaching him the secrets of the bedchamber.

target.text: Now then. This young man, he who goes by the name Sakuya Naomasa. As could be glimpsed from the preceding chapter, fragmentary as it was, in stark contrast to his grandiose name reminiscent of a direct vassal of the Shogun from the old Edo period, he was laziness incarnate.

That is, he was fundamentally lazy, sloppy, and irresponsibly inconstant with women, with nothing you could call a special talent, not excelling in any physical feats of strength like being a fast runner or suchlike, but for all that, at least his brains were passable enough to not obstruct his day-to-day life: in summary, an utterly ordinary man with no redeeming qualities, but even that would not quite suffice, for in addition to his background, he also had a manic temperament, and when the depression paid a visit, he'd regress to something entirely below the average.

The reason such an incapable person had managed to live this long was, apparently, thanks to the efforts of his parents, for he came from a reasonably established family. That said, as the second son and not the heir, his older brother being a brilliant man with no noticeable flaws, there were no fears regarding the family estate, and as such, little was expected from Sakuya, and he was treated like he were made of air by his entire family.

It could perhaps be called a hollow existence, but there must have been plenty others in this world born under similar circumstances, and it would not be rare for those among their numbers to be roused into making their life a success through their own efforts. In essence, it depended on the will of the person in question, but when it came to Sakuya here, he was utterly lacking in such ambitions or mettle or the like.

He might have already shown signs of becoming a parasite up to this point, but in his 15th year, when he, by pure chance, happened to experience his first taste of a woman, that was the final nail in the coffin.

In spite of his athletic and academic abilities both being below average, his sexual curiosity was healthy, and he was horny every day, and for Sakuya, who spent all his teenage vigour on masturbation in secret from his family, once he had held a woman within his arms, he was beyond salvation. As for his partner at the time, it was a charwoman older than him who commuted to his parents' home, and in an unexpected turn of events, she happened to intrude upon Sakuya's masturbation.

By way of feeling awkward at intruding upon a secret belonging to the young son of the master of the estate (although at this point in time, Sakuya took any chance he could get to indulge in diddling his penis, so it was inevitable that, sooner or later, somebody would come to know), as well as being overcome by sentiment for this young man who had been so attached to her for so long (in reality, when Sakuya first learned of his sexual desires, he would cling to the woman's butt under the pretense of playing around, that was the truth), against her better judgment, she initiated him in the basics of secret bedroom activities.

source.japanese: これ自体はまあ良くも悪くのありがちの、まあ少年にとってはやや幸運な、少し淫らで少し甘酸っぱい情戯の通過儀礼に過ぎなかったろう。家族も気づいて黙認した節がある。
source.english: In and of itself, this was probably just a run-of-the-mill rite of passage, for better or worse—though perhaps slightly fortunate for the boy—a bit lewd and a bit bittersweet. There were signs that his family had noticed and tacitly tolerated it.

source.japanese: ただ朔屋少年は、その一度きりで終わらせるつもりなど毛頭無く、それまでは隙あらば自涜可能な機会を独りで窺っていたところ、以降は手伝い娘と二人で秘め事に耽られる隙を狙う鵜の目鷹の目に変わっただけの、なんとも始末に負えない。
source.english: Sakuya had no intention whatever of letting matters end after a single encounter. Before, he had watched like a hawk for any chance to pleasure himself in private; now he watched just as ravenously for an opening to indulge in secret with the serving girl. He was quite beyond managing.

source.japanese: 実家では皆寝静まった夜更け以外はどうにも人目が厳しいと覚った朔屋少年は、それならと手伝い娘の下宿に押しかけるようになり、しまいには入り浸りとなった。手伝い娘の方も、年下を甘えさせる事が嬉しい性情の女で、初めは諫めながらもどうしても流されてしまう、これは確かに、娘の優しさというよりだらしなさだが、一度体を許してしまった相手にはどうにも甘い女の性ばかりを責められまい。
source.english: Once Sakuya realized that the family home afforded no privacy except in the dead of night, he began inviting himself to the serving girl's lodgings, and before long had all but moved in. She was the sort of woman who enjoyed indulging those younger than herself. At first she would admonish him, but inevitably she gave way. This was laxity rather than kindness, certainly; but she was a woman inclined to softness once she had given herself to a man, and that weakness alone could hardly bear all the blame.

source.japanese: 言うまでもなく問題は朔屋であり、見る間に学業は下落し、家を長く空けるようになり、それまでは勤勉であった手伝い娘が仕事に穴を空けがちになったとあっては、流石に実家の勘気を蒙った。
source.english: Needless to say, the trouble was Sakuya. His studies plummeted before their eyes; he began staying away from home for days on end; and when the hitherto diligent serving girl began neglecting her work, he at last incurred the wrath of his family.

source.japanese:
結局娘には充分の手当を持たせて里に帰し、朔屋は家長の鉄拳制裁の後で寄宿制の学校に封じこまれる事になったのが顛末の、厳しい学校だったからと、親も一安心したのは迂闊であった。
　こういう場合、親の目から離れてしまうのは逆効果なのである。どんなところにでもいる放蕩児が、朔屋の小遣い目当てに寮からの抜け道を教授した事から始まって、酒の呑み方、商売女を買うあれこれを仕込みくさった事に両親が気づいたのは、学校からの落第の通知と寄宿舎に相当期間戻っていない事の報せに激怒し、あれこれ手を尽くした挙げ句、すっかりおけらになって曖昧宿の娼妓の部屋でにっちもさっちもいかなくなっていた次男坊を発見した時の、後の祭の馬鹿見本である。
source.english:
In the end the girl was given a generous settlement and sent home, while Sakuya received the patriarch's fist and was confined to a boarding school. It was a strict school, which reassured his parents. That was careless of them. In cases like his, removing the boy from parental eyes only makes matters worse.
It began when one of those wastrels found everywhere, after Sakuya's spending money, showed him a way out of the dormitory. The little bastard went on to teach him how to drink and how to buy a woman. His parents discovered what had been made of him only when the school reported his failure and the dormitory reported that he had not returned for a considerable time. Furious, they exhausted every means of finding him, only to discover their second son stone-broke and trapped in a prostitute's room at a dubious inn. A textbook case of too little, too late.

source.japanese:
ここまで落ちれば後は外面をどう取り繕[つくろ]おうと矯正が利くものではない───
　勉学も成らず、社会の中で身を立てる道も持たず、かといって実家で飼い殺しにしようともたびたび金を持ち出しては女と酒に空費する。
source.english:
Once he had fallen so far, no amount of outward respectability could set him right.
He had failed at his studies and had no means of making a place for himself in society. Keeping him idle at home did no good, either: time and again he took money from the house and squandered it on drink and women.

source.japanese: ここまで堕落しながらも、朔屋の性情は不思議と荒まず、浮ついた坊ちゃん気性のままで長じたのはせめても救いか───いや、どう考えても帳尻合わず、慰めにもならない。
source.english:
Despite his depravity, his disposition had somehow never soured. He grew up the same frivolous, sheltered young gentleman. That, at least, was something to be thankful for—
No. However one looked at it, the accounts did not balance. It was no consolation at all.

source.japanese: しまいには激昂した海軍士官出の伯父御が、船上暮らしの厳しさで性根矯め直すと船員学校に叩きこんだところで、時既に遅し、実家からの仕送りが打ち切られても稼ぐ事知らず、たかれる相手にはたかり、時には情夫まがいに女の部屋に流連し、いっそ見事なまでにだらけきった毎日が朔屋の日常となった。
source.english: At last an uncle, formerly a naval officer, lost his temper and packed him off to a school for sailors. The rigors of life at sea would straighten him out, he declared. Too late. Even when his family stopped sending money, Sakuya never learned to earn it. He sponged on anyone who would let him. Sometimes he lingered in a woman's room, all but a kept man. His daily life became a display of idleness so complete it was almost impressive.

source.japanese: だからあの夜だって、乏しくなった懐中を、ならいっそ一晩でぱっと遣ってしまおうと港町まで繰り出しただけの事、稼ぎ口を探すどころか誰ぞに頭を下げて無心しようとも考えずに、刹那的な快楽を溺れる朔屋青年、一夜明けて財布を逆さに振っても埃しか出なくなった時には、少しばかりは悔やむ事だろう。反省はしないだろうが。
source.english: That evening, then, he had simply come down to the port to spend his dwindling funds in one glorious night. He had not thought of finding work, or even of bowing his head and asking someone for money. He preferred to drown in fleeting pleasures. When morning came and shaking his purse upside down produced nothing but dust, he would probably feel a little regret. He would not learn anything.

source.japanese:
それに、次の朝などは考えてもしかたのない遠い未来の事なのだ。
　今は金髪の、目覚ましいような美女二人を両脇に侍らせてやに下がっているとあっては、先の事などこの邦[くに]の政局を占うより、難しい。
source.english:
Besides, the next morning was so far in the future that there was no point thinking about it.
At present he had a dazzling blond beauty on either side, and wore a thoroughly satisfied grin. Predicting what came next was harder than predicting the country's political fortunes.

target.text: This in itself was common enough, for better or worse, and well, for the young boy, it was a stroke of fortune, a slightly indecent and bittersweet rite of passage of pretend love and nothing more. It seemed plausible that his family might even have noticed and tacitly approved of it all.

However, the young man Sakuya intended not in the least to let things come to an end after but a single time; hitherto, he had taken any chance when he was by himself as an opportunity to masturbate, and henceforth, he was utterly incorrigible, his gaze turning predatory as a hawk on the hunt, scouting for any opportunity to abandon himself in the secretive intimacies he shared with the help.

Outside of the night, where everyone was sleeping quietly, the young man Sakuya was always of the mind that his parents were awfully unsparing in their attentiveness, so he started showing up uninvited at the helper girl's lodgings and ultimately ended up sticking around. The helper, too, was of such a temperament that she found a certain joy in indulging a younger man's desires, so although she initially would try to dissuade him, she always ended up going along with it, certainly a greater sign of her weak will than just kindness, but it was not only the nature of womankind, of being hopelessly soft on those you have given yourself to once before, that was to blame here.

It does not even need to be said that Sakuya was the problem; his grades suddenly plummeted, he was out of the home for long hours, and the helper girl, who been so diligent hitherto, got into a habit of missing work, and as one might expect, incurred the wrath of his parents.

In the end, the girl was given an adequate compensation and returned to her hometown, while Sakuya, after suffering his due punishment by way of the patriarch's fists, was ultimately confined to a boarding school, but while the school was very strict, it was careless of his parents to feel any peace of mind. In situations like these, being far from the watchful eyes of your parents has the opposite effect. It all started when Sakuya's pocket money caught the attention of some profligates, of a kind pervasive throughout society, who taught him how to sneak out of the dorm, how to drink alcohol, how to buy women of easy virtue, all manner of things.

The way his parents found out was through the notice they received from the school informing them that he had failed his grade and not been back at the dormitory for a substantial period of time, so in a rage, and after using any and all means available, by the time they found their second son, he was left utterly penniless in some cyprian's room in some shady hostelry, the sort serving tea below and vices above, completely caught between Scylla and Charybdis, a model specimen of a hopeless dullard.

After falling so low, it mattered not what veneer of respectability he tried to maintain, his character was past the point of mending─── Unsuited for the pursuit of knowledge, possessed of no path to success in life, but even assuming they simply let him waste his life at home without demanding anything in return, he would repeatedly sneak out some money and waste it on women and drink.

Even having fallen this far, Sakuya's sexual desire was bizarrely unaffected; perhaps growing up with the flippant temperament of a naive young man from a well-to-do family was his only saving grace───nay, no matter how one considered this, it did not balance out, it could not even serve as consolation.

By the time Sakuya's uncle, a man who had formerly served as a naval officer, at last grew indignant, said the hard life on a ship would rectify his character and help him grow a backbone, then threw him into a nautical school, it was already too late, and having been cut off from the allowance his parents had given him, and with no knowledge of how to make money himself, he sponged off whoever he could; at times, he'd spend the night in a woman's room as a male escort, and soon enough, spending every day in impressively slothful idleness became Sakuya's routine.

That is why, on that night, his pockets having grown light, he figured that, if so, why not spend all he had in one night as he went into town, not worried if he should find some way to make money or lower his head and pester somebody for more; the young man Sakuya wanted to drown himself in transitory pleasures, and when dawn arrived and his pockets would cough out nothing but dust and lint when upended, he would probably come to regret it, just a little. But he would also be unlikely to feel any remorse.

Furthermore, the next morrow was so far in the future that it was pointless to even think about. At the very least, right now, with these two strikingly beautiful blonde women smirking in satisfaction as they waited upon him, divining what lay in wait for him was even harder than predicting the future of the country's political situation.

source.japanese:
場末の酒場のひ弱い灯りに、タンブラーを干す手の筋が陰翳濃く浮き上がる、返す刀で安酒の瓶注ぐ手もぶれて、タンブラーの中は大波小波、頭上の灯りも酒の水面に揺れている。揺れているのは朔屋のおつむの乏しい中味も然りであり、既に酔眼朦朧と熟柿の息を鯨の潮めかして噴き上げれば、灯りはあの珍[めずら]かな幻日環のように二重にぶれていた。
　こう灯りが二重写しになるのは深酔いした時には良くある事だから良いとして、朔屋は目線を下ろす先、まずは左に、
source.english:
In the feeble light of the shabby tavern, the tendons of his hand stood out in deep shadow as he drained his tumbler. With the same flourish, that wavering hand brought the bottle of cheap liquor around; great waves and little rolled through the glass, rocking the reflection of the lamp above. What little occupied Sakuya's skull was rocking too. His eyes already bleary, he sent up a whale's spout of breath rank as overripe persimmon; the lamp doubled before him into a halo like that rare wonder, a parhelic circle.
Seeing two lamps was ordinary enough in deep drink. No matter. Sakuya lowered his gaze, first to his left—

source.japanese:
【金髪の美女・左】
「うっふっふ、若旦那、あなたちょっと可愛い顔してるじゃない」
source.english: “Hehehe. You're quite a cute little gentleman, aren't you?”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「へっへっへー。そう？　そう見えるん？
　今までそんなコト言われたコトないから、
　なんか嬉しいねえ」
source.english:
“Heh heh. Am I? You think so?
Nobody's ever told me that before.

　美女が朔屋の睾丸むんずと掴み、林檎の汁を搾[しぼ]り出しかねない握力がもたらした、無慈悲で残酷な激痛に一度は覚醒したのだけれど、それも僅かしか続かない。その間に一方がペンを握らせ、なにやら紙切れに署名しろと強要してきても、一度は酩酊にペンを取り落とし書き損じたのはかえって幸運、でも長続きはせず、肩口に強かに噛みついてきた美女の歯の尖った痛みに、よじれた筆致ながらも署名して、してしまって、その失策を覚る前に意識はまた落ちこんだ、渦巻く混沌の度合いは、触覚をもがれた蟻の軌跡のようにねじれた署名の末尾の『正』の字の端に現れている……こんな事も覚えていない。
　署名さえ取ってしまえば、後は寝ていても簡単と、拇印まで捺させられた事も、知らない。
source.english:
And so he knew nothing of what followed.
One of the beauties seized his testicles in a grip that might have squeezed the juice from an apple. The ruthless pain did wake him once, but not for long. Meanwhile, the other put a pen in his hand and demanded that he sign a piece of paper. In his drunkenness he dropped the pen and spoiled his first attempt—a stroke of luck, briefly. Then sharp teeth bit hard into his shoulder. He signed, in a twisted scrawl. Signed. Before he could recognize his mistake, he sank out of consciousness again. The chaos of his senses showed itself in the final character of his name: the last strokes of 正 wandered like the trail of an ant deprived of its antennae. He remembered none of this.
With the signature secured, the rest was easy, even while he slept. He did not know they made him leave a thumbprint, too.

source.japanese: ……ざぶざぶと、手に注ぐ水道水は春先の金魚鉢の水の温さ、爽快感には乏しかったけれど、それでも頭から浴びればいくらかこの頭痛もましになるだろう。それくらいは許して欲しいと、懇願に振り返っても、背後のそれはそれは恐ろしい顔の男は口角牙剥き出しに睨[にら]みつけ、朔屋には些細な慰めさえも許さない。
source.english: …Water splashed into his hands. It was as tepid as a goldfish bowl in early spring, hardly refreshing. Still, if he could pour some over his head, perhaps it would ease the headache. source.japanese:
港の朝まだき───潮風は太陽に温[ぬく]められ始めて間もない。これが昼ともなるとそこらここらの油の匂いが籠もって、今の朔屋には嘔吐催させたろうが、まだ今なら少しばかり心地よい。
　背後には港町、昨夜の酒場があの町並みのどこにあるのか、朔屋には見当もつかなかったし、海に臨む堤防という、胸の扉を大きく開きたくなるような眺めなのに、朔屋には薬にもならなかった。
　港の片隅の水道を盗み借りして、猿股一つでズボンを洗っているという状況では、潮風も海の眺めも、薬にもならなかった。
source.english:
It was early morning at the harbor. The sun had only just begun to warm the sea breeze. By noon, the smells of oil would gather everywhere, enough to make Sakuya vomit in his present state. For now, the wind was almost pleasant.
The port town lay behind him. He had no idea where among its streets last night's tavern stood. Before him was the sea wall and a view that ought to have thrown open the doors of his heart. It did him no good.
But he was washing his trousers in his underpants, helping himself to a tap in a corner of the harbor. Under the circumstances, neither the sea breeze nor the view offered much relief.

target.text: ……Splash. The tap water he was scooping up with his hands was the temperature of a goldfish bowl in early spring, and it was scarcely refreshing, but if he continued to dash it over his head, then surely this headache of his would improve. He would like to be permitted that much at least, but as he turned around pleadingly, what waited at his back was a man with an extraordinarily scary face, glaring at him with fangs bared in the corners of his mouth, and so Sakuya was not permitted even the most trivial of consolations.

In the port as dawn broke─── The sea breeze had not even had time to warm in the sun. Were it noon, the stench of oil from here and there would linger in the air, and it would surely only induce a desire to puke in Sakuya as he felt now, so as it stood, he felt at least a little comfortable in comparison. Behind him was the port town, the bar from last night was perhaps somewhere in those streets, not that Sakuya had any guesses as to where, and here on this wharf overlooking the sea, despite how this breathtaking view would fill one with the desire to fling wide open the door to one's heart, it was no salve for Sakuya's predicament.

Borrowing some tap water without permission in a corner of the port, standing in his undershorts while washing his pants, neither the ocean breeze nor the view of the ocean could cure him of his ills.

source.japanese:

source.japanese:

　太鼓腹ではあったが、不健康に太るのではなく、激しい労働の果てに筋肉の上に乗った脂肪で、荒事の相手とするに一番避けたい手合いである。朔屋は起きがけのこの恐怖の出会いに、他愛もなく失禁しそうになったけれどそれには及ばなかった。
　既にして、ズボンは眠っている間に垂れ流したと思しき尿で冷たく濡れていた。

A dreadful awakening. He had groaned at the hardness of his bed and opened his eyes to a bald, bearded man peering down at him. Never again. I don’t even want to look at another drink. Let me fly to a country without alcohol. Such prayers belonged to the mere dabbler in drink. A man of Sakuya’s caliber thought instead: Feeling this sick makes it hard to get the next drink down. Couldn’t the alcohol hurry up and leave my system? target.text: The moment of awakening was the worst. As he groaned at the hardness of his bed and got up, what he first saw was a bald head and a bearded face, and on half of his already vicious features, this man was covered in an even more terrifying tattoo, and though he looked to be a bit up in the years, he had not withered in the slightest, with arms like tree trunks that could easily crush the likes of Sakuya's neck, muscles rippling. 【Naomasa】 「This is…… why am I here in this place? And who are you……oh. Where are those girls……!?」
【Man with a terrifying face】 「Shut it, and get your stinking breath away from me. You reek of booze. And if that's not enough, you smell like piss too. Go wash yourself first, get up already.」

The moment he was grabbed by the arm and pulled to his feet, Sakuya moaned as the hangover rushed to the top of his head; he was then unceremoniously kicked in the ass by the man with the terrifying face, then shooed to a water tap next to the rust-stained roll-up door of a warehouse in the port.

The moment of awakening was the worst. A heavy, dull hangover together with an intense unpleasantness coiled itself around his stomach and the back of his head, and whenever he took a breath or his heart pounded, even the slightest jolt of his body seemed to strike at his nerves directly with a hammer, bringing with it an unimaginable suffering. I never want to drink or even see alcohol ever again; in fact, I want to leave for a country free of booze. Desires akin to these were the realm of mere dilettantes in the art of drinking.

On the other hand, for the likes of Sakuya, when he felt this ill at ease, he found it quite hard to chug down the next drink, so he'd prefer to sober up as soon as possible, or if not that, perhaps something light with carbonation could help get the sticky saliva stuck in his throat flowing again, and so on; no matter how bad it got, he would never leave behind the booze, he was a man who never learned his lesson, and to begin with, his ability to learn and anything like it had fully evaporated on the morn of his first hangover, back when his partners in crime had forcibly introduced him to the concept of hair of the dog.

Even though he had not the laudable disposition to be discouraged from drinking, washing your piss-stained pants in front of a stranger was, all things considered, no different from a disgraceful public execution, even for Sakuya, and given that he had to strip out of his undershorts to wash them after he finished with his pants, it would truly be pathetic to expose his behind to the faint morning breeze in front of a middle-aged man, and he couldn't help but wish that it was the two beauties from yesterday that were with him this morning instead.

But had this been last night while he was still enjoying the company of those two, then the extreme embarrassment could well have awakened a new sexual fetish within him, and it would only have ended with him adding yet another worthless flaw to his already needlessly long list, so it was probably quite fortunate that he was dealing with this terrifying man instead.

He finished his washing and wrung his clothes out as best as he could. If he tried to shout his objections, it was quite obvious that the man would just rely on his brute strength instead, so Sakuya was left with no choice but to let the man herd him along once more, and even as he tried to make his escape, that pounding, throbbing pain in his head was just too───
