source.japanese: 本人としては獲得せし者の余裕のつもりかもしれない微笑には、朔屋にもよくよく覚えがあった。曖昧宿にしけこんだ街娼の、パンツを引きずり下ろしていく時に自然に湧きあがる笑みと同質で、部屋の隅の姿見に映った己の鼻の下の長さに慌てて口元引き締めてももう遅い、娼婦にはしっかり見られてついでに足元も見られた様子だが、それでもその晩は二度・三度と浅ましく励んでそれは閑却、白スーツが渇望していた品とは、どうやら。
source.english: Sakuya knew that smile well: the complacent smile of possession. The same expression rose naturally to his own face when he tugged down a streetwalker's panties in some seedy inn. By the time he caught sight of his stretched, leering upper lip in the room's full-length mirror and hurried to compose himself, it was too late; the woman had seen his eagerness and priced her services accordingly. He still went at it two or three times that night, shamelessly enough. But set that aside. The coveted article for which the man in white had been yearning was, apparently—

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「けふぅ……ああ、クロ、げろしちゃった」
source.english: “Kefu… Ah, Kuro threw up.”

source.japanese: 胃液臭いおくびを漏らして一息ついてから、
source.english: She let out a belch that smelled of stomach acid and took a breath,

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「あれ？　どうして、しばってるです？
　クロは、ごめんなさい、また粗相したから？
　クロ、ゲロしちゃったから？」
source.english:
“Huh? Why am I tied up?
Is it because Kuro—sorry—messed up again?
Is it because Kuro threw up?”

source.japanese: ようやく把握した状況に混乱するというより、粗相への仕置きを恐れてわななく口元というのがまたこの白子の少女の卑屈さ加減を物語る。そして白スーツは、幼子の哀しい涙を吸いあげて滋養と為す妖魔のようにクロの困惑の顔を満悦の相で味わいつ、封書の中味を指先で摘[つま]み示すがディレイクション仕掛ける手品師はだしに大仰に。
source.english: Her trembling mouth spoke less of confusion at the situation she had finally grasped than of fear that this latest mistake would be punished—another measure of the albino girl's abject servility. The man in white savored her bewildered face like a demon that drinks a child's sad tears for nourishment. Then, with the grand flourish of a magician setting up his misdirection, he pinched the envelope's contents between two fingers and held them aloft.

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「ようし。これでこの白子ちゃんは、僕のモノだなっ」
source.english: “All right. With this, this little albino girl’s mine now!”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「はぁ!?」
source.english: “Huh!?”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「まあ知らなかったようだが、お前が持ってきた半券は、その子の身請け証文に張る印紙の片割れだったんだね」
source.english: “You apparently weren't told, but the torn stamp you brought is the matching half of the revenue stamp affixed to that girl's deed of redemption.”

source.japanese:
知らぬで当たり前、展開を呑みこみかねて喉につまらせてくぐもった鼻息で返す朔屋に、白スーツが取り出す半券の片割れ、破れ目はぴたりと合い、割り印も重なった。厭になるほど気取って俗物臭い手さばきでは、種明かしもなにも、鼻につくばかり。
　ただし本人は観客の反応なぞ知った事かと大満足の、話していくうちに、目が狂的かつ偏執的なかぎろい垂れ流し、所作の度に厭らしい光跡を倉庫の暗がりに曳くかのよう、口調までも幼児的に躁を帯びる。
source.english:
Naturally Sakuya knew nothing of this. As he choked on the turn of events and answered with no more than a muffled snort, the man in white produced the stamp's other half. The torn edges matched exactly; so did the two halves of the red seal. His vulgar, insufferably affected handling made the revelation less impressive than offensive.
Not that he cared how his audience received it. He was delighted with himself. As he spoke, a mad, obsessive light began to stream from his eyes, as though every gesture dragged a greasy trail through the warehouse gloom. Even his voice climbed into a childish mania.

source.japanese:
ああ───もしかして。
　こいつは、そういう───
　金持て余した馬鹿にありがちな、
　そういう───
source.english:
Ah—could it be?
This man was one of those—
one of those rich fools with money to burn,
one of those—

source.japanese:
衣食住共に満たされた人間が求めるものといっては、珍奇な刺激物というのが腐れた世の常の、より珍奇に、より新しいものと求めるうちに、日々の暮らしに追われる小市民には考えも及ばぬゲテモノ探求の道に踏みこんでいくのもありがちの。まあ考えてみれば確かに、珍味美味と称される馬鹿馬鹿しい程に高価な食物などにも、正体を聞けば鼻梁に嫌悪の皺寄せたくなるような物も多い。
　うらなりの白子で知恵足らずというどうしようもないクロなど、朔屋の食指を運ばせるには肉も水気も足らないが、世には進んでイカ物食いに手を染める輩もいる、そういう事だ。
source.english:
In this rotten world, those whose food, clothing, and shelter are assured come to crave ever stranger stimulants. Seeking always the rarer and the newer, they stray into appetites beyond the imagining of ordinary people consumed by daily life. One need only consider the absurdly costly foods praised as delicacies, many of which would wrinkle the nose in disgust if their true substance were named.
Kuro—a sickly, witless little albino—had too little flesh and juice to stir Sakuya's appetite. But there were people who cultivated precisely such grotesque tastes. That was all there was to it.

source.japanese: 朔屋の想像を裏づけるように、身振り手振りの思い入れたっぷりに男は、スーツの白は変わらず清潔なのに、どこかしら濁りを帯びた。
source.english: As if to confirm Sakuya's suspicion, the man's ardent gestures seemed to steep him in something turbid, though the white of his suit remained immaculate.

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「以前より噂は聞いていたんだね。
　あのボロ船の白子ちゃんのことはさ。
　小っちゃくって痩せっぽちで、
　その上舌っ足らずでお馬鹿って言うじゃないか」
source.english:
“I’d heard the gossip, you know.
That little albino girl on the rickety tub.
Tiny, skinny,
and they say she lisps and isn’t too bright, right?”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「───なぁお前っっ!!」
source.english: “Hey, you!!”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「おわあっ!?」
source.english: “Whoa!?”

target.text: 【Rich guy】 「Why, nothing much at all.」

Perhaps he himself had intended for the smile to show the quiet self-possession of a man who had already secured the prize, but it was one that Sakuya only knew all too well. It was the same kind of smile that naturally broke out on his face when he pulled down the panties of a streetwalker he'd slipped into some shady hostelry with, and when he, after seeing how dopey and slack-jawed the expression on his reflection in the full-length mirror in the corner of the room was, tried to quickly purse his lips, the damage was already done, the whore had seen the whole thing, and while she was at it, seemed ready and willing to exploit it; even so, he still shamefully did his best two or three times that night.
But setting that aside, the article this white suit so craved and longed for, it was, seemingly.
【Kuro】 「Keh……aah, Kuro……puked.」
She let out a belch reeking of gastric juices, caught her breath, and then,
【Kuro】 「Huh? Why is Kuro tied up? Kuro is sorry. Was it because Kuro messed up again? Because Kuro puked?」

Rather than confusion after finally grasping her situation, the way her lips instead trembled with fear of some punishment for a blunder spoke much of how servile this albino girl was. And then, like a spectral fiend that sucks up the miserable tears of young children to nourish itself, the white suit tasted Kuro's bewildered expression with a look of rapture, and he plucked the contents from the envelope with a grand, exaggerated flair that could outshine a magician in the middle of misdirecting his audience.
【Rich guy】 「Alright. And with that, this little albino is now mine!」
【Naomasa】 「HUH!?」

【Rich guy】 「Well, it seems you were unaware, but the stub you brought here was actually the matching half of the revenue stamp for the contract assigning that girl's indenture.」 (TN: The term used here is "身請け証文". The "証文" is a deed or contract, while the "身請け" is the term for paying to get someone, especially geishas or prostitutes, out of indentureship or slavery. Slavery was forbidden by law during the Edo period, so the women of the pleasure quarters were often "indebted" instead.)

Of course he was unaware, and while Sakuya found it a very hard pill to swallow, getting it stuck in his throat, replying only with a muffled snort, the white suit took out a fragment of a stub and showed it off to him; it fit perfectly with the tear, and the tally impressions overlapped too. With an execution so sickeningly affected and reeking of such philistinism, the reveal, and everything else about this too, all just left a bitter taste in his mouth.

But as though to all but shout that he cared nothing for the reaction of any spectators, the man in question was as pleased as could be, and while he talked, his eyes emitted a deranged, obsessive gleam; with every gesticulation, it was as though a repulsive trail of light were drawn through the darkness of the warehouse, and even the tone of his voice was tinged with a childlike mania.
Aah───perhaps, could it be. This guy, he was that kind of─── What was all too typically found in those with plenty of money but no sense, that kind of───

On the topic of what people long for once their needs for the basic necessities of life are fulfilled, it is ever the way of this rotten world that novel stimulants are what is sought after, and as they continue to strive for something yet more unusual, more novel, it is quite common for their pursuits to tread down the path of the bizarre, what the petty bourgeois, slaves to their livelihoods, cannot even begin to fathom of. Well, come to think of it, it certainly is true that upon hearing the true nature of the absurdly expensive foodstuffs lauded as rare delicacies, many are of a sort that will make you want to wrinkle your nose in disgust.

Someone like hopeless little Kuro, a pallid albino lacking in intelligence, was too scant of both meat and moisture to whet Sakuya's appetite, but as the world turns, so will there ever be those who wish to dabble in devouring the unusual: that is the nature of things.

And as though to confirm what Sakuya had imagined, while the white of the suit worn by this man busy gesticulating with hands and body to great effect was as immaculate as ever, it was tinged with a vague, murky impurity.

【Rich guy】 「I'd heard rumours about you before. About the little albino on that old, run-down ship. They say you're a tiny, scrawny thing, not to mention tongue-tied and dim-witted. Isn't that right?」
【Rich guy】 「───ISN'T THAT RIGHT, YOU!!」
【Naomasa】 「WAAH!?」

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「ひぃ！」
source.english: “Eek!”

source.japanese: 甲殻類の殻砕く槌よりも苛烈に声、突如として跳ね上がって歪んで、大きな円弧の腕の振りに指差された朔屋はおろか、至近で大音浴びせられたクロなどはひっそりと数滴失禁したのだが、それと気づいたら男はより狂喜に欣喜雀躍した事だろう。
source.english: His voice, more savage than a hammer cracking a crustacean’s shell, suddenly soared and warped. His arm swept through a great arc to point at Sakuya; Kuro, right in the blast of the deafening roar, quietly leaked a few drops of urine. Had he noticed that, the man would surely have rejoiced even more ecstatically.

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「そんな逸材、いませんよ!?
　僕は『小公女』とか『ああ無情』が大好きな子だった。でも僕が好きだったのは、最後に主人公の彼女達が救われるからじゃない」
source.english:
“Where else would you find a gem
like her!? I was the type who loved A Little Princess and Les Misérables. But it wasn’t because the heroines were saved in the end.”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「むしろ救われるその瞬間には本を破り捨てたね。僕は彼女達が零落して落魄して、いじめられていじめ抜かれる事にうっとりしていたんだ」
source.english: “The second they were saved, I tore the book to shreds. I was entranced, watching them fall, watching them get ground down, bullied, bullied, bullied.”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「いや、昂奮していたと言っていい。
　僕の春の目覚めは、彼女達の悲惨に導かれたって訳さ───なのに」
source.english:
“No—excited is the word.
Their misery ushered in my sexual awakening—and yet…”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「なんで最後に救われてしまうんだようっ。
　頭も成長も足らない女の子が、虐げられてのたうち回って喘[あえ]いでもがいて這い上がろうとして、それでも結局はどうにもならずに墜ちたまんまなのが良いんじゃないかッ」
source.english:
“Why does she always get saved at the end?
Isn’t it better when a girl who’s missing a few marbles and hasn’t fully developed gets tormented, writhes around, gasps for breath, struggles, tries to crawl her way up—only to get nowhere and stay down there anyway?”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「だから───僕は誓った。
　誰に誓った？　自分に誓った。
　彼女達を手に入れてやると、自分に誓った」
source.english:
“That’s why—I swore.
Who’d I swear to? Myself.
I swore to myself I’d get my hands on those girls.”

source.japanese:
それは少年の日の、切なる想いであったろう。願いの言葉と、その胸の裡に燃える魂に捧げた誓いであったろう。ある夜に母親は息子に訊ねたものだ。我が腹を痛め、まさに身を二つに裂いて生み落とした分身ながらも、けして根本では理解の及ばぬ、男の子という生き物に、母親は問うたのだ。
　
　───どうして男の子って、窓を広く開けたがるんだろうね──
　
　男の子は、この物静かで控え目で、けれど靱い芯を通わせた母に答えた、そう答えるしかなかったから。
source.english:
That must have been a longing from his boyhood days. A prayer and a vow dedicated to the soul burning deep within his heart. One night, his mother asked her son. To this boy—a creature she had borne with such pain, literally tearing her body in two to bring into the world, a part of herself yet one she could never truly understand at its core—she posed the question.

“Why do boys always want to throw the windows wide open, I wonder?”

The boy answered his mother, so quiet and reserved, yet with such strength at her core—because he had no choice but to answer.

source.japanese:
───血が、熱いからさ───
　
　その血の熱が、魂の誓いが男の子を青年にして男にと鍛え、削り、削ぎ落として鍛造しあげた。
　血の熱は毒の沼の底に澱[よど]むガスの温度であったが。
　魂はどぶ泥を覗きこんだ方がましという色に腐りきっていたが。
source.english:
—My blood runs hot.—
That heat in his blood, that vow in his soul, hammered the boy into a youth and the youth into a man—forging him, paring him, beating him into shape.
Though the warmth of that blood was no more than the temperature of gas stagnating at the bottom of a poison swamp.
Though his soul had rotted to a color that made ditch mud preferable to look upon.

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「だから、僕が手に入れるその子は、
　そんじょそこらの可哀相な子じゃいけない。
　徹底的にダメで、そして珍品じゃないとな」
source.english:
“That is why the girl I take cannot be just any common little object of pity.
She must be hopeless through and through—and a genuine rarity.”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「その意味でこの白子ちゃんほどぴったりなのはいない。噂を聞いてからずっと狙ってた。以前にたまさかこの港に停泊した時に見かけた時は、感動のあまりに気絶した」
source.english: “In that sense, no one’s a better fit than this little albino girl. I’ve had my eye on her ever since I heard the rumors. The one time I happened to spot her when my ship was anchored in this harbor, I fainted from sheer excitement.”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「それ以来ずっと狙ってた。
　あれこれ手を尽くしてあのボロ船をこの港に呼び寄せ、渡りをつけてそしてそしてああようやく───」
source.english:
“I’ve been after her ever since.
I tried everything to coax that rickety tub into this harbor, made contact, and then—and then—ah, finally—”

source.japanese: がっと首とほぼ垂直に反らした顔は双眸は、この薄汚れた倉庫の天上を貫き通して遙かな天の高みを仰いでいるかのよう、伸びあがった長三和音の雄叫びに耳を塞いだのはなぜか朔屋のみ、まあ手下は雇用主への義理もあろうし、クロは生憎両手が使えない。
source.english: He flung his face back almost perpendicular to his neck, his eyes seeming to pierce the dingy warehouse ceiling and gaze into the far heights of heaven. For some reason Sakuya alone covered his ears against the long, major-chord howl. The henchmen, after all, had duties to their employer, and Kuro unfortunately had no use of either hand.

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「さあどうしてあげようかクロくん。
　まあまずは屋敷に戻ってお着替えだね。
　でも君には余計な衣装はごてごてと邪魔なだけ。素敵なネックレスとガーターベルトとブレスレットとアンクレットはもう用意してあるんだ。とりあえずはそれだけ身につけてくれたまへ」
source.english:
“Now, what to do with you, Kuro?
First things first—let’s head back to the mansion so you can change.
But all those extra outfits would just be a cluttered nuisance for you. I’ve already prepared a lovely necklace, a garter belt, a bracelet, and an anklet. For now, just wear those.”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「ちなみに番線カッターの刃も通らず、ガストーチでも溶かせない程に丈夫な逸品だから」
source.english: “By the way, it’s a masterpiece so durable that even a wire cutter can’t cut through it, and a gas torch can’t melt it.”

source.japanese: 男はこれだけの台詞を流暢に並べたのではなく、句読点のように「アヲッ」「アヲッ」と、奇声を挟みながらで。片手を後頭部に当て、片手はズボンに股間に被せて前後に腰をひこひこと振りたくる様、目も当てられないながらも、下半身と裏腹に上半身は芯でも通したように完全に静止していたのはある種美事と言って、いいのやらどうなのやら。
source.english: The man didn’t deliver all these lines fluently; instead, he interspersed them with strange cries of “Awo!” and “Awo!” like punctuation marks. One hand braced the back of his head, the other pressed over his crotch, and his hips bucked in jerky thrusts—a sight too gruesome to watch. Yet his upper body stayed absolutely still, as if fixed on a central axis. It was hard to say whether to call that an impressive feat.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「それは首輪と貞操帯と手錠と足枷だったりしないかあんた」
source.english: “Aren’t those a collar, a chastity belt, handcuffs, and leg irons, maybe?”

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「……そうとも言う。言葉の意味を正しく解釈したのは意外な慧眼、敬意を表するが、やはり庶民は言葉を選ぶという事を知らないのが駄目だな、この俗物が」
source.english: “…So one might say. Your unexpected acuity in discerning the true meaning of my words deserves respect. Still, commoners never understand the importance of choosing one's language. Philistine.”

source.japanese: 豚を去勢する苛烈さで言い切られて朔屋、喉がひりつく心地して、とりあえず一杯のジョッキがたまらなく恋しい、軋むほどに冷やしてなみなみ注いだウォトカのだ。それくらい強烈な奴でなければ、この悪心地を払えるものか。とりあえずこめかみを揉みほぐす朔屋になおも演説は降り注ぐ……。
source.english: Sakuya, confronted with a statement delivered with the same ferocity as castrating a pig, felt a stinging sensation in his throat. For the moment, he craved nothing more than a full mug—one filled to the brim with vodka, chilled until it creaked. Only something that strong could wash away this nausea. As Sakuya rubbed his temples to ease the tension, the lecture continued to pour down on him……

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「クロ、僕の屋敷では、甘い、最高級の桃が君の主食となる。
　それ以外の生臭物は禁止だから。体が濁る。
　毎日桃や果実を食べさせて、体から良い匂いがしてきたら、頃合いだ」

【金持ち】
「君のおしっこを呑ませてもらう。
　そのちっちゃいあそこに直接口を着けてね。
　どんなに美味なのか、思うだけで今から涎が。あっと失礼」
source.english:
“I’ll have the pleasure of drinking your pee.
I’ll put my mouth right on that tiny little spot of yours.
Just thinking about how delicious it’ll be is making me drool already. Oops, my apologies.”
“Eh… eh…?”

source.japanese: 啜りあげた音は、獲物の腸を貪る肉食獣の舌なめずりよりも肉質で卑猥で不快で、朔屋は総身粟立つを禁じなかったくらいであるが、クロは今ひとつ実感に欠けるようで、きょとんと傾げた首の、或いはその無知こそが彼女の天恵なのかも知れない。なにしろそれは桃娘々、大陸の古い時代では長寿と精力増強として知る人ぞ知る人丹法、ただし囲えるのは限られた富裕層のみ、娘々として養成された少女も余生短く、ほとんどが糖尿病で悶死するという。
source.english:
The obscene slurp was fleshier and more repellent than a carnivore licking its chops over its prey's entrails; Sakuya could not keep his whole body from crawling. Kuro, however, seemed unable to grasp what the man meant. She merely cocked her head—and perhaps that ignorance was a blessing granted her by heaven.
This was the art of the ‘peach maiden,’ an obscure human-elixir regimen known in ancient times on the continent as a means to long life and renewed virility. Only a narrow stratum of the rich could afford to keep one. Nor did the girls raised as peach maidens live long thereafter: most, it was said, died in diabetic agony.

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「お薬だってあげよう。ちょっとちくりとするが、一本だけで天国にイける効き目あらたかなお薬だ。
　二本・三本打つとイッたきり戻ってこられなくなって、あうあうあーと成り果てるが、クロくんはもともとおつむが可哀相な子だから、大した差はないだろう」
source.english:
“I’ll even give you some medicine. It’ll sting a little, but it’s a potent remedy—just one shot and you’ll go straight to heaven.
If you get two or three shots, you’ll go and never come back, ending up babbling ‘Uh, uh, aaah’—but since Kuro’s brain is already a bit of a mess, it probably won’t make much difference.”

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「クロ、これ以上馬鹿になるのはやだよぅっ」
source.english: “I don’t wanna get any stupider than this!”

source.japanese: さすがのクロも段々に男の狂が肌からじわじわ沁みてきて頭を振って身を遠ざけようと、しても棒に縛りつけられてでは限りがあり、乳白の髪を一筋、掬いとられるのに拒[こば]む術持たない。男は手に滑らせた白く緩やかに波うつのを、指に巻きつけて、しごいて、しごいて、何度も扱き上げては下ろして、その度に恍惚の笑みが深まり舌がそよめく、明らかに白髪巻きつけた指は代替物、男の脳内では逸物に巻きつけて自慰する酔い心地なのは明らかだ。
source.english: Even Kuro gradually felt the man's madness seeping through her skin. She shook her head and tried to draw away, but bound to the pole she could move only so far and had no way to stop him lifting one strand of her milky-white hair. He let the softly waving strand slide through his hand, wound it around a finger, and stroked it up and down, over and over. Each pass deepened his ecstatic smile and set his tongue aquiver. The finger wrapped in white hair was plainly a surrogate: in his mind he had wound it around his member and was pleasuring himself with it.

source.japanese:
【金持ち】
「ああ、おお……。

target.text: 【Kuro】 「Hii!」

With a voice fiercer than a crustacean's shell-crushing hammer, when the man suddenly leapt, body contorting, arm swung in a wide arc to point right at Sakuya, it was jarring enough for him, but after being struck by such a loud noise at point-blank range, Kuro had quietly let a few drops leak, and had he noticed that, the man would surely have jumped up for joy in even greater rapture.

【Rich guy】 「I won't find another specimen as outstanding as her, you know!? I was a boy who dearly loved 『A Little Princess』and 『Les Miserables』. But what I liked was not the part where the female protagonists were saved right at the very end.」

【Rich guy】 「On the contrary, the moment they were saved, I would tear the book apart and throw it away. I was spellbound by the way those girls would fall to ruin, be reduced to poverty, be tormented and thoroughly abused.」
【Rich guy】 「No, perhaps I should say aroused. My sexual awakening was derived from the tragedies that befell those girls, yes───and yet.」

【Rich guy】 「Why? Why did they have to be saved in the end? A girl still undeveloped in mind and body, oppressed and writhing in pain and gasping and panting and struggling and trying to claw her way up, but for all her efforts, in the end, it would amount to absolutely nothing as she remained fallen, ruined, defiled; what's so wrong with that!?」
【Rich guy】 「And that is why───I made a vow. A vow to who? To myself. I would get my hands on those girls, that I swore to myself.」

Those were likely the earnest feelings from his boyhood. Words of desire, a vow that he had dedicated the soul burning away within his chest to. One night, a mother asked her son something. He was her own flesh and blood, birthed into this world by her through agonizing pain, as if her very body were being rent asunder, and yet he remained a boy, a creature whose fundamental nature she could never truly comprehend; to him, she posed a question. ───I wonder. Why is it that boys always want to fling open the windows so wide───
The boy answered his mother, a woman quiet and reserved, yet always possessed of a core of supple steel, in this way, for it was the only answer he could give in return:

───Because my blood runs hot─── The heat of his blood, the vow of his soul, it tempered, honed, and pared him down through his youth, hammering the boy into manhood. Though the heat in his blood was the temperature of the gases stagnating at the bottom of a poison swamp. Though his soul had rotted to a hue so putrid that peering into the muck of a gutter would seem preferable.
【Rich guy】 「And that's why the girl I'm getting my hands on has to be as pitiful a girl as this one. Thoroughly useless and broken, and a bit of a rarity at that.」

【Rich guy】 「And in that sense, this little albino is just perfect, isn't she? I've been after her ever since I first heard the rumours. When I happened to catch sight of her while you were staying at this port once before, I was so overcome with emotion that I fainted.」
【Rich guy】 「Ever since then, I've always been after her. I used everything at my disposal to summon that dilapidated ship to this port, then got in touch with them, and now. Aaaah, at long last───」

With a sudden twist of his neck, his face was now almost perpendicular, and the twin orbs seated within it seemed to pierce through the ceiling of this grimy warehouse, peering into the distant divine above, and for whatever reason, Sakuya alone shielded his ears from the roar of the ascending major triad resounding from his throat; well, his henchmen probably felt a sense of duty to their employer, and Kuro could, unfortunately, not use either of her hands right now.

【Rich guy】 「Now then, whatever shall I do with you, Kuro-kun? Well, first, we will return to my mansion and have you change into a new set of clothes. But too many layers would serve as nothing but a tawdry distraction on you. I've already prepared a most wonderful necklace and garter belt, as well as a pair of bracelets and anklets. You shall wear only those for now.」
【Rich guy】 「Incidentally, these masterpieces are of such sturdy make that they will neither be sliced through by the blade of a wire cutter, nor melted by the flame of a gas torch.」

The man did not just fluently declaim these utterances one after the other, no, he inserted little howls of "awooh, awooh" in a queer voice in the gaps between them like he were adding little punctuation marks. With one hand on the back of his head, the other covering the crotch of his suit trousers, he jerked his hips back and forth with violent thrusts, and while it was unbearable to look at, in stark contrast to his lower body, his upper body remained dead still as though an iron rod had been driven through it; it was a feat of such strange grace that one could well call it admirable, in a sense, for lack of a better word.
【Naomasa】 「Hey, isn't that just a collar, a chastity belt, and a pair of handcuffs and ankle cuffs?」

【Rich guy】 「……One could put it like that, yes. You possess a surprisingly keen eye to correctly interpret the meaning of those words; to that, I extend my respect, but it truly is a great shame that commoners know nothing of choosing their words, you lowly philistine.」

Cut down with the brutal finality of gelding a pig, Sakuya felt his throat sting; in this moment, he felt an aching longing for a mug, one filled to the lip with vodka chilled so deeply the mug creaked. Could he ever hope to rid himself of this unpleasant feeling without something that strong? At any rate, while Sakuya massaged his temples, yet more grand speeches rained incessantly upon him…….

【Rich guy】 「Kuro, in my mansion, only sweetness for you, the finest of peaches shall be your staple food. For any other fetid flesh is forbidden. It stains the body with impurity. You will be made to eat peaches and other fruits every day, and when a nice smell wafts from your body, that is when it shall begin.」

【Rich guy】 「I shall be drinking your pee. I shall place my mouth directly on your tiny nether lips. How delicious a treat it shall be, just pondering it makes my drool run rivers. Aah, how rude of me.」
【Kuro】 「Eh……eh……?」

The sound of his loud slurping was far more meaty, vulgar, and unpleasant than even a carnivore licking its lips while it devoured the innards of its prey, so bad was it that Sakuya could not keep the gooseflesh from spreading all over his body, but it seemed to be lacking in realness to Kuro, for she only looked blankly at him with her head at an angle; perhaps that very ignorance might have been a divine blessing bestowed on her by the heavens.

For you see, he spoke of Tao Niang, the peach girls, a type of Dan Fa from ancient times in mainland China, well-known to but a few connoisseurs, that would bring long life and strengthen one's vitality, but keeping peach girls was a privilege enjoyed by only a select few among the wealthiest. (TN: Dan Fa, written "丹法" is an esoteric sort of Chinese alchemy, one that evolved from the external (like the infamous ingestion of mercury during the Tang Dynasty) to the internal. The ultimate goal is creating an elixir of immortality, and the peach is the ultimate symbol of that in Chinese folklore. These peach girls are an urban legend stemming from around 700 BC.)
The peach girls cultivated in such a way had only a scant few years to live, and it is said that most of them died in agony from diabetes.

【Rich guy】 「I'll even give you some medicine. It'll prick a little, but it has a truly miraculous effect. Why, but one injection and you shall ascend to the heavens. After two or three shots, you'll cum so hard that you'll never come back, reduced to nothing but moaning, "aah, aah, aaah", but Kuro-kun, your brain has always been in a sorry state, so it probably won't make much of a difference.」

By now, even Kuro had gradually come to feel the madness oozing out from the pores of this man's skin; she shook her head and tried to shrink away from him, but she could only get so far while still tied to the rod, and so the girl possessed no means to resist when a single strand of her milky-white hair was scooped up in his hand.

The man let his fingers glide through the gently rippling waves of white, wrapped them around his finger, stroked, stroked, how he stroked them up and down, again and again, and with each stroke, his enraptured smile grew deeper, his tongue fluttered, the finger wrapped in her hair very clearly a substitute for something else; it was obvious that, in the man's mind, he was experiencing the intoxicating sensation of wrapping it around his penis and masturbating.

【Rich guy】 「Aaah, oooh……. Ah, not to forget, about that medicine. That it does not leave behind any unsightly scars when injected into the underside of your tongue is good and all, but I really must insist that I inject just one dose into your nipple……no, directly into your clitoris……but the shock may be quite severe, but then again, that in itself has a certain charm……oh, what to do, what to do……」
【Rich guy】 「And I have also arranged for some friends for you after that. Your figure is so white and slender, so to form a matching pair, I had to find some black and well-fed───swine. Andalusian.」

【Rich guy】 「And I simply must insist that you take the opportunity to deepen your connection as bosom friends. Aah, on that note, I wonder if you are aware of this, Kuro-kun? Of the fact that a pig's genitals are drill-shaped. They wrench open the entrance to the womb and slither inside. It seems to be an excruciatingly painful experience for a woman yet to experience childbirth.」

【Rich guy】 「What's more, the volume of their ejaculation is incredible, and finally, the semen turns gelatinous, forming a copulatory plug within your vagina, sealing it shut, and your stomach will swell up, distend like a frog's. Now that is a true black and white show.」 (TN: The term black and white show, written "白黒ショー", is Japanese slang for a strip show featuring actual sex between a male and a female actor on stage.)

But he'd be sure to scrape it all out for her, he claimed with a dazzlingly bright and perfectly serene smile, standing in front of Kuro with the index and middle fingers of both his hands stuck out like hooks, raking back and forth through the air.

But though his smile certainly was cheerful, the very picture of serenity, the way he manipulated his fingers was more sinister than even the calculated ministrations of a virtuoso libertine attempting to wring out a squirting orgasm from an innocent girl with a callous hand, that was the true terror, and for Kuro, it must have been an entirely unprecedented stimulus, or rather, a form of torture, for the man's smile alone was enough to cause a wave to rise up to her throat.

But she had already emptied her stomach. He was so desperately trying to convince himself that this must be Sugamo Asylum, or else the open ward at Kyushu Imperial University's psychiatric hospital, that he had no thought to spare for Kuro. Such a madman could not possibly be roaming free; therefore this warehouse was an asylum. He repeated it to himself like a spell—only to realize that he was standing face-to-face with the lunatic, with not so much as a barred door between them. His nausea worsened, and his knees went loose.
His legs trembling beneath him, he nevertheless had to confront this unhinged reality. With a courage rare in him, he denounced—

　……なにが心強い、こういうのは容赦なしというのだと、翳した手に握られた、黒くて硬くて底光りする鉄塊に、警鐘を乱打する警戒本能は、主と同じくぼんくらそのもの、硬い、冷たい、そして致命的な銃口を額に胸に擬されてから危機を告げたところでなんになる、もっと前に逃げろと告げるべき。

In sheer mortification his face went slack and his knees began to fold—until one of the white-suited man's henchmen raised a hand to stop him. How reassuring.
…Reassuring, hell. The word was merciless. The raised hand held a black, hard, dull-gleaming lump of iron. Sakuya's instincts began hammering alarm, but they were every bit as dim-witted as their master. What use was a warning only after cold, hard, lethal muzzles had leveled themselves at brow and chest? They ought to have told him to run much sooner.
