What was supposed to be so affable about this? The smile of this man calling himself Kijima immediately showed its true colours, the wickedness lurking in his heart brazenly exposed for all the world to see.
【Kijima】 「And there, Sakuya-san happened to incur a bit of a debt. To me, that is. I've already taken what he had on his person to cover as much of it as I could, but.」
【Kijima】 「Well, sending him out into the street stark naked would be a little pitiful, you see, and so I graciously offered to let him keep his very last piece of clothing.」
【Naomasa】 「……But come ooon. That stuff you pulled, any way you slice it, that had to be cheating.」
【Kijima】 「You wound me. It's very rude to speak of another as though they are a common swindler, good sir. ……Well, I suppose I did allow myself to make a little use of what they call "gamesmanship".」

source.japanese: 朔屋の冴えないぼやきは鬼島の冷笑と、
source.english: Sakuya's dispirited grumbling met Onijima's sneer—

target.text: After Sakuya's sullen complaining was met with Kijima's derisive sneer,

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「それでも君がそんな姿でここにいるという事は、ゲームの途中で見抜けなかった───そういう事でしょう。それじゃあ仕方ない」
source.english: “Even so, your standing here in that state means you failed to detect it during the game. In that case, nothing can be done.”

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「And that you nevertheless stand here in such an immodest outfit means that you never saw through the trick while playing the game─── I suppose that would be the whole of things. If so, then there is little to be done here.」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「まあ、直さんが引き際を見誤ったと、それだけの事でしょうね」
source.english: “Well, Nao simply didn't know when to quit. That's all.”

source.japanese: 機関長と泪のすげない台詞で切って捨てられた。朔屋としても途中まではいい調子で勝っていたところを後から巻き返されて頭に血が上り、負け分を取り替えさんとして泥沼に嵌[はま]ってしまったのは事実であるだけに、なにも言い返せなくなる。
source.english: —And was cut down by the engineer's and Rui's cold remarks. Sakuya had indeed been winning nicely at first, only to be overtaken. He lost his temper, tried to recover his losses, and sank into the mire. There was nothing he could say in reply.

target.text: 【Rui】 「Well, Nao-san misjudged his moment to retreat. I suppose that is indeed the whole of things here.」

Cut down and thrown to the wolves by the cold words of the Chief Engineer and Rui. Even from Sakuya's perspective, he had to admit it: while he had been on a nice winning streak until partway through, when the tables were turned, the blood rushing to his head made him lose his cool, and later, in an attempt to break even by recouping what he had already lost, he had only dug a deeper hole for himself; that was, in fact, true, and so he had no retorts to offer.

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「それで、朔屋君のみじめな現状はまあ置くとして、君はなぜわざわざこの船までやってきたのですか？」
source.english: “Now, setting Mr. Sakuya's wretched condition aside, why have you come all the way to this ship?”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「……そこんところだよ、狡っ辛いのは」
source.english: “…That's the sneaky part.”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「泪さん、このおっさんの目当ては俺じゃなく、そもそもあなただったんだ」
source.english: “Rui, this old fellow wasn't after me. He wanted you all along.”

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「So then, setting aside the disgraceful present state of Sakuya for a moment, why did you then go to the trouble of coming all the way aboard this ship?」
【Naomasa】 「……That's exactly it, that's where this guy's being real sly.」
【Naomasa】 「Rui-san, this old man was never after me. You were in his sights right from the start.」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「わたくし？」
source.english: “Me?”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「まあ打ち明ければそういう事になりますな。
　御婦人、彩久津泪さん。
　あんたのその姓は旧姓ですね？」
source.english:
“Well, to be frank,
that's how it is. Madam—Rui Irokuzu.
That's your maiden name, isn't it?”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「かつては鳴宮姓を名乗っておられた……間違いはないはずだが」
source.english: “You used to go by Narumiya… No mistake about that.”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「───はて。どうだったかしら」
source.english: “—Well. Did I?”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「とぼけて無駄だぜ、泪さん。鳴宮照信……旦那の名前を忘れちゃいまい」
source.english: “No use playing innocent. You haven't forgotten your husband's name. Terunobu Narumiya.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「Me?」
【Kijima】 「Well, if I must confess, then that is what it comes down to. Madam, Irokudzu Rui-san. That last name of yours would be your maiden name, correct?」
【Kijima】 「Formerly, you went by the last name Narumiya……I do not believe that I am mistaken here.」
【Rui】 「───Well now. I do wonder if I ever went by such a name.」
【Kijima】 「No point playing dumb, Rui-san. Narumiya Terunobu……don't go forgetting your husband's name.」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「ええと……そんな方も、いらしたような？」
source.english: “Um… There may have been someone like that?”

source.japanese: 泪は小首を傾げて遠い目を、記憶を底から総ざらえにして、なおも掬[すく]いきれないように、恐らく彼女は本気で忘れているのだ。何番目の夫かは知らぬが、話によると婚姻を結んだ男の数十指に余ると言われるほどの泪である。そのうちの一人一人を細かく覚えていなかったとしても、泪なら有り得る話だ。
source.english: Rui tilted her head and looked into the distance, as though dredging her memory from the bottom and still failing to scoop it all up. She had probably genuinely forgotten. Which husband he had been, Sakuya did not know. Rui was said to have married more men than she had fingers. For her, failing to remember every one in detail was entirely possible.

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「……本気で忘れてんのか。
　ひどい女だなあんた。
　まああんたが覚えていようがいまいが、
　借金は消えないんだよ。
　証文だって残ってるんだ」
source.english:
“…You really have forgotten?
You're an awful woman.
But remembered or not,
a debt doesn't disappear.
I've still got the written acknowledgment.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「Humm……I think there might have been a man like that?」

Rui tilted her head with a distant look in her eyes, reviewing her memory from to bottom; that she still didn't seem to be able to find anything meant that she probably had genuinely forgotten. It wasn't clear what number of husband he'd been to her, but this was Rui, who was said to have been bound through holy matrimony with too many men to count with one's fingers, at least according to what he'd heard. To not remember the details of each and every single one among their number certainly was possible when it came to Rui.
【Kijima】 「……Did you seriously forget? You're a terrible woman, lady. Well, whether you remember or not, the debt ain't going anywhere. I've even got the paperwork for it.」

source.japanese:
横柄な口調を徐々に露わにして、鬼島はボストンバッグから一葉の書類を取りだして、泪に突きつける。朔屋の側からは内容は見てとれなかったけれど、鬼島の話からするとかなりの金額がそこに記されているはずだった。
　この男はそもそも、泪の何番目かの夫がこさえていた債権を取り立てるために、彼女を追いかけていたのだとか。
source.english:
Growing steadily more overbearing, Onijima took a document from his travel bag and thrust it at Rui. Sakuya could not read it from where he stood, but judging by the man's account, the figure written upon it must have been considerable.
Onijima had apparently been pursuing her to collect a debt incurred by one of her husbands.

source.japanese: それが数日前、泪が港町の酒場に現れ、朔屋と一緒に信天翁号に乗りこんでいったのを目にした。その翌日に船は出港してしまったけれど、鬼島は独自のつてを辿って、信天翁号の次なる寄港地を探り当て、網を張っていたところに朔屋がのこのこやってきたと、そういう次第らしい。
source.english: Several days earlier, he had seen Rui appear in a port-town tavern and board the Albatross with Sakuya. The ship departed the following day. Through connections of his own, however, Onijima discovered her next port of call and laid his net. Into it Sakuya had come strolling. That, apparently, was the story.

source.japanese:
朔屋としては何度目かの脱走を試みて、酒場に逃げこんで、そこでこの鬼島と出会ってしまった我が身を呪わずにはいられない。巧妙にギャンブルを持ちかけられ、カモられ、イカサマも見抜けず猿股一丁まで剥がれて、でも到底負け分にはおっつかない。それで、信天翁号まで戻って、不足分は朔屋の雇い主、すなわち信天翁号の面々から支払わされる事となった。
　脱走も失敗し、せっかく逃げ出した船へと泣く泣く逆戻りすることになったばかりか、泪の元に招かざる客まで伴ってきたとあっては、朔屋は馬鹿を通り越して有害ですらある。
source.english:
Sakuya could only curse himself. Attempting yet another desertion, he had escaped into a tavern and met this Onijima. Cleverly coaxed into gambling and taken for a sucker, he failed to spot the cheating and was stripped down to his undershorts. Even that came nowhere near covering his losses. So he had to return to the Albatross, where his employers—the Albatross crew—were to pay the remainder.
Not only had his desertion failed, forcing him tearfully back to the ship he had finally escaped; he had also brought an unwelcome visitor to Rui. Sakuya was worse than a fool. He was a liability.

source.japanese: 機関室の弱く赤味を帯びた光の中でつくづく書類を眺めて泪は、それでも遠い目、さしたる興味を抱いた様子はない。
source.english: Rui studied the document in the engine room's weak reddish light. Her eyes remained distant. She showed little interest.

target.text: He gradually laid bare his arrogant manner of speech, and Kijima pulled out a single document from his boston bag, thrusting it at Rui. Sakuya couldn't read the contents from where he stood, but based on how Kijima was talking, it must have been a sizable amount written on that paper. So, had this man, from the very start, been pursuing this woman, all to enforce a claim on the debt that Rui's whatever'th husband had previously racked up?

A few days ago, he had witnessed Rui show up at a bar in a port town, and he had also seen her boarding the Albatross together with Sakuya afterwards. The next day, the ship had left port, but through his personal connections, Kijima sniffed out which port the Albatross would make call at next, and by the time he was setting up his net to capture his target, who should come nonchalantly strolling by but Sakuya; that was supposedly how things went.

From Sakuya's point of view, that he had tried to make his grand escape for the nth time, sought refuge in a bar, and then happened to run into Kijima there was something he only had himself to curse for. He'd been shrewdly approached with a gamble, played like a fiddle, and unable to see through the swindle, he'd then been stripped to his drawers, but that was certainly not fit to serve as compensation for what he owed. Thus, they'd returned to the Albatross with the outstanding amount supposed to be paid off by his employer, in other words, the crew of the Albatross.

His attempt at escape had failed too, for not only did he end up running back in tears to the ship he'd finally gotten away from, he'd even brought with him an unwelcome guest right into Rui's lap; Sakuya had transcended the merely idiotic and even become actively harmful.
Bathed in the faintly red tinge of the engine room's light, Rui stared intently at the document, but it was with a distant look in her eyes, and she didn't seem to care about it in the slightest.

source.japanese:
【泪】
「見せていただいてもね。やっぱりわたくしには覚えにない事だし、遺産の管理は公証人に任せてあります」
source.english: “Showing me that hardly helps. I still know nothing about it. Management of the estate is in the notary's hands.”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「不服がお有りなら、まずはそちらに申し立てては如何」
source.english: “If you have a grievance, why not take it there first?”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「まあつれねえ事を言うな。
　あまりあんたが言うことを聞かないと、
　この坊主がどうなるか判らないぜ？」
source.english:
“Don't be so cold.
Refuse to listen,
and there's no knowing what'll happen to this boy.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「You've certainly shown me as much. But as I surmised, this is something I hold no recollection of, and his estate is being managed by the executor.」
【Rui】 「If you have any objections, then why don't you consider filing a complaint with them first?」
【Kijima】 「Come now, don't be so cold. If you don't want to listen to what I'm saying, I can't guarantee what'll happen to the kid here, yeah?」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「───お好きなように」
source.english: “—As you please.”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「えええ!?　そんな殺生な、泪さん！」
source.english: “What!? That's cruel, Rui!”

target.text: 【Rui】 「───Do as you see fit.」
【Naomasa】 「EEEEH!? Rui-san, have a heart!」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「お黙りなさい。
　貴方も大人の殿方なのだから、
　ご自分の始末位ご自分でおつけなさい」
source.english:
“Be quiet.
You're a grown man.
At least settle your own affairs.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「Be quiet. You are an adult gentleman, dear, and so you must clean up your own messes, at the very least.」

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「同感だね。この人は別に朔屋君の保護者でもなんでもないのだから」
source.english: “Agreed. She is not Mr. Sakuya's guardian, after all.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「……いいのかそれで本当に。
　この小僧が間抜けな死に面晒して、
　港の海にぽっかり浮かんだとあっちゃ、
　いくらあんたでも、
　寝覚めは悪いと思うんだがな」
source.english:
“…You truly don't mind?
If this boy turns up floating dead in the harbor with that stupid look on his face,
even you might lose some sleep.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「見たところ、あんたの着けている宝石だけでも鳴宮氏の借金分には足りそうだ」
source.english: “From the looks of it, the stones you're wearing alone would cover Mr. Narumiya's debt.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「あんたにとっちゃその程度の借金が、この小僧の命取りになるってわけだが、それで本当に構わないんだな？」
source.english: “A debt that small to you could kill this boy. You really don't mind?”

source.japanese:
鬼島の恫喝はまこと古典的な、芸もなにもない物ではあったが、朔屋を震え上がらせるには充分用は足り、顔ばかりが全身青ざめさせて、今にも失禁そして失神とやりかねない塩梅である。
　そんな朔屋をさすがに哀れと思し召したのか、
source.english:
The intimidation was classic and entirely artless. It nevertheless served perfectly well to terrify Sakuya. Not merely his face but his whole body went pale. He looked ready to wet himself and then pass out.
Perhaps Rui finally took pity on him—

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「I share the sentiment. For you see, she is not Sakuya-kun's guardian, patron, or anything of the sort.」
【Kijima】 「……Are you sure that's fine? If this kid ends up bobbing in the harbour, gormless look on his stiff mug, I'd imagine even guys like you'd have a hard time sleeping at night.」
【Kijima】 「From a glance, just that jewel you're wearing right now looks like it should be enough to pay off Mr. Narumiya's debt in full.」
【Kijima】 「What amounts to such a trifling debt for someone like you is gonna cost this kid his life, so are you still telling me you really don't care about that?」

Kijima's threats were a truly classic, artless thing to behold, but it was plenty to make Sakuya shudder, with not just his face, but his entire body turning pale, left in such a state that he might well piss himself or even faint any second now. As one might expect, perhaps they did finally feel some pity for Sakuya,

source.japanese:
【泪】
「じゃあそれこそ、カードで勝負しましょう」
source.english: “Then let's settle it at cards.”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「私が負ければ、その人とわたくしの債権は、諦めて全て払いましょう」
source.english: “If I lose, I'll resign myself to paying both his debt and mine in full.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「待ちな。もし姉さんが勝ったらどうするつもりだ。
　ちょっとでもあんたに有利な条件なら、そもそもあたしはこんな勝負をする意味がない」
source.english:
“Hold on, lady. What if you win?
If the terms favor you in the slightest, I've got no reason to play.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「Well then, a game of cards seems like just the thing to settle the matter with.」
【Rui】 「Let us say that, should I lose, then whatever it is you claim he and I owe you, I shall resign myself to paying in full.」

【Kijima】 「Hold it right there. What are you planning if you happen to win, lady? If there are any kind of beneficial conditions in this for you, then it's not like taking you up on this game ever had anything in it for me.」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「細かい方ね。わたくしが勝ったとしても、夫の債権分は払います。ただ……直さんに服だけは返して差し上げて」
source.english: “How particular you are. Even if I win, I'll pay my husband's debt. Only… Give Nao his clothes back.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「A fastidious man I see. Even should I win, I will still pay the debt my husband owes you. However……you will return to Nao-san his clothing.」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「そんな下着一つでうろうろされては、わたくしには目の毒だし……残りの負け分のとりたては、ご自由にどうぞ」
source.english: “Having him roam about in nothing but his underwear is rather too much for my eyes… As for collecting the remainder of his losses, do as you please.”

source.japanese:
どう転んでも、鬼島には不利にならない条件である。鬼島にとっては朔屋など、泪を追求する為の餌でしかなかったわけであるのだし。
　それに鬼島も自分のカード捌[さば]きに自信があったのだろう。
source.english:
Whichever way it went, Onijima would not lose. To him, Sakuya had never been more than bait with which to pursue Rui.
Besides, Onijima must have been confident in his skill with cards.

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「ま、そういう事であるんなら。
　そちらは……機関長ですな？
　あんたが立ち合いになって下さいな」
source.english:
“Well, on those terms.
You there… You're the chief engineer?
Be our witness.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「おっと、同じ船の仲間だからって、
　最後に話の蒸し返しはなしにしたい。
　今の条件、念書にしたためますんで、
　それで構いませんな？」
source.english:
“And no reopening the matter
afterward because you're shipmates.
I'll write down those terms.
No objections?”

target.text: 【Rui】 「If he is made to aimlessly loiter about here in but a pair of underpants, it makes far too tempting a sight for my poor, sore eyes…… as for any other losses you already collected on, do as you see fit.」

No matter how things played out, those were conditions that couldn't turn unfavourable for Kijima. From Kijima's perspective, Sakuya had also been nothing more than bait used in his pursuit of Rui. And Kijima must surely have had some confidence in his own card-playing skills.
【Kijima】 「Well, if that's how it's gonna be, then. You there…… the Chief Engineer, right? You'll be our witness, yeah?」

【Kijima】 「Hold on, since you're from the same ship and all, I'd like to make sure that you won't just reconsider when all's said and done. These conditions here, I'll have them recorded as a written pledge. No objections there, right?」

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「私はそれで構わないよ」
source.english: “None from me.”

source.japanese: 事の成り行きにはらはらしながらも、朔屋が見守るうちに念書は認められ、泪の署名と拇印も捺され、かくして朔屋の身柄を賭けたゲームが開始せらるる事と相成った。
source.english: Sakuya watched anxiously as the agreement was written, then signed and thumbprinted by Rui. Thus a game with Sakuya himself at stake began.

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「I have no objections.」

Though he was anxious about how this would all unfold, while Sakuya closely observed the whole thing, the written agreement was drawn up, Rui's signature and thumbprint was added, and thus, the game where the very fate of Sakuya's person itself was at stake hath commenced.

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「ああそれと鬼島君、私は、機関室であまりだらしない格好というのは好まない。
　……ああいや、君の事じゃあない。
　朔屋君だ。この室温では下着一つでも差し支えないとはいえ、いささか露骨に過ぎる」
source.english:
“Oh, one more thing, Mr. Onijima. I dislike excessively slovenly attire in the engine room.
No, I don't mean you. Mr. Sakuya.
In this temperature, underwear alone may be comfortable, but it is rather too revealing.”

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「Oh, one thing if I may, Kijima-kun. I am not very fond of having someone dressed so slovenly in my engine room. ……Aah, no no, I speak not of you. It is Sakuya-kun. While wearing but a pair of underwear in the temperature of this room would hardly be an impediment, it is rather too exposed.」

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「幸い船員服の予備がある───といっても上着と襯衣だけだが。着てもらっても構わないかね？」
source.english: “Fortunately, there is a spare uniform—though only a jacket and shirt. May he put them on?”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「……あんた、俺が知ってる、こういう機関室働きの人間とはどうにも勝手が違うな。
　ま、別にいいよ。俺かて好きこのんで男の裸を見たいって訳じゃない」
source.english:
“…You're a different sort from the engine-room workers I know. Well, go ahead.
I don't particularly want to look at a naked man either.”

source.japanese:
鬼島自身、朔屋を裸に剥いたのも枝葉末節で、寛容というより無関心に着用を許す、許したところで青年の下半身は猿股一つの相変わらず。
　もそもそと着こんでは見たものの、上だけ着衣下は猿股姿というのはどうにもアンバランスでかえってみっともない。鬼島はさておくとして機関長と泪の二人を並べてみると、機関室の燃焼の匂いも重低音も二人の曰くありげな佇まいに背景の暗がりで鎮まって、どこかヴィクトリア朝の典雅さえ帯びてくる。
　その中で朔屋は、往来を猿股一丁で歩いていた時より酷い晒し者にされているような気がしてならなかったけれど、そんな羞恥心などすぐに勝負の緊迫感に駆逐される事になる。
source.english:
Stripping Sakuya had been incidental for Onijima, too. He permitted the clothes with indifference rather than generosity. Yet the young man's lower half remained in undershorts.
He fumbled into the jacket and shirt, but with clothes on his upper half and only undershorts below, the mismatch made him look even more ridiculous. Set Onijima aside, and the engineer and Rui, together, lent even the engine room something of Victorian elegance. The smell of combustion and the deep rumbling subsided into the background darkness around their enigmatic bearing.
Amid it, Sakuya felt more exposed than when he had walked the streets in his underwear alone. That embarrassment, however, would soon be driven away by the game's tension.

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「Fortunately, we do have spare crew uniforms───though with that said, it is but a shirt and jacket. You don't mind letting him wear that much, yes?」
【Kijima】 「……You're a far cry from the stokers I usually see working the engines. Well, can't say I care. It's not like I look at naked men because I like to.」

Kijima himself considered Sakuya being stripped to be a trivial detail, and he permitted him to put clothes on less out of magnanimity and more lack of care, but even with this permittance, the young man's lower body was still covered by nothing but a sarumata.

Though he fumbled his way into several extra layers, to only wear something on his top while clad in a sarumata below cut a figure so imbalanced that it conversely looked even more pathetic. Kijima notwithstanding, when you see the Chief Engineer and Rui standing side by side, the engine room's smell of combustion and heavy thrum seems to subside into the darkness behind their suggestively mysterious presence, lending the whole scene a touch of Victorian elegance.

And standing amidst all that, it wasn't that Sakuya didn't manage to feel like an even worse exhibitionist compared to the time he was walking around in but his sarumata, but any such feelings of shame were quickly eradicated by the tension of the game about to unfold.

source.japanese: 機関室片隅の、備え付けの椅子と卓でのカードゲーム、立ち合いは機関長、勝負人は信天翁号の女客と彼女を追ってきた取り立て人と。
source.english: Cards at the table and chairs in a corner of the engine room. The engineer witnessing. The ship's lady passenger playing against the collector who had pursued her.

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「ところでどんなゲームにするかだが、
　ポーカーでよろしいな？」
source.english:
“Now, as for the game—
poker will suit you?”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「ご自由に。それでよくってよ」
source.english: “As you please. That will do.”

source.japanese: 大して興味もなさげに承諾して、朔屋に目線を向ける。
source.english: She agreed without much apparent interest, then looked toward Sakuya.

source.japanese:
【泪】
「ああそれから直さん、あなた、このゲームには口出しをしてはだめよ」
source.english: “And Nao: you must not interfere with this game.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「そうそう。お前さんがなにか言おうものなら、このゲームはそこで御破算にするぜ。
　大人しくそこで見てな───って」
source.english:
“Exactly. Say anything, and the game's canceled on the spot.
Just stand there quietly and watch—Wait.”

source.japanese:
【下級水夫】
「あれ、こちら新しいお客さまですか？
　だったら、お荷物お運びしますねー」
source.english:
“Oh, a new guest?
I'll carry your luggage.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「あっ、いい、いいっ。
　俺の荷物に触んなっ」
source.english:
“No! No, that's fine!
Keep your hands off my bag!”

source.japanese: たまさか機関室に用足しにやってきた下級水夫がはやとちり、運んでいこうとしたバッグを慌ててひったくる。
source.english: A junior sailor passing through the engine room on an errand had jumped to a conclusion. Onijima hurriedly snatched back the bag the sailor had tried to carry away.

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「ちょっと用事があっただけで、こんなオンボロ船の客になろうって訳じゃないんだ。
　さあ行きな、お前さんには用はない───って。なんだこりゃあ、冷てぇな」
source.english:
“I've come on business, not to be a passenger on this wreck.
Off you go. Nothing for you here—What the hell? It's cold.”

source.japanese: 下級水夫を追い払い、席に着こうとした鬼島だったが、腰を浮かせて機関室備え付けの鉄製の椅子を覗きこんだ。
source.english: Having driven the sailor off, Onijima tried to sit. Then he raised his hips and inspected the engine room's iron chair.

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「ああすまない。先ほどお茶を零してしまったようだ。すぐに拭こう……とはいえ、この部屋にあるのは油の染みたウエスばかり」
source.english: “Oh, sorry. I seem to have spilled tea earlier. I'll wipe it at once… Though all we have here are oily rags.”

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「綺麗な布を持ってこさせるから、君、しばらく待っていてくれたまえ」
source.english: “I'll have a clean cloth brought. Wait a little, please.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「……いいよ、ちょっと濡れたぐらい気にしないよ。
　それともあんたら、この期に及んで勝負を引き延ばそうって腹か？」
source.english:
“…Never mind. A little damp doesn't bother me.
Or are you trying to delay the game at this late stage?”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「そんなつもり、ありません。
　貴方が構わないなら、いつでもどうぞ」
source.english:
“Nothing of the kind.
If you don't mind, begin whenever you wish.”

source.japanese: と途中で入った茶々に、鬼島は渋面を作りながらもボストンバッグからカードの箱を取り出した。真新しい、封が切られる前の一式である。
source.english: Frowning at these interruptions, Onijima took a box of cards from his bag. A brand-new, unopened pack.

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「公正を期す為に、デッキは新品、封切り前のものを使わせてもらう。それでいいな？」
source.english: “For fairness, we'll use a new, sealed deck. Agreed?”

target.text: In the corner of the engine room, a card game held on the bolted-down table and chairs found there, the Chief Engineer serving as the witness, the players consisting of the female passenger aboard the Albatross and the debt collector who had pursued her there.
【Kijima】 「So, on the topic of what game we're playing, poker's fine, yeah?」
【Rui】 「By all means. That suits me well enough.」
She assented without showing any particular interest, then turned her gaze to Sakuya.
【Rui】 「Oh yes. Nao-san, dear, you are not allowed to interfere with this game.」
【Kijima】 「Right, right. If you try to say anything, this game is called off right then and there. You just be a good boy and watch from over there───hey.」
【Deck boy】 「Oh, would this be a new passenger? In that case, let me carry your luggage for youー」
【Kijima】 「Ah, it's fine, it's fine. Hands off my stuff!」
In a fluster, he snatched back the bag that a deck boy, who had just so happened to stop by the engine room on an errand, was about to carry away after jumping to a hasty conclusion.
【Kijima】 「Just here on a bit of business, I'd never be a passenger aboard a ship this ragged. Come on, get, I have no use for you───bah. The hell is this, it's so cold.」
Shooing away the deck boy, Kijima made to take his seat, but he then raised his behind again and stared intently at the iron chair the engine room was furnished with.

【Chief Engineer】 「Aah, sincerest apologies. I must have spilt some tea there a little earlier. I shall clean it posthaste……or so I'd like to say, but all I have in this room is a rag stained with oil.」
【Chief Engineer】 「I shall bring a clean rag, so if you would please wait a short while for my return.」
【Kijima】 「……It's fine, getting a little wet is nothing to be concerned with. Or what, are you people trying to postpone our game here right at the last second?」
【Rui】 「I have no intentions of the sort. If you do not mind, then I am ready to start any time.」
While frowning at the silly interruptions along the way, Kijima pulled a card case from his boston bag. It was brand new, a complete set that had yet to be unsealed.
【Kijima】 「To guarantee fairness, the deck is brand new, and I'll be using one that has yet to be unsealed. That's fine, yeah?」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「ご自由に」
source.english: “As you please.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「By all means.」

source.japanese:
封緘を切り、包みのセロファンを破ってシャッフルも執拗に、泪と交互に切り合った後で鬼島がもう一度切り直すという念の入りようである。朔屋はこの男に散々毟られた苦い経験から、目を更に引ん剥きその手元を監視したのだが、そこになにかを仕込んだような動作は認められず、それでも疑念は拭い去れなかった。こういう手合いが正直な勝負をしようとは考えられなかったので。
　ましてや、鬼島自らカードを配りつつ、
source.english:
He broke the seal, tore off the cellophane, and shuffled with great persistence. He and Rui took turns cutting the deck; then he cut it once more himself. Thorough indeed. Bitter experience of being fleeced by the man made Sakuya open his eyes wider still and watch those hands. He saw no motion that appeared to slip anything into play. Even so, suspicion remained. A fellow like this was unlikely to gamble honestly.
Especially when Onijima, dealing the cards himself, said—

target.text: Cutting the seal, Kijima ripped open the cellophane wrapping and relentlessly shuffled the cards, swapped with Rui, and then reshuffled the cards one last time, just in case. Sakuya had already suffered the bitter experience of being plucked completely bare at the hands of this man, so he kept his eyes peeled and stared fixedly at his hands, but though he was unable to confirm anything that looked like the preparations for some sort of trick, his doubts were not dispelled. It was hard to imagine that this sort of man would ever intend to play an honest game. To say nothing of the fact that, while Kijima himself was dealing the cards,

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「ところで勝負は一度きりにしたい。
　こういうのはお互い手早く終わりにしたいだろう？」
source.english:
“I'd like to settle it in one hand.
We'd both prefer to finish quickly, wouldn't we?”

source.japanese: こんな事を言いだした、その自信はどこから来るのか、それもイカサマ由来としか思えなかった故に。だが泪は、またしても平然と受けた。
source.english: Where did such confidence come from? It could only be cheating. Yet Rui accepted calmly once again.

source.japanese:
【泪】
「それで結構よ。だらだらと続けるのは退屈だわ」
source.english: “That's quite all right. Dragging it out would be boring.”

target.text: 【Kijima】 「Incidentally, I'd like to keep this to a single match. I'm sure we'd both like for this sort of thing to be over quickly, right?」

He stated such a thing, but where did that confidence come from? He could only imagine it as something derived from whatever swindle he had planned. However, Rui, once again, accepted it with calm composure.
【Rui】 「That will be fine. Endlessly dragging things out is boring.」

source.japanese: かくしてカードも配られて───
source.english: So the cards were dealt—

source.japanese:
朔屋の控えた位置は、卓から一歩下がったところ、賭け事も何事も一歩下がった方が局面が見えるという真理通りに、自分がボロ負けした時より遙かに状況が見やすかった。
　具体的には鬼島の手札がちらちら覗けるくらいに。
　そして、危機感に目の前が暗くなった。
source.english:
Sakuya stood one step back from the table. True to the principle that, in gambling as in anything else, a step backward improves the view, he could read the situation far better than when he himself had been losing so catastrophically.
Specifically, he could catch glimpses of Onijima's hand.
And what he saw made his vision darken with alarm.

source.japanese:
なんとなれば既に鬼島の手札にはＡのペアが出来ている。ただのワンペアであるが、Ａは最強の札、ここから交換されたカード次第で、相当強い役が揃う事が充分に有り得る。
　鬼島も案の定手札を三枚交換しようとして───
source.english:
Onijima already held a pair of aces. Only one pair, but aces were the strongest cards. Depending on what he drew, he could easily complete a formidable hand.
Sure enough, he prepared to exchange three cards—

source.japanese: 案の定、だった。
source.english: Sure enough.

target.text: Thus, the cards were dealt───

In preparation, Sakuya had positioned himself a step away from the table; true to the adage that you can only observe the state of the board, in gambling as in everything else, by taking a step back, he could see the situation much more clearly than back when he was cleaned out. More concretely, he was able to sneak peeks at Kijima's hand from here. And then, his vision darkened from a sense of impending crisis.

Of all the things, Kijima's hand already consisted of a pair of aces. It was just a pair, but the ace was the strongest card, and depending on what cards he'd be able to swap for, it was plenty possible that he'd be able to make a very strong hand. And when Kijima, as expected, made to swap out three cards from his hand───
It was, indeed, as expected.

source.japanese:
【直正】
（げぇ!?　このおっさん……！）
source.english: (What!? This old bastard…!)

source.japanese:
朔屋の位置からは見えたのだ。
　鬼島が手首に巻いていたサポーター。
　この小太りな男はその体型故に汗かきで、朔屋との勝負の最中も幾度かサポーターで額の汗を拭っていた。そのサポーターから。
source.english:
Sakuya could see it from where he stood.
The sweatband about Onijima's wrist.
The plump man's build made him sweaty. During the earlier game, too, he had repeatedly wiped his forehead with those bands. Now, from the band—

target.text: 【Naomasa】 （Geh!? This old bastard……!）

It was visible from Sakuya's position. The bands that Kijima had wrapped around his wrists. This plump man would, of course, sweat as a consequence of his physique, and he had wiped his brow several times with those wristbands during his game with Sakuya. And from those wristbands.

source.japanese: カードが───
source.english: Cards—

source.japanese:
このスペードダイヤクラブハートそれぞれ一三枚にそしてジョーカー、五三枚揃えのこういったプレイングカードは通称『トランプ』と呼び慣わされているけれど、本来『トランプ』には『切り札』の意味がある。
　この時鬼島のサポーターから出現したのはまさにその切り札、Ａとそして、Ｋのペアーの都合三枚も。
source.english:
In Japan, a pack of cards such as this—thirteen each of spades, diamonds, clubs, and hearts, plus one joker, fifty-three in all—is commonly called toranpu. Properly speaking, however, trump means a card that wins the trick.
What now emerged from Onijima's sweatband were his toranpu in precisely that older sense: an ace and a pair of kings, three trump cards in all.

source.japanese:
サポーターはカードを収められるほどに幅は足りないようにしか見えないのにもかかわらず、隠しきって手の内に収める、それが鬼島の手練なのだろう。
　交換したカードと巧妙に入れ替え、出来上がるはフルハウス、相当上位の役だ。
source.english:
The band seemed too narrow to contain cards. Yet he concealed them completely and gathered them into his hand. That must have been his skill.
He deftly substituted them for his replacements, completing a full house. A very strong hand.

source.japanese: かたや泪はカードのチェンジなし。配られた手札をさっと一瞥して伏せて、それで勝負を受けるつもりと見えた。泪がどれだけの運を抱えているのかは知らないが、朔屋には勝負を捨てた投げ遣りにしか見えず、鬼島の詐術に───
source.english: Rui, meanwhile, drew no cards. She glanced briefly at her hand, set it facedown, and apparently meant to play it as it was. Sakuya did not know how much luck she possessed. To him, she looked merely indifferent, throwing the game away. At Onijima's trickery—

target.text: Came cards───

The thirteen cards from each of the suits of spades, diamonds, clubs, and hearts, as well as the joker: this set of fifty-three playing cards collected in a deck is well-known as『Toranpu』 or『Trump』in these lands, but the original meaning of『Trump』in this context comes from the concept of a『Trump Card』. What emerged from Kijima's wristbands in this moment were the very definition of trump cards, an ace as well as a pair of kings, an inordinately convenient set of three.

Despite the fact that it didn't look like the wristbands were wide enough to be able to contain the cards, the hidden cards slid into the palm of his hand; this was surely the technique Kijima employed to deceive others. He skillfully replaced the cards he'd drawn with the ones hidden in his hand, assembling a full house, a remarkably high-ranking hand.

On the other hand, Rui did not swap out any cards. She barely spared the cards she'd been dealt a quick glance and placed them face down: it looked like she intended to participate in this round. He didn't know exactly how blessed Rui was by Lady Luck, but to Sakuya's eyes, this only looked like her recklessly throwing the game, and having witnessed Kijima's swindling, he───

source.japanese:
糾弾しようとして、朔屋は結局口を噤んだ。
　どうあろうともこの厄介事、そもそも持ちこんだのは朔屋である。泪は言わば巻きこまれただけであり、なのに朔屋に手を差し延べてくれている。
source.english:
He meant to denounce him. In the end, he held his tongue.
However one looked at it, Sakuya himself had brought this trouble aboard. Rui had merely been caught up in it. Even so, she had offered him a hand.

source.japanese:
その泪が受けたのだ。
　鬼島の、
『朔屋が勝負に口を挟んだら御破算にする』
　という条件を。
　ならば、今さら口を差し挟める筋はない。
　朔屋は観念して、泪に全てを任せる事にした。
source.english:
And she had accepted Onijima's condition:
‘If Sakuya interferes, the game is canceled.’
He had no right to intervene now.
Resigned, he decided to leave everything to Rui.

source.japanese:
【泪】
「……いい子ね、直さん」
source.english: “…Good boy, Nao.”

source.japanese:
葛藤の末に押し黙った朔屋に、ふと掛けられた声は、彼には目線もくれず、秘やかな囁き声であったけれど。
　朔屋はその一言で、体を押し包む怯えと力みが柔らかく溶けていくのを感じた。
　相手の詐術に気づいているのかいないのか、泪はあくまでも淡々としており、それが朔屋にこの上ない安心感を与えたのだった。
source.english:
After his struggle, Sakuya fell silent. Then came the voice, addressed to him without so much as a glance, in a hushed, private whisper.
At that one sentence, he felt the fear and tension gripping his body gently melt away.
Whether or not she had seen through her opponent's trick, Rui remained perfectly composed, and this reassured Sakuya beyond measure.

target.text: He was about to denounce the fraud, but ultimately, he bit his tongue. No matter what angle he considered it from, Sakuya himself was the one who had brought this trouble back with him. Rui had, so to speak, only been wrapped up in all this because of him, and yet she was still extending a helping hand to Sakuya.

And Rui had accepted it. The condition that 『If Sakuya meddles in this game, then the game is called off』, what Kijima had demanded. Given that, there was no logical reason for him to intervene at this point. Sakuya resigned himself to his fate, leaving everything in Rui's hands.
【Rui】 「……That's a good boy, Nao-san.」

Keeping silent after his internal conflict, the voice that suddenly called out to Sakuya spared him not a single glance, though it was given in a secretive whisper. At those simple words, Sakuya felt all the trepidation and tension enveloping his body soften and melt away. Whether she had noticed the swindling done by her opponent or not, Rui was dispassionate to the last, and that was precisely what left Sakuya with an unrivaled sense of relief.

source.japanese:
どうせまともに勝負するはずもないと予想していたけれど、こうまであからさまな手口を使われては。
　泪までその遣り口の犠牲にされてはたまらない。自分がこんな安い手口に引っかけられたその悔しさもある。たまりかねて糾弾しようとして、
source.english:
He had expected the man to cheat. But a trick this blatant?
He could not bear to let Rui become its victim, too. There was also the resentment of having fallen for something so cheap himself. Unable to endure it, he tried to denounce him—

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「……おい坊主。
　もう忘れたわけじゃなかろうな。
　おめえが口出ししたら、
　そこで御破算だって事を」
source.english:
“…Hey, boy.
You haven't forgotten already?
If you interfere,
the game is over.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「わざわざ繰り返してやったんだ。
　それで───何か言いたい事があるのか？」
source.english:
“I've gone to the trouble of reminding you.
Now—anything you want to say?”

target.text: He had always expected that this would never be a fair game, but to use such a blatant method was beyond the pale. He couldn't bear also letting Rui fall victim to that method. He also felt bitterly frustrated that he himself had fallen for such a simple trick. At the end of his rope, as he made to denounce the man,
【Kijima】 「……Oi, kid. I'm sure you haven't forgotten. That if you meddle here, this whole thing is getting called off right then and there.」
【Kijima】 「I'm going out of my way to repeat myself here. So───is there something you'd like to get off your chest?」

source.japanese:
口元まで上ってきた言葉は、鬼島の一睨[にら]みで喉の奥まで押し戻される。
　それに鬼島だけでなく泪までもが、朔屋に咎めるような眼を向けているではないか。
source.english:
The words that had risen to Sakuya's lips were forced down his throat by a single glare.
And not only Onijima. Rui, too, was looking at him reproachfully.

source.japanese: ───下らない事で、ゲームに水を差さないで。
source.english: —Don't spoil the game over something so trivial.

source.japanese:
泪は黙していたけれど、沈黙の裡にそんな意味を籠もった横目をくれてよこしたのには、朔屋としては押し黙るしかない。
　後は泪の運を信ずるしかなさそうだった。
source.english:
She said nothing, but the sidelong look held that meaning in its silence. Sakuya could only hold his tongue.
All that remained was to trust her luck.

target.text: The words that were already on the tip of his tongue were pushed all the way down the depths of his throat again by a single glare from Kijima. And it was not just Kijima, for was Rui not also sending a reproachful look Sakuya's way?
───Do not put a damper on the game over something so trivial.

Rui was keeping quiet, but having been sent a sidelong glance, one laden with such implications within its silence, Sakuya could only remain quiet in turn. It seemed like all he had left was to believe in Rui's luck.

source.japanese:
チェンジも済んで、カードが捲[めく]られていく。
　
　卓上に一枚ずつ───
source.english:
The draw was over. Now the cards turned faceup.
One by one upon the table—

target.text: With their draws now finished, the cards were being flipped over. One by one, atop the table───

source.japanese: 鬼島のＡの三枚揃い、対する泪も負けていなかった。スリーカードを揃えていた、けれど、先にＡを抑えられては。或いは泪に相応しい、Ｑの絵札、しかしそれでもやはり鬼島の手役にはこの時点では負けている。
source.english: Three aces for Onijima. Rui was not to be outdone: she, too, had three of a kind—queens, the face cards perhaps most fitting for her. But against his aces, at this stage her hand was still losing.

target.text: Compared to Kijima's three aces, Rui's hand was no slouch. She had gathered three of a kind as well, however, the aces had already been been claimed. Or perhaps it was befitting of Rui, for she had the Queen face cards, but ultimately, at this moment, that would still lose against Kijima's hand.

source.japanese:
一枚、と捲[めく]られる。朔屋には判っていた事だが、鬼島のＫ、泪は───ハートの２という可憐ではあるがこの場にはなんの役にも立たない札。
　
　朔屋は足下から崩れ、このまま信天翁号を浮かべる海に呑みこまれていくかの失墜感に───鬼島が止めを、刺す───
source.english:
Another card turned. As Sakuya already knew, Onijima's was a king. Rui's—a two of hearts. Sweet, perhaps, but utterly useless here.
Sakuya felt himself collapse from the feet upward, as though about to be swallowed by the sea supporting the Albatross. Onijima delivered the finishing blow—

target.text: They flipped one card. Sakuya already knew it, but it was Kijima's king, and Rui's was───a two of hearts, a very lovely card, but not one that would be of any use in this situation. The world collapsed from under Sakuya's feet; the way things were going left him with a sinking feeling, as though he were being swallowed by the very waves the Albatross was floating on───and Kijima dealt the final blow───

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「ＡとＫのフルハウスだ。
　そっちは───って!?」
source.english:
“Aces full of kings.
Yours is—What!?”

source.japanese: もちろん鬼島はこの段階で勝利を確信して、朔屋にも止めを刺すつもりでいたのだろうが。
source.english: Of course, by then he must have been certain of victory and meant to deal Sakuya the final blow as well.

target.text: 【Kijima】 「Aces full of kings. And you have───WHAT!?」
Naturally, Kijima was certain in his victory at this point, likely also intending to deal the final blow to Sakuya while he was at it.

source.japanese:
【泪】
「フォーカード」
source.english: “Four of a kind.”

source.japanese: ……わざわざ最後に捲[めく]る札に役を隠しておくあたり、泪も意地悪というもので、鬼島の顔こそ見物だった。
source.english: …Keeping the decisive card until the last reveal was rather cruel of Rui. Onijima's face was a sight to behold.

target.text: 【Rui】 「Four of a kind.」
……She had deliberately kept the rank of the final card she was flipping over hidden; Rui, too, could be quite malicious, but the look on Kijima's face was the true spectacle worth beholding here.

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「ちょ……なんだそれぇ！」
source.english: “Wait… What the hell is that!?”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「なんだ、って、ご覧の通り」
source.english: “What do you mean? Precisely what you see.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「チェンジも無しの初手からかよ、有り得ねえだろそんなのは！」
source.english: “From the deal? Without drawing? That's impossible!”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「けれども、ご覧の通りですもの」
source.english: “And yet, there it is.”

source.japanese:
勝ち誇りもせず、どこまでも退屈そうに、一つ小さな欠伸を優雅に漏らしてみせるのが朔屋には小気味よく、鬼島にはどれだけ小面憎く映った事だろう。
　震える肩と口元にやる方のない憤懣を漲らせ、泪を睨[にら]みつける鬼島の、口にするかするまいか激しく葛藤するその一言は、朔屋には、いや朔屋だからこそ判った。口にしてしまえば負け犬のその一言。
『イカサマだ』というそれ。
　そして泪は、葛藤する鬼島に、初めて興味を見せたように。
source.english:
Without triumph, looking bored throughout, she gave one small, elegant yawn. Sakuya found it immensely satisfying. How irritating it must have looked to Onijima.
His trembling shoulders and mouth brimmed with anger he could not discharge. He glared at Rui, fiercely debating whether to say one particular thing. Sakuya understood it—indeed, understood precisely because he was Sakuya. The accusation that would make him a sore loser.
‘You're cheating.’
And Rui, apparently showing interest in his struggle for the first time—

source.japanese:
【泪】
「納得いかないご様子ね。
　なんでしたら、もう一勝負、いかが」
source.english:
“You seem dissatisfied.
Would you like another hand?”

source.japanese:
───そこで鬼島は引き下がっておけば良かったのだ。少なくとも彼のいう債権は、この勝負に負けても回収できるのだし、朔屋に服を返すだけでいい。それを戻したところで鬼島には大して痛痒も与えないはずである。
　鬼島も大きく息を吸いこみ深呼吸の、まだそこまでは彼にも心を落ち着けようとするくらいの分別はあったのだろうが。
source.english:
—He should have withdrawn then. At least the debt he claimed would still be paid despite his loss. He had only to return Sakuya's clothes. That would scarcely hurt him.
He drew a great breath. Up to that point, at least, he retained enough sense to try calming himself. But—

source.japanese:
【泪】
「そうねえ、条件は。
　貴方が勝ったなら、わたくしは貴方の物になりましょう」
source.english:
“Now, the terms.
If you win, I'll become yours.”

target.text: 【Kijima】 「Wha-……THE HELL IS THAT!?」
【Rui】 「What do you mean? It is as you see.」
【Kijima】 「You had those cards in your starting hand without any draws? That's gotta be impossible!」
【Rui】 「And yet, it is still as you see.」

She held no pride in victory either, seemingly bored from start to finish, the small yawn she elegantly let slip bringing a great thrill to Sakuya's heart, though it must surely have looked incredibly impertinent to Kijima. With shoulders and lips trembling, brimming with a seething anger he was unable to vent, Kijima glared at Rui, and that thought, the one he was internally conflicted on whether to put into words or not, Sakuya knew it, rather, he knew it precisely by virtue of being Sakuya. Those words that would forever brand you a sore loser the moment you uttered them. 『You cheated』, those very words.
And then, Rui, as though showing an interest in the conflicted Kijima for the very first time.
【Rui】 「You do not appear to be satisfied. If that is the case, how would one more round suit you?」

───Kijima really should just have pulled out then and there. At the very least, the debt he had spoken of would be collected even if he lost this game, and all he had to do was return Sakuya's clothes. And returning those should not have brought Kijima any particularly great mental anguish. Kijima also took a deep breath and heaved a grand sigh, so he surely still had enough sense to try and calm himself down and put a stop to things here, but.
【Rui】 「Oh yes, the terms. If you win, then I shall henceforth belong to you.」

source.english: “—What!?”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「なんだとうっ！」
source.english: “What did you say!?”

source.japanese: 驚愕の声は朔屋と鬼島、別々の喉からなのに機を同一させて、二人が目を剥いたにもかかわらず泪は変わらず優雅な怠惰のままに男達を見つめるばかり。
source.english: The startled cries came from different throats, Sakuya's and Onijima's, but at the same moment. Both stared. Rui merely watched them, her elegant languor unchanged.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「泪さん、それはいくらなんでも……っ」
source.english: “Rui, that's going too far…!”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「黙ってろい、小僧がッ。
　おいあんた、それは本気なんだな？
　女が男の物になるって、
　それがどういう意味かをわかって───」
source.english:
“Shut up, brat!
Listen—you mean that? You understand what it means for a woman to become a man's property—”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「皆まで言わせずともよろしい。
　それにね、わたくしも身に覚えのない債権とやらには、悩まされたくないの」
source.english:
“There's no need to spell it out.
And I don't want to be troubled by these alleged debts I know nothing about.”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「貴方、そちらの勝った時のお話は、
　言った通り。
　けれどわたくしが勝ったなら、債権は帳消しにして、そして貴方の全てをこの船に置いて行きなさい」
source.english:
“If you win,
the terms are as I said.
But if I win, cancel the debts and leave everything you own on this ship.”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「いかが───？
　まあわたくしとしては、別にどちらでも構わないのだけれども」
source.english:
“Well?
Personally, I don't particularly mind either way.”

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「───WHA!?」
【Kijima】 「You will WHAT!?」

The voices of astonishment came from both Sakuya and Kijima, flying out from separate throats yet operating as one; even as the two goggled at her, Rui paid it no mind, simply continuing to gaze at the men with her usual elegant laziness.
【Naomasa】 「Rui-san, no matter what, I think that's going too far……」
【Kijima】 「Shut your trap, you dumb brat! Hey, you, are you serious about that? When a woman belongs to a man, do you understand just what that implies───」
【Rui】 「There is no need to spell out every little detail. In addition, I do not wish to be troubled over claims of debt that I hold no recollection of.」
【Rui】 「Dear, if you are to win, it will be just as I said. But if I am to win, the debt will be forgiven, and you will leave behind everything you own on this ship, then take your leave.」
【Rui】 「How about it───? Well, for my part, I do not care overly much either way.」

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「あんた……なに考えてやがる？
　なにを、仕込んでやがる……？」
source.english:
“You… What are you thinking?
What have you rigged…?”

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「おかしな事を言うね、君は。
　仕込むもなにも、そもそもデッキは君が持ちこんだものだろうに」
source.english:
“What an odd thing to say.
Rigged? You brought the deck yourself.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「あんたも黙ってろって！」
source.english: “You shut up, too!”

source.japanese:
声高く怒鳴りつけたものの、今や鬼島の惑乱彼の総身から湯気となって立ちのぼり、泪を睨めつける視線にも凄まじいかぎろいが溜まっている。
　眼の中に渦巻いていたのは、欲と迷いと。
　泪の肢体を己の物とし、恣に貪りたい食い荒らしたい。男をそうたやすく狂わせる魔力を泪の艶麗な肉体は宿している。これに抗[こう]しきれる男はそういまい。
　しかし一方で己の全財産を失う危険もある。ギャンブルで他人を食い物にする者にも、逆らえない信条はある。賭の結果にはなにがあっても従う事。これを踏み破る博徒には相応の結果が待っているのだから。
source.english:
He shouted, but confusion now seemed to rise like steam from his whole body. A violent shimmer filled the eyes glaring at Rui.
Desire and doubt swirled there.
He wanted to possess her body, devour it however he pleased. Her sumptuous flesh held a power that could so easily drive a man mad. Few men could resist it completely.
On the other hand, he risked losing all his wealth. Even a man who preyed on others through gambling had a principle he could not defy: whatever happened, one obeyed the outcome of a wager. Appropriate consequences awaited gamblers who broke that rule.

source.japanese:
鬼島は迷いに迷い、泪を見て、泪は、迷う男の前で泰然と足を組み替えて見せた。ドレスが張り詰めて、裡側からえもいわれぬ柔らかそうな肉から零れんばかりに熟れた色香が香りたった。
　それで、鬼島の天秤はことりと片側に墜ちた。
　カードは自分が持ちこんだもの、泪が詐術を仕込めるはずもないとの計算は果たして正しかったのかどうか、なんにせよ女の肉の魅力が鬼島の心を乱したのは確かである。
source.english:
He hesitated and hesitated, looking at Rui. Before the wavering man, she serenely crossed her legs the other way. Her dress stretched taut. A ripe sensuality seemed to rise like fragrance from the indescribably soft-looking flesh beneath, almost overflowing.
With a soft click, the balance within Onijima tipped to one side.
Whether he was right to reason that the cards were his and Rui could not have prepared a trick, one thing was certain: the attraction of her flesh had disturbed his judgment.

target.text: 【Kijima】 「You……what the hell are you scheming? What kind of trick do you have up your sleeve……?」
【Chief Engineer】 「What an odd thing to say. There are no tricks of any sort, on account of you being the one who brought the deck here in the first place, surely.」
【Kijima】 「You shut your mouth too!」

Although he shouted loudly at him, the waves of confusion radiating off Kijima's entire body had now turned to steam, rising like great pillars into the air, and an intense, hazy glint pooled in his eyes as he glared at Rui. What spiralled in those eyes was lust and hesitation. The desire to make Rui's body his very own: he wanted to devour her in a fit of self-indulgence, wolf her down. Rui's bewitchingly beautiful flesh was possessed of such magical power that it could easily drive a man to madness like so. Few men would be able to fully resist her. [0, 0, 0, 0, -1, -1, 1]

Kijima hesitated, how he hesitated, looked at Rui, and Rui, she calmly made a show of crossing her legs in front of this vacillating man. With her dress stretched taut, an alluring, mature scent wafting out from the indescribably soft flesh almost about to spill out from within. And with that, the scales of Kijima's heart tilted to one side with a clonk. Since he'd brought the cards himself, there was no way Rui should have been able to set up some kind of trick; whether that reckoning would end up proving true or not, regardless, what was certainly true was that the charms of a woman's flesh had thrown Kijima's mind into disarray.

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「……もう一度、同じポーカーでいいな？」
source.english: “…Poker again. Same game. Agreed?”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「ええ。そしてこれで、お終いにしたいわ。
　これが最後よ。よくって？」
source.english:
“Yes. And I'd like this to end it.
The last hand. Is that clear?”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「ああ」
source.english: “Yes.”

target.text: 【Kijima】 「……You good with the same game of poker one more time, yeah?」
【Rui】 「Yes. And in addition, I would like this round to be the end of it. This is the final game. Is that acceptable?」
【Kijima】 「Yeah.」

source.japanese:
【直正】
「泪さん、俺の事は───」
source.english: “Rui, as for me—”

source.japanese: 泪自身は朔屋の進退などに拘泥せず、ただ彼女自身の心の風が赴くままにもう一勝負、存在を賭けた勝負に挑んだのだとしても、彼女を制止する言葉を最後まで吐ききれず、尻すぼみに終わらせた朔屋は、やはりどこまでいっても駄目な朔屋であった。
source.english: Perhaps Rui cared nothing for Sakuya's fate. Perhaps she challenged another hand, with her very self at stake, merely because the wind of her own heart took her there. Yet he could not finish the words that might stop her. They trailed away. As ever, Sakuya remained hopelessly Sakuya.

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「いいからお前は黙ってろい。
　だが……そうだな、最後のシャフルと札を配るのは、お前にやらせてやろう」
source.english:
“Just keep quiet.
But… Yes. You can do the final shuffle and deal.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「さすがにこの勝負、あたしがそれをやっちゃあ、後からどんなけちがつくか知れたもんじゃないしな」
source.english: “With stakes like these, if I do it, who knows what complaints I'll hear afterward?”

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「Rui-san, I'm-, what about me───」

Rui herself wasn't concerned with whether Sakuya would stay in this world or leave it behind; the winds blowing within her heart were merely headed in the direction of one more game, and even though this was a game with his very existence on the line, he remained unable to find the words that could reign this woman in until the very end; true to form, Sakuya's protest weakly tapered off into nothing, a testament to Sakuya being an incompetent failure through and through.
【Kijima】 「That's enough out of you, can you just shut up? But……right, I'll have you do the final shuffling and dealing.」
【Kijima】 「As is only to be expected, were I to do that for this game, you never know what sort of bad luck I might be blamed for afterwards, right?」

source.japanese:
いきなり振られた大役を、朔屋は必死に丁重に辞退申し上げたものの、鬼島の一睨[にら]みと泪と機関長の納得ずくの一揖に却下される。
　鬼島の方も朔屋の博才欠片もない事を見抜いていて、詐術を割りこませる余地もないと判断したのだろう。
　実際朔屋には、積み込みをする余裕も器用さもなく、震える手でようやくに切り終え配るのが精一杯でありそして───
source.english:
Sakuya desperately and politely declined this sudden great responsibility. Onijima's glare, and approving nods from Rui and the engineer, overruled him.
Onijima must have recognized his complete lack of gambling skill and judged there was no room for him to introduce a trick.
Indeed, Sakuya had neither the composure nor the dexterity to stack the deck. With trembling hands, he barely managed to shuffle and deal. Then—

target.text: Although Sakuya desperately and politely tried to turn down this big responsibility suddenly foisted on him, he was shot down by a glare from Kijima and small nods of approval coming from Rui and the Chief Engineer. Kijima must have noticed that Sakuya had not a scrap of talent when it came to gambling, likely determining that he did not have the composure or ability to sneak in any cheating. In reality, Sakuya did not, in fact, have neither the composure nor the nimble fingers needed to stack the deck in any way, his plate already full just dealing the cards he'd finally finished shuffling with shaking hands, and then───

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「どうだっ。ストレートフラッシュ！」
source.english: “How's that? A straight flush!”

source.japanese:
───難度としては最上位に位置する手役をこの局面で引き当ててみせたのはいっぱしの博徒としては当然というべきか。一度目の勝負と同じ、サポーターに隠した切り札を懲りずに使ってみせたのだから。鬼島は一度やられた手口を臆面もなく繰り返して、その面の皮の厚さに今度こそ糾弾の手を入れようとした朔屋は、またも泪の目礼で黙らされた。
　その結果がこれでは目も当てられないと戦慄する一方で、朔屋には奇妙な予感があったのだ。
　泪なら、この状況にも何一つ揺るがないだろうと。
　果たして。
source.english:
—Drawing one of the highest-ranking hands at this moment might be only natural for a seasoned gambler. He had once again used the trumps hidden in his sweatband, just as in the first game. Without shame, he repeated the trick that had already been beaten. This time Sakuya meant to intervene and denounce such brazen nerve, but Rui silenced him again with a glance.
He shuddered at this disastrous result. Yet he also had a strange premonition.
Rui would not waver at anything in this situation.
And indeed—

source.japanese:
【泪】
「わたくしも同じ。ただわたくしのは」
source.english: “Mine is the same. Only mine—”

target.text: 【Kijima】 「Read 'em and weep. A straight flush!」

───Perhaps it ought to only be called natural for a fully-fledged gambler to attempt to pull the hand also ranking highest on the scale of difficulty in a situation like this? Just like the first game, he had shamelessly made use of the trump cards hidden in his wristbands. Kijima repeated the same trick he'd already used once before with no scruples, and incensed by how absolutely brazen this was, Sakuya made to denounce him this time for certain, but he was once again brought to silence by the look in Rui's eyes.

While he trembled at this result that was too unbearable to even look at, Sakuya had a queer premonition. Given this was Rui, she would surely not waver in the slightest in the face of this state of affairs. And in the end.
【Rui】 「I have the same. However, mine is.」

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「うげえっ!?」
source.english: “What!?”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「ロイアル・ストレートフラッシュ……すげえ、実戦で揃うのなんて、初めて見た……」
source.english: “A royal flush… Amazing. First time I've seen one in an actual game…”

source.japanese:
煌びやかに揃った絵札が、機関室の無機質な卓の上を宮廷と為し、華やかに円舞に興ずるかのように。
　そして鬼島は、ひとかどの矜持持つ博徒なら口にはしない一言を、とうとう放ってしまったのだった。
source.english:
The splendidly assembled court cards seemed to turn the engine room's plain table into a palace and dance a brilliant waltz upon it.
At last, Onijima uttered the accusation no gambler with a shred of pride should speak.

target.text: 【Kijima】 「Ugeh!?」
【Naomasa】 「A royal straight flush……incredible, that's the first time I've ever seen that in a real game……」

The gorgeous set of face cards formed a royal court atop the inorganic table of the engine room, as though they were making merry with a resplendent round dance. And then there was Kijima, who finally blurted out the one thing that any respectable, proud gambler would never dare put into words.

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「イカサマだ！」
source.english: “You're cheating!”

source.japanese: 詰め寄る男に返してみせたが、呆れるほど落ち着き払ったただの一言で。
source.english: She answered his angry advance with one astonishingly composed remark.

target.text: 【Kijima】 「YOU CHEATED!」
She offered a reply to the man closing in on her, but it was a single, short sentence delivered in a manner so absurdly composed it was baffling.

source.japanese:
【泪】
「ええそうよ」
source.english: “Yes, I am.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「てめえこの阿女、
　よくもせけえ真似しくさりやがってっ！」
source.english:
“You bitch!
How dare you pull such a filthy trick!”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「でもあなた、見破れなかったじゃない。
　見破れなかったイカサマは、
　イカサマとはいえません」
source.english:
“But you failed to detect it.
Cheating that goes undetected cannot be called cheating.”

source.japanese:
朔屋をいいように手玉に取った後で、得意気に吐いた時と同じ台詞の、自分に向けられて鬼島は、醜くたやすく逆上した。
　やにわポロシャツまくり上げ、体毛むさ苦しく繁った三段腹を晒せば、ズボンの背側に呑んでいた拳銃が現れる、朔屋に突きつけた、小型の隠匿用の拳銃ではあっても急所に当たればただでは済むまい。
source.english:
The same words he had proudly used after making a fool of Sakuya. Turned upon himself, they easily sent him into an ugly rage.
Abruptly he pulled up his polo shirt, exposing three rolls of belly thick with coarse hair. A pistol appeared from the back of his trousers. He aimed it at Sakuya. Small and intended for concealment, perhaps, but a hit to a vital point would be no trivial matter.

target.text: 【Rui】 「Yes, I certainly did.」
【Kijima】 「You fucking bitch, how dare you pull that dirty shit on me!」
【Rui】 「But you never saw through it, yes? And cheating that was never seen through, why, that can't be called cheating.」

Kijima was now on the receiving end of the very same line that he himself had so proudly uttered after leading Sakuya around by the nose, and he easily flew into a disgraceful rage. When he suddenly rolled up his polo shirt, showing off a potbelly covered in a distressingly thick carpet of body hair in the process, a handgun emerged from where it had been tucked into the back pockets of his pants, and he thrust it right at Sakuya; though it was a small handgun made for concealed carrying, were that to hit him in a vital spot, he'd end up paying a fatal price for it.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「最後にゃまたこれかよ……」
source.english: “And it ends with this again…?”

source.japanese:
反射的に両手を挙げて、恐ろしいやら情けないやらで朔屋は泣き顔に、信天翁号に乗ってからなぜこうも、自分が空手なのにもかかわらず銃口と向き合う羽目に陥られねばならないのか、運命を嘆いたところで答える天の声はない。
　鬼島は激昂し、朔屋は恐怖し、一方泪と機関長は悠揚迫らず、それが踏んだ場数と格の差か、
source.english:
Reflexively he raised both hands. Frightened and miserable, he looked ready to cry. Since boarding the Albatross, why did he keep ending up unarmed before a gun's muzzle? He lamented his fate, but no heavenly voice answered.
Onijima raged. Sakuya was terrified. Rui and the engineer remained unhurried and untroubled. Was that the difference in experience, and in their caliber?

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「Are we really ending things with this again……」

He raised both his hands reflexively, Sakuya's face in tears from fear or maybe misery, but why was it that ever since he had come to board the Albatross, in spite of him being empty-handed, he'd always be the one who the gun was aimed at? For all that he lamented his fate, no voice answered his call from the heavens. Kijima was fuming, Sakuya was terrified; meanwhile, Rui and the Chief Engineer were calm and composed, but was that born from a difference in experience or character?

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「別に構わないがね、君。
　ただ一つ、教えてあげよう。
　君が座っているその鉄椅子には、
　電線が引いてある。
　そしてこれがスイッチだ」
source.english:
“I don't particularly mind.
But let me tell you one thing.
The iron chair beneath you is wired.
And this is the switch.”

source.japanese: 取り出したとも見えないのに、機関長の手の中には確かにその電気装置が収まって、
source.english: Sakuya had not seen him produce it, yet there in the engineer's hand unmistakably lay the electrical switch.

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「私の指一つで、一五〇〇ボルト相当の電流が流れる筈で、まあショック死は免れまいね」
source.english: “One touch of my finger should send fifteen hundred volts through you. You would hardly survive the shock.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「う、嘘だ！」
source.english: “Y-you're lying!”

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「I don't really care overmuch, sir. But I have one thing I must tell you. That iron chair that you are sitting in has been rigged with a wire. And this here is the switch.」
It didn't look like he'd even pulled it out from anywhere, but there certainly was some manner of electrical equipment held in the Chief Engineer's hand,
【Chief Engineer】 「With but a single flick of my finger, an electrical current equivalent to 1500 volts will surge through you, and I am afraid that death by shock will be inevitable.」
【Kijima】 「Y-, you're lying!」

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「そう思うなら、椅子の脚を見たまえ」
source.english: “If you think so, look at the chair legs.”

source.japanese: ……確かに電線が巻きつけられている。
source.english: …Wires were indeed wrapped about them.

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「座った時に濡れていたろう？　余計に通電しやすくなっているはずだ」
source.english: “It was wet when you sat down, wasn't it? That should make it conduct all the better.”

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「If that is what you believe, then I ask that you direct your gaze to the legs of the chair.」
……A wire certainly had been coiled around them.
【Chief Engineer】 「It was wet as you sat on it, I believe? That should make it much easier for the electrical current to flow through to you.」

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「だいたい君、口上打つ暇があるのなら、
　どうしてさっさと撃たないのかね。
　せっかく拳銃を向けたのに」
source.english:
“Besides, if you have time for speeches,
why not simply shoot?
You went to all the trouble of pointing the pistol.”

source.japanese:
【鬼島】
「あ、あたしに何かあったら、ボスが黙っちゃいねえぜ!?」
source.english: “If anything happens to me, my boss won't stand for it!”

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「To begin with, sir, if you have the time to deliver a dramatic monologue, why do you not simply shoot him already, I wonder? Anything else would be a waste after going to the trouble of pointing your gun at him.」
【Kijima】 「If-, if anything happens to me, don't think the boss is just gonna stay quiet about it, got it!?」

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「君ぃ、それは君がどうなったか、ちゃんと陸に伝わればの話だろう」
source.english: “My dear fellow, that assumes news of what happened to you properly reaches shore.”

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「陸での話ならいざ知らず、この船は明日にも出港する。そんな船にのこのこ独りで乗りこんでくると言うのは、少々配慮に欠けやしないかね？」
source.english: “Ashore might be another matter. But this ship sails tomorrow. Coming aboard such a vessel alone, so casually, seems a little thoughtless, doesn't it?”

source.japanese: 今さら陸にいるらしいボス格やらなんやらを傘に着る鬼島など所詮小物で、機関長が虚言を弄している事に気づくはずもない。信天翁号はまだこの港に数日は停泊しているはずであり、もし鬼島の言葉が真実なら、手下の失踪に背後の勢力が乗りこんでくる可能性だってないとは言いきれない。……もっとも、こんな小物の行方を一々気に掛けてやるような優しい心配りをそのボスが有していればの話であるが。
source.english:
Onijima was only a small fry, belatedly sheltering beneath the name of some boss ashore, and could hardly recognize the engineer's lie. The Albatross was supposed to remain in port for several more days. If Onijima's claim was true, one could not rule out the forces behind him boarding in search of a missing subordinate.
…Provided, of course, that his boss possessed the kindly concern to trouble himself over the whereabouts of such small fry.

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「Siiir, that will only be an issue IF news of whatever happened to you actually reaches the mainland, I do believe.」

【Chief Engineer】 「Were we on land, that might certainly be possible, but this ship is leaving this port tomorrow. That you decided to board a ship like that all by yourself, why, do you not think that was a little lacking in prudence of you, hmm?」

At this point, Kijima was nothing more than some small-fry hiding behind the reputation of some boss or what-have-you back on land; he was far too insignificant a player to realize how the Chief Engineer was toying with him in a web of lies. The Albatross was still scheduled to remain in this port for several more days, and if Kijima's words were true, were they to bungle anything while handling his disappearance, they could not deny the possibility that whatever forces he had backing him would come marching onto the ship.
……In the first place, this, of course, was assuming that there existed a boss kind and considerate enough to worry about the whereabouts of somebody this unimportant.

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「……君は知っていますか。そこの罐の中に放り込んだら、人間など一瞬で燃え尽きてしまうことを」
source.english: “…Did you know? Throw a person into that furnace, and they'll burn up in an instant.”

source.japanese: 殺し文句という、まさにそれだった。
source.english: A killer line. In the most literal sense.

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「その時は……あれは燐が燃えるんだろうね。
　美しい、そう、とても美しい蒼い炎を放つ事を」
source.english:
“At that moment… The phosphorus must be burning, I suppose.
It gives off a beautiful blue flame. Yes, very beautiful.”

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「……Are you aware of this? That if thrown inside that boiler, the likes of a man would be burnt to ashes in but an instant.」
That right there was exactly what you'd call a killer line.
【Chief Engineer】 「And when that happens……it must be the phosphorus burning, no? A beautiful, yes, an absolutely gorgeous flame of greenish-blue is released.」

source.japanese:
顔色を失う鬼島の、拳銃を放り投げて、もそもそ言いながら、部屋から逃げ出そうとするも、機関長の指の方が一瞬早い。
　スイッチ一つで電流が流れ、弾けた音と閃光に鬼島はあっさり悶絶の、だが濡れ具合が足らなかったか通電は不完全だったようで、どうやら生命だけは取り留めたようだ。
source.english:
All color fled Onijima's face. He flung away the pistol and, muttering, tried to flee the room—but the engineer's finger was an instant faster.
A touch of the switch sent current through the chair. There came a crack and a flash, and Onijima collapsed in agony. Perhaps the seat had not been wet enough, for the conduction seemed incomplete. At any rate, he appeared to have escaped with his life.

target.text: With his face losing all colour, Kijima hurled the handgun away, and while muttering to himself, he made to flee from the room, but the Chief Engineer's fingers were a moment too fast. With the flick of a switch, the current surged, and with a popping sound and a flash of light, Kijima readily fainted in agony, but perhaps he hadn't been wet enough, for the conduction was incomplete: he somehow managed to escape with his life.

source.japanese: 泪は鬼島の持っていた鞄に、彼女自身はさしたる興味も示さず朔屋へ押し出した。
source.english: Rui showed no particular interest in Onijima's bag. She pushed it toward Sakuya.

target.text: Rui pushed the bag Kijima had been carrying towards Sakuya without showing much interest in it herself.

source.japanese:
【泪】
「こんな男の財産なんて要らないし。
　でもちょっとだけ、退屈がしのげたかしら。
　これは、そのご褒美よ。
　もらっておきなさい」
source.english:
“I've no use for anything that man owns.
But he did relieve a little boredom.
This is your reward.
Take it.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「I have no need for property belonging to a man of his ilk. But, it did make for a slight diversion from my boredom, I suppose. This here is your reward for that. Take it with you.」

source.japanese:
鞄の中には小金くらいでろくなものは入っていなかったけれど、一つだけ、目覚ましい品物が混ざっていた。一体こんな三下がどこから手に入れてきたのか、綺麗に磨き上げられた真鍮の、細工も美しい二段の折り畳み式の、それは望遠鏡。古めかしい代物だが傷みも見えず、工芸品の風格さえまとってあった。
　この逸品を鷹揚にも朔屋へ与えて惜しむ様子もない泪こそ、真に豊かな者と言えたろう。あるいはその優美な細工物さえ、泪の心を動かすに至らなかっただけかも知れないが。
source.english:
The bag held a little money and little else of value, but among the rubbish lay one remarkable object. Where in the world had such a third-rate fellow acquired it? Polished brass, exquisitely worked, built to collapse in two sections: a telescope. Old-fashioned, yet unmarred by wear, it possessed even the dignity of a work of art.
That Rui could bestow such a treasure upon Sakuya with grand unconcern and no sign of regret made her, one might say, the truly wealthy one. Or perhaps not even this graceful piece of workmanship had been enough to stir her heart.

source.japanese: 鬼島はその後下級水夫達の手によって縛り上げられ船外にと連れ出され、どこかに打ち捨てられたようだが仔細は知らぬ、朔屋としてもどうでもいい。ただ朔屋は、泪に一つの借りを作った事を自覚して重たい気分の、恩に酬いようとする心根くらいは持ち合わせていても、その機会がこんな修羅場でなければいいと今から恐れているあたり、やはりこの青年はなんとも度し難い。
source.english: Afterward, junior sailors bound Onijima and took him off the ship. Apparently he was dumped somewhere; Sakuya did not know the details and did not care. What weighed on him was the knowledge that he now owed Rui a favor. He possessed at least the decency to wish to repay a kindness, yet already feared that the occasion might arise amid another scene of carnage. Incorrigible to the end.

target.text: There was nothing of particular value in the bag, just a bit of spare change, with the exception of a single remarkable article. Where had a third-rate like him even gotten his grubby hands on this? It was made of exquisitely polished brass, two-draw collapsible, and with beautiful craftsmanship: a telescope. It seemed like an antique article, but it also showed no signs of wear, and it even possessed the grace of a work of art.

Rui, who showed not a single shadow of regret from having so generously bestowed such a rare masterpiece unto Sakuya, could truly be called affluent. Or perhaps it was simply that even the beautiful elegance of this handiwork was not enough to stir Rui's heart, he couldn't say.

Later, Kijima was tied up by the deck boys and dragged off the ship, apparently dumped somewhere, not that he knew the details, and not that Sakuya really cared at all. However, Sakuya, having realized that he had now incurred a debt with Rui, was left in a melancholy mood, and while he was possessed of the disposition to at least attempt to repay any debts of gratitude he owed, with dread in his heart, he only hoped that the opportunity would not present itself during a violent situation like this one; this young man truly was incorrigible.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「ところで泪さん、さっきのチンピラ引っかけた、イカサマって言うのはいったどんなものなんです。俺にはあなたがカードをいじった様子なんて見えなかったんだが」
source.english: “By the way, Rui, what sort of cheating did you use to catch that hoodlum? I never saw you tamper with the cards.”

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「By the way, Rui-san, that cheat you used to pull a fast one on that goon earlier, what in the world was it? I didn't see any signs of you messing with the cards at all.」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「そういう種明かしなんて、
　ほんとは不粋で好まないけれど。
　直さんは、それでは納得いかないご様子」
source.english:
“Revealing the trick is really rather graceless.
I don't care for it.
But you won't be satisfied without an explanation, will you, Nao?”

target.text: 【Rui】 「To reveal such tricks is not something I am fond of, for it is quite boorish. But you do not seem content with that alone, Nao-san.」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「簡単な事よ。
　要は中味のすり替えね」
source.english:
“It's simple.
Essentially, a substitution.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「It is quite simple, really. In short, we swapped the contents.」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「あの方、新しく切ったデッキは、ご自分が持ってきたものだ、ってそう思いこんでいらしたようだけれど」
source.english: “He seemed convinced the newly opened deck was the one he had brought.”

source.japanese:
【泪】
「そのデッキが、わたくしたちが先に用意してあったモノだ、としたなら？」
source.english: “But what if it was one we had prepared beforehand?”

target.text: 【Rui】 「That man seemed convinced that the freshly-opened deck was one brought here by his own hand, however.」
【Rui】 「If that deck, say, were to be one that we had prepared in advance, what then?」

source.japanese:
【泪】
「もちろん、色々と仕込んだデッキでね」
source.english: “A deck loaded with all sorts of tricks, of course.”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「そりゃあ……あの男が、多少何枚かカードをサポーターに仕込んだところで、勝てるわけがない……」
source.english: “Then… There was no way he could win just by hiding a few cards in his sweatbands…”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「しかし、一体いつの間に、そんなすり替えなんてやったんだ」
source.english: “But when on earth did you make a swap like that?”

target.text: 【Rui】 「Of course, it was a deck that we had prepared with plenty of tricks.」
【Naomasa】 「In that case……even if that guy had a bunch of cards hidden in his wristbands, he could never win……」
【Naomasa】 「But just when did you even find the time to make that swap?」

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「君、覚えていませんか。
　ゲームを始める前に、水夫君があの男の鞄に触れた事を」
source.english:
“Don't you remember?
Before the game began, one of our junior sailors touched the man's bag.”

source.japanese: 言われてみればなるほど、下級水夫が鬼島を乗船客かと勘違いしてバッグを運んでいこうとした、あれは、勘違いなどではなく、そもそも仕込みはその段階で為されていたということか。
source.english: Now that he mentioned it—yes. A junior sailor had seemingly mistaken Onijima for a passenger and tried to carry his bag. Then it had been no mistake at all. The substitution had already taken place.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「あっ。あの時にか。
　でもあん時だって、ほんの一瞬で───」
source.english:
“Oh! Then?
But that was only an instant—”

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「Do you not remember? How just before the game started, the young sailor touched that man's bag.」

Now that he mentioned it, indeed, the deck boy had mistaken Kijima for a passenger and made to carry his bags for him; and that was not a mistake, rather, the scheme had already been underway since that very moment?
【Naomasa】 「Ah. So it was back then? But when that happened, it really was just a brief moment───」

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「うちの水夫君達には、指先が器用な子もいるという事だよ。あの鬼島氏より余程筋が良い子が、ね」
source.english: “Some of our sailors have deft fingers. One of them has far more talent than Mr. Onijima, you see.”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「それにしたところで、あいつがどの会社のデッキを持ってくるのか、なんで事前に判ったんだ？」
source.english: “Even so, how'd you know beforehand which company's deck he'd bring?”

source.japanese: 泪の話を聞くにつれ、種明かしと思われたものが全然そうではなく、聞けば聞くほどに謎が深まっていくのだった。
source.english: As he listened, what had seemed an explanation proved no explanation at all. The more he heard, the deeper the mystery grew.

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「It is simply that our sailors are all possessed of very nimble fingers. They certainly have a much greater aptitude for such things than that Mr. Kijima, yes?」
【Naomasa】 「But if that's the case, then how did you know what brand of deck he'd bring with him before he even showed up?」
As he listened to Rui's explanation, he certainly did not feel like the trick had been revealed at all; in fact, the more he heard, the deeper the mystery grew in turn.

source.japanese:
【泪】
「その辺りのことまでは、
　教えて差し上げられません。
　ご自分でお考えなさい、ね、直さん」
source.english:
“I cannot tell you quite that much.
Work it out for yourself, Nao.”

target.text: 【Rui】 「I am afraid that my lips must remain sealed regarding that particular mystery. Think on it yourself, Nao-san.」

source.japanese:
【機関長】
「まあ兎を追っていた狐が、狩人の罠に陥るという事なぞ、よくある話だよ」
source.english: “Well, foxes chasing rabbits fall into hunters' traps often enough.”

source.japanese: そういって静かに穏やかに微笑する機関長と泪こそ、あの三下博徒なぞ最初から敵いもしない、余程始末に負えない魔物としか朔屋には思えず。
source.english: The engineer and Rui smiled quietly, serenely. To Sakuya they seemed nothing less than monsters, far more troublesome than that third-rate gambler. Onijima had never stood a chance against them.

target.text: 【Chief Engineer】 「Chasing the hare, the fox fell into the hunter's trap. A common tale.」

Saying that while smiling with such quiet serenity, Rui and the Chief Engineer only seemed to Sakuya like monsters far beyond his ability to handle, and well beyond anything the likes of that third-rate gambler could ever hope to stand a fighting chance against.

source.japanese: なおあの鬼島だが、この数日後に港町外れの倉庫の中で息も絶え絶えになっているところを倉庫番に発見され、信天翁号の存在を往生際悪く小癪にも官憲に注進に及んだ。もとより官憲からもお尋ね者の信天翁号は、既に港をよろよろと出て行った後ではあるが、その航跡を掴まれてしまった事には変わりなく、後日官憲からも追われる羽目となる───
source.english: Onijima, incidentally, was found several days later by a watchman, barely breathing in a warehouse on the town's outskirts. With spiteful persistence even at the bitter end, he informed the authorities of the Albatross's presence. Already wanted, the ship had by then staggered out of port. The authorities had nevertheless picked up her trail, and in time would give chase—

target.text: Furthermore, on the topic of Kijima: he was discovered feeble of breath a few days later in a warehouse on the outskirts of the port town by a warehouseman, and not knowing when to give up, decided to insolently report the Albatross to the authorities. The Albatross was already wanted by the authorities, and though it was only after they had already unsteadily drifted away from the port, it did not change the fact that the wake of their ship had been picked up, and a few days later, they would come to be pursued by the authorities as well───

source.japanese: <01>こらえて、口を噤んだ
source.english: Hold back and keep quiet.

target.text: <01>Endured, bit his tongue

source.japanese: <01>糾弾しようとした
source.english: Try to denounce him.

target.text: <01>Made to denounce the fraud

source.japanese: ───さて。朔屋が信天翁号に乗せられた経緯からして井戸入道に奈落の深みに引きずりこまれたかの観を呈[てい]していた訳だが。
source.english: Now, the circumstances that brought Sakuya aboard the Albatross had already suggested a man being dragged into the abyss by a demon from a well.

source.japanese: その後の日々をざっと辿り、点描してみればこれまでに語ったような情景、場面場面が浮き上がる。何かというと銃声やら生命の危機、そして悪漢に怪物といった極限的でピカレスクな状況が連続してなんとも刺激的、だが刺激といってツボを探って心地好いようなではなく、刺してくるのはどれもこれも致命の毒秘めた針先ばかりで、朔屋としてはこれまでを振り返る度、情景の背後に地獄の道化師の跳梁と哄笑を思わずにはいられない。
source.english: A quick survey of the days that followed gives us the scenes already related, picked out here and there: gunfire at the slightest provocation, mortal danger, villains, monsters—a succession of extreme, picaresque adventures. Stimulating, certainly. But not the pleasant stimulation of a finger finding a pressure point. Every needle that pricked him carried a lethal poison. Whenever Sakuya looked back, he could not help sensing the capering and raucous laughter of some clown from hell behind it all.

source.japanese: こんな破天荒な日々であっても航行距離にしてみれば、いっぱしの船乗りには近所の散歩に行く程度の航路で、なにしろまだ船は外海に出ていない。信天翁号は乗りこむ面子からして滅多矢鱈の寄せ集め、白い黄色いの人種不明なの、黒いのは猫くらいだからちと数に足りないが、その意味では実に国際色豊かな船であり、事実現れる先々も世界の津々浦々、こんな五浬[マイル]進むくらいでも機関が駄々をこね自然沈没を懸念せねばならないような船なのに、これで世界を股に掛けているというのだから滅法界に素敵な話だ。船の上を舞うアホウドリがどこまでもついてくるのだって頷[うなず]ける。あまりの素晴らしさにベタ惚れしているのだきっと。
source.english: For all these outrageous days, the distance traveled amounted to a stroll around the neighborhood for a proper sailor. They had not even reached the open sea. The Albatross's crew was a thoroughly indiscriminate collection: white, yellow, of indeterminate race. Only the cat was black, which left that contingent a little underrepresented, but in this respect she was a most international vessel. And she did, in fact, turn up in every corner of the world. A ship whose engine threw tantrums over a mere five nautical miles, whose spontaneous sinking was a constant concern, nevertheless ranged the globe. What an extraordinarily splendid tale. No wonder the albatrosses wheeling overhead followed her everywhere. They must have been hopelessly in love with her sheer magnificence.

source.japanese:
その手広く貿易業を執りおこなって御座る船が現在燻[くすぶ]っているのは、瀬戸内と呼ばれた風光明媚な沿岸海域で、もちろん朔屋にはどれだけ景色に彩りが溢れていようと目を向けていられた余裕なぞあろう筈もない。
　潮風は人間の体にとって健やかな作用及ぼすというし、内海の牧歌的な眺めは目に快く、これで一般的な貨物船あたりの水夫働きを続けていたなら、朔屋の如き社会の落伍者であっても四肢はそれなりに鍛えられ、心にもいくらか真っ当な活気を植えた事であろう。
　だが朔屋にとっては、酒浸りに女の肉を追っかけていた日々よりもっと体と心を損なう危難の連続で、無精髯を当たろうと裏の水銀剥[は]げた鏡を覗く度、目の下の隈がより濃くこずんでいくように思われてならず。
source.english:
This vessel, engaged in the noble business of far-flung commerce, was presently languishing in the picturesque coastal waters called the Seto Inland Sea. Sakuya, of course, had no leisure to admire their colors.
Sea air is said to be good for the human body, and the inland sea's pastoral vistas were easy on the eye. Had he been working aboard an ordinary freighter, even a social failure like Sakuya might have strengthened his limbs and acquired a little wholesome vigor of mind.
Instead, one peril followed another, doing more damage to his body and spirit than his days of drinking and chasing women's flesh. Whenever he peered into a mirror with its mercury backing peeling away to shave his stubble, the shadows beneath his eyes seemed to have settled a little deeper.

source.japanese:
それが古参の船員達に言わせれば、『子供の遣い』程度の片手間仕事で、船乗りとしての勘が鈍っちまいそうだ、と。では何故信天翁号がそんな微温湯の中に甘んじているかというと。
　後から下級水夫の一人に事情を耳打ちされて、またぞろ朔屋の船からの脱走への熱が再燃しかかったのだが。
source.english:
