He was well past the point of caring who saw them. After all, the only one who was allowed to do this to Kuro, the only one capable of doing this to Kuro, yes, it was only he himself. He may have been the newcomer on the Albatross, but he wouldn't let any of the others do something like this. Not that they ever could in the first place.
【Naomasa】 （Why? Because all of you guys are the kinds of people who can actually do what has to be done…… unlike me or Kuro……）

A devastatingly acute self-awareness of his own weakness. In a sense, Sakuya's resilience lies in the fact that he can harbour this realization and still laugh it off by indulging in booze and woman, and yet that does not mean his weakness is conquered, nor has it remedied his ineptitude. While Sakuya's incompetence is, in large part, something drawn to him by fate, precisely because of that, there are aspects of it which cannot be truly rectified.

Sakuya had in Kuro discovered something that he also possessed. Something the Bosun, the first mates, or Rui could never hope to fully understand: the pathetic, almost servile wretchedness of the weak; on this ship, he was the only one who could instruct her in how to navigate that moving forwards, Sakuya mused, hugging Kuro's shoulders as they heaved with sobs; for now, he decided to take her a little ways away from the others. Because in times like these, just the sheer body temperature and breathing of so many people alone can be enough to make you feel like a creature so wretched you want to die.
To the Bosun, who was about to say something to Sakuya and Kuro as they were about to move into the adjoining room, Sakuya said:
【Naomasa】 「……I'm very sorry. We……were a little thoughtless. Uhm, I'll ask what we should do a little later.」
【Naomasa】 「So for now, I'm gonna go calm Kuro down for a bit, at least.」

Honestly, he already had a very good idea as to what exactly he was going to be made to do. And it was no wonder he found the thought of it terrifying. It might be best to get asking about something scary over with quickly, but right now, what mattered was comforting Kuro. After doing nothing but fawning obsequiously, Sakuya then moved Kuro and himself into the adjoining room, shielding them from everyone's eyes.

source.japanese: 苦虫を噛み潰したような水夫長に、キサラが見せたのは皮肉げな、それでいて物事噛み分けたような苦笑だ。
source.english: Long looked as though he had bitten into something bitter. Kisara gave him a wry smile, ironic yet knowing.

source.japanese:
【キサラ】
「悪役、お疲れ様。水夫長。
　水夫長の長の字は、
　伊達じゃないってわけだ」
source.english:
“Good work playing the villain,
Boatswain.
Guess you're not head of the crew for nothing.”

target.text: What Kisara flashed the Bosun, who looked as if he'd been sucking a lemon, was a wry smile: ironic, and yet deeply knowing.
【Kisara】 「Thanks for the effort you put into playing the villain, Bosun. Looks like we don't call you bosun for nothing.」

source.japanese:
【水夫長】
「くだらねえ……名誉挽回の機会？
　知った事かよ」
source.english:
“Bullshit… A chance to make up for it?
What do I care?”

source.japanese: 唾と共に吐き捨てて、水夫長は禿頭をばりばりと掻[か]いて、床にどっかと腰を落として胡座組み、舞い上がった埃の中でいよいよ厳めしく口元をへしゃげさせる。
source.english: Spitting the words, he scratched his bald head vigorously, dropped onto the floor and sat cross-legged. Amid the rising dust, his mouth twisted more forbiddingly still.

target.text: 【Bosun】 「Ridiculous…… this a chance to redeem myself? See if I give a shit.」

The Bosun spat that out with a lump of saliva, vigorously scratched his bald head, then dropped to the floor with a heavy thump and crossed his legs, pulling his mouth into an increasingly stern frown amidst the swirling dust.

source.japanese: と、こちらは、持てる者、できる者の理論だった。
source.english: That was the reasoning of those who had, and those who could.

target.text: But, this was the theory of the haves, of the capable.

source.japanese: ───逃げこんだ廃屋に満ちた、焦燥感と苦しげな息遣いが、中に敗残兵の収容所じみた様相をもたらしていた───
source.english: The abandoned house into which they had fled was thick with desperation and labored breathing, giving it the air of a camp for the remnants of a defeated army.

source.japanese: 皆一様に荒い息で、肩を壊れる寸前の鞴[ふいご]の様に上下させているが、呼吸の乱れはしつこく残り、なかなか去ってくれようとしない。これまで知らざる恐怖との邂逅が皆の体力気力を鑿[のみ]を当てたように奪っていた。
source.english: All of them gasped, shoulders pumping like bellows on the verge of breaking. Their breath refused to settle. The encounter with a terror none had known before had chiseled away their strength and spirit.

source.japanese: 乱れた呼吸で肺と喉が炉の中のように灼けて、肌一面が天火に炙[あぶ]られたかのよう、なのに夥[おびただ]しく伝う汗は、身体を損ねてしまいそうなくらい悪く冷たい。
source.english: Every ragged breath scorched their throats and lungs as though inside a furnace. Their skin felt roasted in an oven, yet the sweat streaming over it was viciously cold, cold enough to do them harm.

target.text: ───The feeling of impatient unease and laboured breathing that filled the abandoned building wherein they had taken refuge gave it the appearance of an internment camp housing the remnants of a defeated army───

They all breathed heavily as one, their shoulders rising and falling like a bellows on the verge of breaking, but their erratic breathing stubbornly persisted, showing no signs of readily taking its leave. Their chance encounter with a horror they had never known of hitherto had deprived them of the strength of mind and body alike as though had it been scraped away at by a chisel.

Their ragged breathing made it feel as if their lungs and throat were being heated up inside a furnace, like the whole surface of their skin was being roasted in an oven, and yet the copious amounts of sweat trickling down was so awfully cold that it might even be harmful to the body.

source.japanese: ───大海蛇から逃れた、といってもその場しのぎに過ぎないという事実が、それぞれの肩に重く粘くへばりついていた。
source.english: They had escaped the great sea serpent—but only for the moment. The knowledge clung stubbornly to every pair of shoulders, heavy and clammy.

source.japanese:
裏街道の悪党どもをせせら笑い、立ちはだかるものがあれば鉄火と暴力で薙ぎ倒し、時には裏をかいて逃げ道を掠め取ってきた信天翁号の面子にして、初めて遭遇する劫初の恐怖だった。
　性質としてはシサム・キサラが出くわした大怪魚悪婁に近しいが、あれより遙かに陰湿で貪欲で凶猛で残酷で、邪神のような邪悪ささえ纏[まと]うていたことを、遭遇した者全員肌感覚で、そしてそれより深い本能で感じ取っていた。
source.english:
The Albatross's crew had jeered at the villains of the underworld, swept aside whatever opposed them with gunfire and brute force, and at times outwitted their enemies to snatch a path of escape. Here, for the first time, they had met a terror from the beginning of the world.
In nature it resembled Akuru, the monstrous fish Sisam and Kisara had encountered. But it was incomparably more insidious, greedy, savage and cruel, possessed even of the wickedness of an evil god. Everyone who had seen it knew as much in their skin, and in an instinct deeper still.

target.text: ───Though one could say that they had escaped the great sea serpent, the reality that it was nothing but a mere stopgap was a persistent heaviness weighing down on each pair of shoulders present.

For the Albatross and her crew, they who had always mocked any scoundrels from the backstreets of life with scornful smirks, mowed down any who dared stand in their way with violence and gunfire, and at times outwitted them to snatch a means of escape, this encounter with a primordial horror was the first of its kind. In terms of nature, it was similar to the enormous legendary fish Akuru that Shisamu and Kisara had come across, but this one was more devious, ravenous, fierce, and ruthless by far, clad even in a wickedness akin to that of a malevolent deity; all of the crew who had encountered it sensed it on their skin, as well as with instincts that lay even deeper than that.

source.japanese: ───太古から生き続けてきた、人間より古い、理解を拒[こば]む根源的恐怖。
source.english: A creature that had lived on since remote antiquity. Older than mankind. A fundamental terror that refused to be understood.

source.japanese: あれは、そういうモノだ。
source.english: That was what it was.

target.text: ───It had survived since prehistoric times, more ancient than humanity itself, a primordial horror that defied understanding.
That was the sort of being that thing was.

source.japanese:
【水夫長】
「あれが……あんなのが、この島の動物達の最後の生き残りかよ……」
source.english: “That thing… A thing like that is the last survivor of all this island's animals…?”

target.text: 【Bosun】 「That……you're telling me THAT thing is the last survivor of the animals of this island……?」

source.japanese:
下級水夫達からの無言の糾弾と非難の目に耐えかねて、角隅にクロを連れてしゃがみこむ朔屋の前に、航海士の編み上げの長靴が床の軋みも酷薄に立ちはだかる。
　胸ぐら掴み取られて顔面蹴球の球と腫れ上がるまで殴打の嵐か、さもなくば長靴の爪先で肋[あばら]を全て粉砕するまで蹴り込まれるか、いずれにせよ仕置きと痛めつけられることは間違いなく、朔屋は長靴とミニスカートの間の太腿を鑑賞する気力はおろか、目を上げることさえできなかった。
source.english:
Unable to bear the junior sailors' silent, accusing eyes, Sakuya crouched in a corner with Kuro. A navigator's lace-up boots stopped before him, their tread wringing a merciless creak from the floorboards.
She might seize him by the collar and batter his face until it swelled like a soccer ball, or grind the toes of those boots into him until every rib was powder. One way or another, punishment and pain were certain. He had no strength left to admire the thighs between boots and miniskirt; he could not even raise his eyes.

target.text: Unable to bear the wordless condemnation and accusatory glares of the deck boys, Sakuya had taken Kuro with him into a corner of the room and crouched down, but even the creaking of the floorboards produced by the high-laced boots of the first mate cruelly confronted Sakuya, blocking his way.

Would he be hoisted by the collar and suffer a storm of blows until his face was swollen like a football, or would he instead be kicked with the toe of her boot until every one of his ribs were crushed to powder; either way, he'd doubtless be subject to some manner of punishment or torment, and not only did Sakuya lack the willpower to appreciate the thighs on display in the gap between her boots and miniskirt, he had not even the energy to look up.

source.japanese: 航海士が身じろぐ気配に、のろのろとクロを背中にかいこむ。どうせこの白子の少女とて、程度の差はあっても朔屋と同様の目に遭わされるだろうが、それを目の当たりにするのはあまりに辛く、順番が後回しになれば恐怖もより募る。
source.english: When the navigator shifted, he slowly tucked Kuro behind his back. The albino girl would probably suffer much the same fate, if to a different degree. He could not bear to watch it, while making her wait longer for her turn would only deepen the terror.

target.text: Sensing the first mate begin to stir, he slowly drew Kuro closer to his back. This albino girl would surely suffer the same fate as Sakuya, albeit perhaps to a lesser degree; to witness it would be too agonizing to bear, and the longer he put it off, the more frightening the thought would become.

source.japanese:
朔屋もクロも怯えきっていたから、自分達へ叩きつけられめりこんでくる拳足がとりあえずはないのにも気づかず俯[うつむ]いたままだったから、航海士はしまいに焦れてどん、と脚を踏み鳴らした。
　それだけでも朔屋の睾丸は痛いほど体内に縮み上がったし、クロなどは一つ大きく身を震わせてから、朔屋の背中に額を押し当ていやいやとぐずぐず涙したほど。
source.english:
Both were so terrified that they kept their heads down, never noticing that, for the moment, no fist or boot was driving into either of them. At last the navigator lost patience and stamped.
That alone sent Sakuya's testicles retreating painfully into his body. Kuro gave one great shudder, pressed her forehead to his back and whimpered through her tears, no, no.

target.text: Both Sakuya and Kuro were so utterly terrified, they did not even notice that there were no fists or feet being slammed or lodged into them for the time being; they instead just kept hanging their heads, so finally growing impatient, the first mate stomped her foot down with a loud bang. Even that alone was enough to make Sakuya's testicles crawl painfully high up into his body, and the likes of Kuro, after a violent shudder ran through her entire body, was reduced to weeping hysterically while pressing her brow against Sakuya's back.

source.japanese: 大海蛇は大海蛇として、今は眼前の女の方が間近に迫った大いなる危機、恐ろしくて仕方なかったが、無視を決めこんだところで状況が打開されるわけもなく、その上とうとう焦れきったか、航海士が太腿のガンベルトから回転式弾倉抜き払い、撃鉄まで起こしてきたので、泡を食って顔を上げる。
source.english: The serpent was one thing. This woman, looming right before him, was the more immediate danger, and he was desperately afraid. But pretending she did not exist would solve nothing. Finally she drew the revolver from the gun belt around her thigh and cocked it. He looked up in a panic.

target.text: While the great sea serpent was one thing, right now, the woman standing before him posed the much greater, imminent threat, but though he was consumed by dread, simply pretending it wasn't happening would do nothing to resolve the situation, and on top of that, perhaps she had finally lost the last vestiges of her patience, for the first mate pulled the revolver from the gun belt around her thigh and even cocked the hammer, which made him lift his head in a panic.

source.japanese: これで自分の頭をぶち抜いてケリをつけろと拳銃を押しつけられたわけでもなく、腹をかき切れと船員ナイフを握らされたわけでもなく、航海士が差し出してきていたのは、ごしゃごしゃとした布の堆積、いや、イルカやオットセイの肌の質感、鼻先をついたのはゴム張りのきつい匂い、潜水夫が身に着けるような、ウェットスーツだった。
source.english: She was not thrusting the gun upon him with instructions to blow his brains out and settle the matter. Nor handing him a sailor's knife to slit his belly. What she held out was a crumpled heap of cloth—no, something with the texture of dolphin or fur-seal skin. A strong rubber smell struck his nose. A wetsuit, of the sort a diver might wear.

target.text: But it wasn't like he had a gun thrust at him while being told to blow his brains out to settle things, and neither did he have a sailor's knife shoved into his hand while being told to slit open his own stomach; what the first mate was presenting to him was a messy pile of tangled cloth, no, it was something with the texture of the skin of a dolphin or a fur seal, and the harsh smell of rubber hit his nose; it was a wet suit, the kind a diver would wear.

source.japanese:
【シサム】
「……島の根っこの部分が気になったんでね。
　後で潜[もぐ]ってみるつもりだった。
　もうそんな必要もないわけだけど」
source.english:
“…I was curious about the bottom of the island.
Thought I'd dive down later and look.
No need now, of course.”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「で、こいつを着て、あの化け物の前を横切ってこい、と」
source.english: “So I'm supposed to wear this and walk past that monster.”

source.japanese:
樹脂製のウェットスーツ、絶縁の。
　朔屋にしては呑みこみよく理解して、浮かべた笑みは安堵からではない、もっと捨て鉢な、殴りつけてやりたくなるように荒んでいた。実際つい拳を握りしめたほどである。
source.english:
A synthetic wetsuit. An insulator.
Unusually quick on the uptake, Sakuya understood. His smile held no relief; it was a desperate, ugly thing that made the navigator want to hit him. Indeed, she caught herself clenching a fist.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「あのさ。素直に俺を生贄にしてさ、俺があれに食われちゃってる隙にみんなが走ったほうが早いんじゃないの？」
source.english: “Look. Wouldn't it be quicker just to sacrifice me, then all make a run for it while it's eating me?”

target.text: 【Shisamu】 「……I was curious about the foundation of the island. Was planning on giving diving under it a shot later. Not that there's any need for that at this point.」
【Naomasa】 「So, you're telling me to put this on and walk right past that monster?」

A synthetic polymer wet suit, an insulating one. This was a case of Sakuya being unusually quick on the uptake, but the smile he wore was not one born of relief; it was something far more desperate, frayed with a wild urge to lash out and strike something. To the point he was actually unintentionally balling his fists.
【Naomasa】 「Look. Isn't it faster if you just skip the nonsense and offer me as a sacrifice, and while I'm being eaten by that thing, you all make your escape?」

source.japanese:
【キサラ】
「あたしらを信じろ、朔屋。
　確かにあんたとクロを囮にはするけど、
　あんたらを見捨てたり、
　見殺しにはしない」
source.english:
“Trust us, Sakuya.
Yes, we'll use you and Kuro as decoys.
But we won't abandon you.
We won't leave you to die.”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「はっはっは、俺も他人の事は言えないが、
　あんたらを信じろと？」
source.english:
“Ha, ha, ha. Not that I'm one to talk,
but you want me to trust you?”

target.text: 【Kisara】 「Have some faith in us, Sakuya. Sure, we'll use you and Kuro as bait, but we won't abandon you, or just leave you to die.」
【Naomasa】 「Ha-ha-ha. I'm also not one to talk here, but you're telling me to have faith in YOU?」

source.japanese:
【シサム】
「べったべたと疑い深い奴だなあ。
　じゃあこう言えばいいか？」
source.english:
“God, you do cling to suspicion.
Would this put it better?”

target.text: 【Shisamu】 「Damn, you are incredibly paranoid. Fine, how about I put it this way?」

source.japanese:
【シサム】
「あんたらを囮に使って、それでようやく勝ちの目も出てくるんだ。あんたらがもしやられちまったら、あたしら、万に一つの目もなくなる」
source.english: “We’ll use you as bait—that’s the only way we’ve got a sliver of a chance. If you get taken out, we won’t have the slightest chance.”

target.text: 【Shisamu】 「We're using you two as bait, and it's only because of that we even have a chance of pulling through. Should you two get taken out, we also lose that one-in-a-million chance.」

source.japanese:
【キサラ】
「後はあの淫獣に、
　全員後をレイプされてお終いさぁ」
source.english:
“After that, that lustful beast will rape all of us up the ass,
and that’ll be the end of it.”

target.text: 【Kisara】 「After that, we'll all be raped in the ass by that dick monster, and that'll be the end of us.」

source.japanese:
【キサラ】
「一蓮托生、ってわけだ。
　どうだ、少しは道理が見えたかい？」
source.english:
“We’re in this together, then.
Well, do you see the logic in it now?”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「一応もっともらしくは聞こえるけど。
　なんか俺、騙されてない？」
source.english:
“It sounds reasonable enough.
But aren't you putting one over on me?”

target.text: 【Kisara】 「We're all in the same boat here is what we're saying. So, is it starting to make a little sense now?」
【Naomasa】 「It does kind of sound reasonable, at least. But I'm being tricked here somehow, aren't I?」

source.japanese:
【シサム】
「大丈夫。お前みたいに馬鹿が過ぎると、
　騙す騙されるどころじゃなくなる。
　下手すると騙そうとしたほうが、
　阿呆みたいなしっぺ返しを喰らう事になる」
source.english:
“Don't worry. With someone as stupid as you,
tricking and being tricked don't come into it.
Anyone who tried to fool you could wind up
on the receiving end of some idiotic backlash.”

target.text: 【Shisamu】 「Don't worry. When someone's as exceedingly stupid as you are, it's not even a matter of tricking or being tricked anymore. If you aren't careful when you try to trick someone like that, it'll just end up backfiring and make you look like the idiot instead.」

source.japanese:
【水夫長】
「そろそろええな？
　こうしてる間にもヤツぁどこをぬたくり通ってくるのかわからんのだ」
source.english:
“We ready, then?
While we stand here, there's no telling which way that thing's slithering.”

target.text: 【Bosun】 「Can you get going already? We've got no idea where that thing might be wriggling around while we're just standing here.」

source.japanese:
【水夫長】
「それに朔屋、そのスーツなら、たといあの化け物にカマをほじられようとも、少しは防いでくれるだろう」
source.english: “Besides, Sakuya, with that suit, even if that monster tries to ream you out, it’ll offer at least some protection.”

target.text: 【Bosun】 「Also, Sakuya, as long as you're wearing that suit, should that monster try to rearrange your guts, it should offer some protection.」

source.japanese:
【シサム】
「行っておいで、朔屋」
source.english: “Go on, Sakuya.”

target.text: 【Shisamu】 「Off you go, Sakuya.」

source.japanese:
【キサラ】
「せいぜい派手に囮をやってねぇ」
source.english: “Do try to put on a flashy show as the decoy.”

target.text: 【Kisara】 「You better make one hell of a scene out there as bait, yeah?」

source.japanese:
【下級水夫】
「朔屋さん、ファイトー！」
source.english: “Sakuya, go for it!”

target.text: 【Deck boy】 「Fight, Sakuya-san, fight!」

source.japanese:
【下級水夫】
「僕らのお尻を護る為、頑張れーっ」
source.english: “Do your best to save our butts!”

target.text: 【Deck boy】 「Do your best out there to protect our buuuutts!」

source.japanese:
【直正】
（簡単に言ってくれるよなあ。
　俺ぁ駆けっこはビリから数えた方が早かッたっつうのに……）
source.english:
(Easy for them to say.
In a footrace, you'd find my place quicker by counting from the back…)

source.japanese:
【直正】
「クロ……行こうか。
　どうにも納得はいかなくっても、
　世の中ってのは───」
source.english:
“Kuro… Let's go.
It doesn't make any sense to me either,
but the world…”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「……そんなものでしかないみたいだ」
source.english: “…doesn't seem to have much more sense to offer.”

target.text: 【Naomasa】 （You all make it sound so easy. But it was always quicker to find my placement in a sprint by counting from last place……）
【Naomasa】 「Kuro……let's go, shall we? Even if there's no way in hell I can accept this, that's just how the world───」
【Naomasa】 「……It sure seems like that's all the world has in store for me.」

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「……なっとくが、いかないのが、
　よのなか……」
source.english:
“…The world's…
what doesn't make sense…”

source.japanese: 朔屋に手を取られて、逆らいもせず、というより引かれるままのクロ、何事かを考えていた。一心に考えて考えて、クロが辿り着く答えは、多分。彼女にとっては苦い味になるだろう。
source.english: Sakuya took her hand, and Kuro went where he led without resistance. She was thinking. Thinking and thinking with all her heart. Whatever answer she reached would probably taste bitter to her.

target.text: 【Kuro】 「……No way……you can accept this, but all the world……」

Hand taken by Sakuya, Kuro offered no resistance, rather, she just let herself be led away, thinking about something or other. She thought and thought with all her heart, and the answer Kuro was arriving at was, probably. Something that would leave a bitter taste in her mouth.

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「やっぱり……クロは」
source.english: “After all… Kuro's…”

target.text: 【Kuro】 「Knew it, Kuro is……」

source.japanese: クロの内心にどんな思いが去来しているのか、言葉として表せなくともその想いの味は朔屋にも伝わって、舌に苦い。
source.english: Whatever was passing through her mind, however unable she was to put it into words, Sakuya could taste the feeling. Bitter on his tongue.

source.japanese:
まともな装備と物資に乏しい信天翁号の事である。単純に大人二人分を用意できなかっただけの事かも知れない。
　それでも───
source.english:
This was the ill-equipped, ill-supplied Albatross. Perhaps they simply had not been able to provide equipment for two adults.
Even so—

source.japanese:
ウェットスーツは二つ有ったけれど、大人用の物は一つ。残りは、クロでも着用できそうな程に小さい物。
　偶然と言ってしまえばそれまで。
　だがそれがしつこく朔屋の心に引っかかったし、クロの内部が少しずつ変容しつつあるのも気にかかる。
source.english:
There had been two wetsuits. One for an adult. The other small enough for Kuro.
Call it coincidence and that was that. But the thought would not leave Sakuya.
Nor could he stop worrying about the change slowly taking place within her.

source.japanese: 愚かで力足らずではあったけれど、それでもクロは彼女なりに『善き人生』を希求して、前に歩む力と為していた。
source.english: Foolish and weak though she was, Kuro had still wished, in her own way, for a good life. That wish had given her the strength to go forward.

target.text: Though Kuro did not put into words the thoughts running through her mind, the taste of those feelings were felt by Sakuya as well, acrid on his tongue.
This was the Albatross, which always lacked proper equipment and supplies. It could simply be that they were unable to provide for two adults. But even so───

They had two wet suits, but only one was adult-sized. The remaining one was small enough for even Kuro to wear. You could just call it coincidence and let it be. But the thought continued to stubbornly niggle at the back of Sakuya's mind, and he was also concerned about the gradual changes happening inside Kuro.
Though stupid and lacking in strength, Kuro, in her own away, still yearned for a『good life』, and this became the strength that kept her moving forwards.

source.japanese: クロ───朔屋には、この白子の少女がノアの方舟から放たれた鴉[カラス]の、呪われて彷徨い続けた成れの果てなのだ、という事が完全に納得されたわけではない。
source.english: Kuro. Sakuya had not fully accepted that this albino girl was what remained of the crow released from Noah's ark, cursed to wander ever since.

source.japanese: クロ───時に神がかった操船能力を発揮し近づき難い相を垣間見せる時があったとしても、朔屋にとって彼女は、ちっぽけで痩せッぽちで、そして健気な、クロ、だった。
source.english: Kuro. Even if she sometimes displayed an uncanny mastery at the helm, sometimes let him glimpse something unapproachable, to him she was still little, skinny, plucky Kuro.

source.japanese:
その未成熟な身体を抱きもした。
　共に泣いた事もあった。
source.english:
He even held that immature body in his arms.
There were times when they cried together.

source.japanese: その少女の中から、抜け落ち流れ去っていく心がある、その後から現れつつある哀しい理解がある。
source.english: Something within that girl was falling away, flowing out of her. In its place a sorrowful understanding was beginning to appear.

source.japanese: 世界は残酷な物でしかないという事実。
source.english: The fact that the world was nothing but cruel.

target.text: Kuro───Sakuya had not yet been fully convinced that this albino girl was the mere shadow that the crow sent forth from Noah's Ark had been reduced to after being cursed and left ever to wander.

Kuro───even though there were times when she would exhibit godlike seamanship and show glimpses of a nature he found difficult to approach, in Sakuya's eyes, she was a tiny, skinny, and brave girl; that was Kuro to him.
He had made love to her immature body. They had even cried together.
Within that girl, a part of her heart was breaking off and drifting away, and a miserable understanding was gradually emerging in its wake.
The cold truth that the world is nothing but cruel.

source.japanese:
クロがそれを完全に受け入れてしまった時、彼女がどう変わってしまうのか───
　朔屋には、その結末が、あの大海蛇と同じくらいに恐ろしいことのように感じられてならず───
source.english:
What would Kuro become when she accepted that completely?
Sakuya could not help feeling that the answer might be as frightening as the great sea serpent itself.

target.text: And once Kuro had fully accepted that, how would she change─── To Sakuya, that final outcome seemed just as terrifying as that great sea serpent, filling him with an inescapable dread───

source.japanese:
木造建築の合間、通路と通路が合流してちょっとした広場のような間隙を為している地点で、大海蛇は縮まった蛭のようにじっとして、身じろぎもせずに。
　だが動かずにいるとはいえ、この前を横切って老人の海図があるという建物に向かうのは並大抵の覚悟では足らず、朔屋とクロは失禁寸前であった。
source.english:
Where the passages between wooden buildings joined into a small open space, the great sea serpent lay as still as a contracted leech.
But still or not, crossing before it to reach the building where the old man's chart supposedly lay required no ordinary resolve. Sakuya and Kuro were on the verge of wetting themselves.

source.japanese:
それでも進むしか他に道はなく、互いの存在をよすがとして、そろそろと歩み始める。
　眠っているのかなんなのか、動かない大海蛇の前を極力跫音と息を忍ばせて、横切っていく。慣れないスーツが動きを阻害し、ゴムの擦れる響きが二人の耳には万雷ほどにも巨大に響く。
source.english:
There was no way forward but through. Taking comfort in each other's presence, they began to creep past the motionless serpent—asleep, perhaps,
or whatever it was—holding their breath and placing each foot in silence. The unfamiliar suits hampered them. Every squeak of rubber sounded in their ears like a thousand thunderclaps.

target.text: In a pause between the wooden buildings, a spot where the streets joined with other streets and came together to form a gap resembling a small plaza, like a contracted leech, the great sea serpent remained motionless, moving not even a muscle. But while it may not have been moving, your run-of-the-mill determination would fall short when faced with crossing right in front of it and heading for the building that supposedly contained the old man's chart, and both Sakuya and Kuro were on the verge of incontinence.

Nevertheless, there was no other way but forwards, and relying on each other's presence, they began to walk gingerly. Perhaps it was asleep or something of the sort; while doing their utmost to keep their footfalls and breaths as quiet as possible, they crossed in front of the motionless great sea serpent. The unfamiliar suits hindered their movements, and the squeaks of the rubber chafing roared like heavy thunder in their ears.

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「しぃ───っ」
source.english: “Shhhh…”

target.text: 【Kuro】 「Sshh───」

source.japanese:
【直正】
「しぃー……っ」
source.english: “Shhh…!”

source.japanese:
低くお互いの息遣いを鎮め合い、一歩、一歩、踏みしめた足を抜いて、差しこむように進めて、また一歩。
　溜まらない時間がのろのろと流れ、僅か数十米[メートル]の移動が万里の長城の踏破ほどにも二人の神経と体力を磨り減らし、目が回る、目が眩む、息が苦しい、心臓は内側から胸骨と肌をぶち破ってしまいそうに激しく乱打して、もう一歩も歩けない、今度こそ立ち止まってしまう、そんな際を破れかぶれの気力でか、臆病故の生き汚さでか、辛うじて乗り越えて、ようやく、遂に、とうとう、やっと、広場の端、海図の建物への通路の入口まで後数歩、まで至る。
source.english:
Softly they hushed each other's breathing. One step, another: lift the foot just set down, ease it forward, one more step.
Time crawled intolerably. Crossing a few dozen meters wore down their nerves and strength like traversing the Great Wall—dizzy, faint, unable to breathe, hearts battering as if to burst through breastbone and skin; not one more step, this time they would stop. Yet at each breaking point something carried them through: desperate courage, perhaps, or a coward's sordid will to live. At last—finally, finally, finally—they reached the edge of the open space, a few steps from the passage to the building that held the chart.

source.japanese: ここまで来たなら、たとえ大海蛇が不意に動き出したとしても、通路には逃げこめると、朔屋はそろそろと背後に目をやったのが、傷となった。それも死に繋がる傷だ。
source.english: They had come far enough to reach the passage even if the serpent suddenly moved. Sakuya cautiously glanced back. That was his mistake. A fatal mistake.

source.japanese: 振り返れば大海蛇は今だ静止したままで、ほっと気が緩んだ、途端に足下の板の継ぎ目に爪先を取られ───
source.english: The serpent remained motionless. Relief loosened every muscle—and his toe caught in a gap between the boards.

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「Sshhー……」

They quietly hushed each other's breathing, and one step at a time, lifted a firmly planted foot, moved it forwards as through thrusting it into something, then took another step. This unbearable time flowed sluggishly, and travelling but a few dozens of metres wore down at their nerves and stamina as if they had traversed the Great Wall of China in its entirety.

They felt faint, dizzy, they almost couldn't breathe, heart racing so intensely it felt as if it might batter down their sternum and tear apart their skin from the inside, they couldn't take another step, this time they would come to a stop for sure; in those moments, whether through willpower sourced from sheer desperation or a base clinging to life born from cowardice, they barely managed to overcome it, and finally, at length, after everything, in the end, they had made it all the way to the end of the plaza, but a few steps remaining before they reached the entrance of the street leading to the building with the chart.

Now that they had come this far, even should the great sea serpent suddenly come alive, they could simply escape down the street, Sakuya thought, cautiously casting a glance behind him; that became his undoing. A fatal undoing at that.
When he looked back, the great sea serpent yet remained still, and he let his guard down in relief; just as he did, his toe caught on the joint of the boards beneath his feet───

source.english: “Ghh!?”

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「……WHA!?」

source.japanese: 蹴躓いた弾みで、長靴の隙間に差してあったあの望遠鏡が弾け飛び、がらんと床に落ちて転がっていった響きが巨大だった。しかも、大海蛇の鼻先から程遠からぬ位置に。
source.english: The stumble sent the telescope tucked into his boot flying. It hit the floor and rolled with an enormous clatter. Worse, it landed not far from the serpent's nose.

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「あ、だめ、それ朔屋さんの……っ」
source.english: “Oh, no, that's Mr. Sakuya's…!”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「ほっとけ、そんなの今は……っ」
source.english: “Leave it! Not now…!”

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「大丈夫、まだへいき……んしょ」
source.english: “It's all right. Still all right… Hup.”

source.japanese: よせばいいのに、望遠鏡を拾い上げるクロ、だがなんと幸運なことか、大海蛇は気づいた様子はない。
source.english: Kuro picked up the telescope. She should have left it alone. But what extraordinary luck: the serpent showed no sign of having noticed.

target.text: That telescope of his, which he had tucked into the gap in his boot, was sent flying from the momentum of his stumbling, and the clanging it made as it fell to the floor and rolled around was deafening. Moreover, it landed somewhere not too far from the tip of the great sea serpent's nose.
【Kuro】 「Ah, oh no, that's Sakuya-san's……」
【Naomasa】 「Leave it alone, right now that's not……」
【Kuro】 「It's fine, it's still okay……hup.」

She should have just let it be, but Kuro still picked the telescope up, and what manner of good fortune they must have been blessed with, for the great sea serpent showed no signs of having noticed anything.

source.japanese: ───かに見えて。
source.english: Or so it seemed.

target.text: ───Or so it seemed.

source.japanese: クロが背を向ける隙を待ち構えていたのだろう、青黒い、卑猥で、汚怪で、そして貪欲で凶猛な生命体の、動き出して、その様、クロと朔屋達、温血の生き物とはあまりに隔たっている故に、どこか神さびている、とも言えた。
source.english: It had probably been waiting for the instant Kuro turned her back. The bluish-black, obscene, hideous, greedy, ferocious life-form began to move. Its motion was so alien to Kuro, Sakuya and every other warm-blooded creature that it seemed almost numinous.

source.japanese:
だが、戦き見守るうちに、クロの背後に鎌首がゆっくりともたげられるを目にしてしまった朔屋にとっては、神も悪魔もあったものかで、胸掻きむしり、地団駄踏み、焦燥感に気が狂いそうに、いや狂う、今狂う、それくらい恐ろしいのに。
　実際、限度を越えた恐ろしさが、朔屋の神経の接続を狂わせたのだろう。
source.english:
As Sakuya watched in terror, its head slowly rose behind Kuro. God or devil, what did that matter? He clawed at his chest and stamped his feet, panic driving him mad—no, he was mad, he was going mad now, so great was his terror.
Perhaps fear beyond all limits had simply crossed the wiring in his nerves.

source.japanese:
あれ？　と朔屋は、首を傾げていた。
　なぜ自分の身体が前に進んでいるのだ？
　何故クロに向けて手を伸ばして───
　何故かは判らないけれど、何故だって良いではないか、むざむざ彼女を見捨てるよりは！　一度勢いが付いてしまえば、朔屋は自分の足が思っていたよりは随分と増しに走ってくれる事が有り難かった。
　疾走の勢いを利して、クロの腕を捕まえて、
source.english:
Huh? Sakuya wondered.
Why was his body moving forward?
Why was he reaching for Kuro—? He did not know.
But who cared why, if it was better than simply abandoning her? Once he had started, he was grateful to find his legs ran far better than he had supposed.
Running at full tilt, he caught her arm.

target.text: It must have been lying in wait for the moment Kuro turned her back, for that bluish-black, lewd, grotesque, as well as ravenously fierce life-form came alive, and the way it moved while it did was so far removed from Kuro, Sakuya, and all other warm-blooded life that one could even say it held an air of something divine.

However, as Sakuya watched on with trepidation, he caught sight of that head slowly rearing up in a serpentine curve behind Kuro's back; what did it matter to him if that thing was deity or devil? He clawed at his chest, stomped his feet, driven to the brink of madness by this burning anxiety, nay, he was going mad, he was losing his mind right this second, so terrifying was it. In reality, a terror that exceeded all limits must have disrupted Sakuya's neural connections.

"Huh?" Sakuya thought, tilting his head. Why was his own body moving forwards? Why was it reaching for Kuro─── He did not understand the why of it, but did it really matter why? It was better by far than just helplessly abandoning the girl! Once the momentum took over, Sakuya was thankful that his legs carried him far better than he had anticipated. Using the momentum of his sprint, he grabbed Kuro's arm,

source.japanese:
【直正】
「……駄目だったみたいだ。
　走れえええっっ！」
source.english:
“…Apparently it wasn't all right.
Run!”

source.japanese:
知っていた筈なのに、無我夢中の勢いがその軽さを失念させた、藁の束を抜いたような頼りなさで、勢い余って牛蒡抜きにクロの身体、宙に放り投げてしまいそうになる。掴む手は為さず、遊園地の遊具のように一回転、振り回して勢いをやっと殺して、横抱きに腕の中に収めて、一目散だ。
　望遠鏡はスーツの首から背中に押しこんだ、ごわごわするがもう落としてもいられない。
source.english:
He should have remembered how light she was, but the blind rush had driven it from his mind. Snatching her up felt like yanking a sheaf of straw from a bundle, and his own momentum nearly flung her bodily into the air. Without letting go, he swung her through a full circle like a fairground ride, finally killed their momentum, gathered her sideways into his arms and ran for his life.
He shoved the telescope down the neck of his suit and against his back. It dug into him, but he could not risk dropping it again.

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「お、おろして。クロ走れる。
　一人で走れる───」
source.english:
“P-put Kuro down. Kuro can run.
Can run alone—”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「無理だって言うの！　お前さんの足じゃ、
　走ったって追いつかれる」
source.english:
“You can't! With those legs,
it'll catch you even if you run.”

source.japanese:
それに、何もクロを助けたいどうこう以前に、今さら彼女を下ろす為に一々足を留めていたら、それだけでも追いつかれてしまいそう。背後で身じろぎして、巨体が動き出す気配に板敷きの通りが軋む、音だけで竦み上がりそう、振り向いてなどいられない、走る、朔屋が屠殺場から逃げ出した鶏のように懸命に駆ける。
　クロが軽すぎてかえってバランスが取れない。落とすまいと強く抱きしめているだけでも壊してしまいそう。肋同士がぶつかって軋む。痛い。でも構っていられない今は。
source.english:
Quite apart from wanting to save Kuro, if he stopped now merely to put her down, the serpent might catch them for that alone. Behind them the vast body stirred, making the boardwalk creak. The sound almost froze him where he ran. No looking back. Run. Sakuya fled like a chicken loose from the slaughterhouse. Kuro was so light that carrying her threw him off balance.
His desperate grip, meant to keep her from falling, seemed enough to break her. Their ribs knocked and ground together. It hurt. There was no time to care.

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「……朔屋さんに、迷惑……」
source.english: “…Kuro's a burden… to Mr. Sakuya…”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「迷惑かけられる相手がいるだけ、
　幸せと思えっ」
source.english:
“Be glad you've got someone you can be a burden to!
That's happiness enough!”

source.japanese: こんな状況、死にもの狂いの状況、物語や伝説中にしか登場し得ないような怪物に、この今の代、今の世の中になって追いかけられていると言うのは、一体なんだ？　悪夢か？　誰かの仕掛けた質の悪い冗談か？　クロが思い詰めたように呟いたが、細かく相手していられる余裕などなく、つい怒鳴り返したが、それ故に朔屋の実感であったろう。
source.english: What was this? Running for their lives, pursued by a monster that ought to exist only in stories and legends, here, now, in this modern world? A nightmare? Someone's vicious joke? Kuro's murmur sounded desperately troubled. He had no time to answer it properly and shouted back without thinking. For that very reason, it was probably what he really felt.

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「しあわせなの……？　そんなのが？
　じゃあクロは……。
　ずっと誰かに、迷惑をかけていても、
　それでしあわせ……？」
source.english:
“That's being happy…?
Just that? Then Kuro…
Even if Kuro's always a burden to someone…
that's still happiness…?”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「当たり前だろうっ。迷惑がホントに厭[いや]なら相手にしなくなるよ、それでも付き合ってくれる奴が居るのは幸運な───あーもう、いいから黙ってつかまってろ、クロ！」
source.english: “Of course! If they really hated the trouble, they'd stop having anything to do with you. Having someone who still sticks around is good luck—oh, just shut up and hang on, Kuro!”

source.japanese: 朔屋に怒鳴られて、クロは意外な言葉を聞いたような、少し驚き目で腕の中から見上げれば青年は、雨粒と脂汗で顔をどろどろにして、なりふり構っていられない疾走に、口角からは涎、鼻水だって伸びて、頭は密着するスーツのお陰で変梃に丸くて。はっきり言ってしまえばとてもみっともなくて。
source.english: Startled by words she had never expected, Kuro looked up from his arms. Rain and cold sweat smeared his face. He ran with no thought for appearances, drool at the corners of his mouth, snot trailing from his nose. The close-fitting suit made his head look peculiarly round. Frankly, he was a dreadful sight.

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「……Looks like it didn't work. RUUUUUUN!」

He should have already known, but being caught up in his single-minded frenzy had made him entirely forget how light she was, and with as little resistance as pulling a straw from a bundle, as well as the excess momentum of pulling up a burdock root, it felt like he was about to fling Kuro's body through the air. Without even attempting to grab hold, she spun around fully like an amusement park ride, swinging through the motion to finally bleed off the momentum, and cradling her in his arms, he ran as fast as his legs could carry him. He stuffed the telescope down the back of his suit through the neck; it was uncomfortably stiff and bulky, but he could no longer risk dropping it.
【Kuro】 「L-, let Kuro down. Kuro can run. Can run on Kuro's own───」
【Naomasa】 「Not a damn chance! With your legs, it'll catch up to you even if you run.」

Moreover, before his desire to rescue Kuro even came into consideration, were he to let the girl down at this point, he'd need to stop fully in his tracks, and that alone seemed enough to let that monster catch up to them. It stirred behind them, and the wooden floorboards creaked in response, hinting that its enormous body was beginning to move; that sound alone was enough to make him want to cower with fright, he couldn't bear to even look over his shoulder, and like a chicken that had escaped from a slaughterhouse, Sakuya ran, dashing as fast as his legs would take him.

Kuro was too light, to the point it actually made it harder to balance her. Even just holding her tight in his arms to make sure she wouldn't fall made it feel as if she might break. Ribs groaned as they collided with each other. It hurt. But now wasn't the time for that.
【Kuro】 「……A burden to Sakuya-san……」
【Naomasa】 「I think that just having someone who can be a burden to you is bliss in itself!」

What in the world was this situation, this desperate struggle of life and death, where he was being chased by a monster of the sort that would only show up in stories or legends, and in this age, in this modern world at that? Was this a nightmare? Was this some cruel joke that somebody was playing at his expense? Kuro muttered as though brooding over something, but he really didn't have the composure to pay attention to every little thing she did, and so he ended up impulsively shouting back at her; therefore, that was probably how Sakuya actually felt.
【Kuro】 「Bliss……? From something like that? Then even if Kuro……. Forever and always kept being a burden to someone, would that be bliss……?」

【Naomasa】 「Of course it would! If somebody really hated you being a burden, they'd stop paying attention to you, but if you have somebody out there who'll still put up with you regardless, that's a bless─── argh, enough, just shut up and hold on tight, Kuro!」

Yelled at by Sakuya, Kuro looked up from within his arms with a slightly surprised look in her eyes, as though she'd heard something she wasn't expecting to, and what met her gaze was the young man's face clammy with cold sweat and rain, sprinting without the slightest care for his appearance, drool hanging from the corner of his mouth, even snot dripping from his nose, and a head strangely round owing to the tight-fitting suit. To put it bluntly, he looked utterly disgraceful.

source.japanese:
けれどそれは全て自分の為なのだと知った時クロは───
　クロは恥じ入った。深く深く、今となっては懐かしいあの『船長の箱』に入ってしまいたくなるそれくらいに。それぐらい恥ずかしくて、自分が悪い、いけないものになってしまったような疚[やま]しさに襲われた。
source.english:
But when she understood that all of it was for her, Kuro—Kuro was ashamed.
Deeply, deeply ashamed. She wanted to crawl into that captain's box she now remembered almost fondly. She was so ashamed that guilt seized her, as though she herself had become something bad and wrong.

source.japanese:
何故なら少女は、朔屋という青年が、ここまで気取りも何もない、生のままの顔をさらけ出しているのが、自分を助けようと、自分のためにしてくれているのだと実感した時、無上の喜びに包まれてしまっていたから。
　この、体の底からぞわぞわと押し寄せて、喉にむず痒[がゆ]いくらいの感触は、きっと、嬉しい、そういうものなのだと。
source.english:
Because when the girl realized this young man, Sakuya, was showing such a bare, unguarded face in his effort to save her, doing it for her, she was filled with boundless joy.
The feeling rose in little shivers from deep inside, almost tickling her throat. Surely that was what it meant to be happy.

source.japanese: クロが無言に唇を引き結び、朔屋の首筋に強くしがみついて胸板に顔押しつけるようにしたのは、青年の言葉にただ従ったからでなく、こんな時に嬉しいと感じてしまっている自分が恥ずかしくて、見られたくなかったからだったのだ。
source.english: Kuro pressed her lips together, clung hard to Sakuya's neck and buried her face against his chest. Not merely because he had told her to. She was ashamed to feel happy at such a time, and did not want him to see.

source.japanese:
朔屋という一人の青年が、自分のためにこんなにも必死になってくれる事に、喉の底から突き上げてくるような歓びを、一瞬間だけど感じてしまって。
　もちろんクロはそれを恥じたし、いけない事だと後悔したし、その一瞬の歓びだけでもう充分とどこかで諦めていたし、それ以上の事は望まなかったのに。
source.english:
For one instant she had felt joy surge up from the bottom of her throat at this young man, Sakuya, trying so desperately for her sake. Of course she was ashamed.
She regretted it, felt it was wrong. Somewhere in her she had already resigned herself to that single instant being enough. She asked for nothing more.

source.japanese:
……何処の天上の、どんなご本尊やら知らないが、狭量な奴もあったもの。強欲か色欲か、いかなる罪科に数え上げたかは定かならぬが、幸いの実のちょっと端っこを囓っただけのクロに罰をくれてよこしたとしか考えられなかった。
　よこした罰は、朔屋の足許に転がった缶殻の形に顕現した。
source.english:
…What a petty deity there must be in some heaven or other. Who knew which one, or whether Kuro's offense had been entered under greed, lust or some other sin? It could only have punished her for nibbling at the merest edge of the fruit of happiness.
That punishment manifested as an empty can rolling beneath Sakuya's feet.

source.japanese: クロを抱きかかえていた為に視界が及ばなかったし、背後には、粘つく体表に、雨粒を弾けさせる電気と充たされる事のない餓えを纏う大海蛇が肉迫していたし、朔屋は足許に目を配ってなどいられず───
source.english: With Kuro in his arms, Sakuya could not see the ground. Behind him the great serpent bore down, its slimed hide crackling with electricity that burst the raindrops upon it, its body possessed by a hunger that could never be filled. He had no chance to watch his step.

source.japanese: クロもまた、朔屋の顔ばかりを見あげていたから。こういう時には、感謝の気持ちはちゃんと言葉にしないと伝わらないと知っていたから、朔屋に言おうとして。
source.english: Kuro, too, had been looking only at his face. She knew that gratitude at a time like this would never reach him unless she put it into words. She was trying to tell him.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「しゃべんなっ、舌を噛む、
　───って」
source.english:
“Don't talk!
You'll bite your tongue—”

target.text: But when Kuro realized that all of that was for her sake─── She felt terribly embarrassed. Deep and burning, intense enough to make her want to crawl inside that 『Captain's Box』that seemed almost nostalgic to her now. She was even overcome with guilt, so ashamed was she, as if she had done something bad, something she shouldn't have.

Why? Because when the girl realized that this young man by the name Sakuya was laying bare his face in its rawest form, with no pretension or posturing, all in so desperate an effort to save her, when she truly felt that he was doing it all for her sake, she was enveloped in unparalleled bliss. This tingling that surged upwards from deep within her body and left her shivering, this almost itching feeling in her throat, was surely what happiness felt like.

Kuro wordlessly pursed her lips, clung tightly to Sakuya's neck and pressed her face into his chest, not because she was just doing as he'd told her to, but because she felt ashamed of herself for feeling joy at a time like this, and she simply didn't want him to see it.

For a brief moment, Kuro felt a surge of joy that seemed to almost burst out her throat at the knowledge that this one young man by the name of Sakuya was making so desperate an effort for her sake. Naturally, Kuro felt ashamed of it, realized it was wrong and felt remorse, and some part of her had resigned itself to the fact that this fleeting moment of happiness was already more than enough, that she couldn't want for anything more, and yet.

……Who knows what manner of divine deity was to blame or which heavenly realm they hailed from, but there were some petty, narrow-minded gods out there. Greed or lust? It wasn't clear whatever sort of sin it was they were enumerating, but it could only be thought of as a divine punishment handed down upon Kuro, who had only taken the slightest of nibbles on the very edge of the fruit of happiness. And the punishment that was handed down manifested itself in the shape of an empty can lying by Sakuya's feet.

Because he was carrying Kuro in his arms, it never registered in his field of vision, and behind him, the great sea serpent, the sticky surface of its body enveloped in an insatiable hunger and a coiling electricity that made the raindrops burst, was closing in, so Sakuya couldn't afford to spare any glances towards his feet───

And Kuro was also doing nothing but looking up at Sakuya's face. She knew that, in times like these, she had to make sure to properly express her gratitude in words, so when she opened her mouth to tell Sakuya as much.
【Naomasa】 「Don't talk, you'll bite your tongue, ───oh.」

source.japanese:
【直正】
「うおっ!?」
source.english: “Whoa!?”

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「UOH!?」

source.japanese: どれだけしっかりとしがみついていたつもりでも、クロの腕[うで]の力は、やはりどこまでも足りなくて、朔屋の身体伝いに、足許から響いた衝撃を聞いた時にはもう、もぎ離されてしまってあり───
source.english: However firmly she thought she held on, Kuro's arms were still far too weak. By the time she felt the jolt travel up from Sakuya's feet through his body, she had already been torn loose.

source.japanese:
朔屋は抱えていた軽さが失せた事に、取り返しのつかない事態が見舞った事を知り、クロは自分の腕の、大事な者さえ捉まえていられない非力だったこと、今さらのように呆然となって。
　喪失感を二人に刻みこむように、世界の速度がこの瞬間、残酷な事に零に近づいた。
source.english:
The slight weight vanished from his arms, and Sakuya knew that something irreparable had happened. Kuro stared in fresh horror at arms too weak to hold on even to someone precious.
As though to carve that loss into them both, the world now slowed with exquisite cruelty to almost nothing.

source.japanese:
ゆっくりと緩慢に、クロの身体が朔屋の腕の中から抜けていく。
　クロは朔屋の顔が、呆然と、それから悔恨の表情に歪んでいく、筋肉の動き一つ一つを眺めている。
source.english:
Slowly, sluggishly, Kuro slipped from Sakuya's arms.
She watched each movement of the muscles in his face as bewilderment twisted into regret.

source.japanese: けれど、これだけお互いの動きが視えるのなら、判るのなら、と二人は互いに手を差し延べる───手が、指先が届く、触れ合う、絡み合う！
source.english: But if they could see each other's movements so clearly—could understand them—then surely… They reached for one another. Their hands stretched out, their fingertips met, their fingers entwined!

source.japanese:
───かに見えて。
　水の中に落ちていく貝殻に、手を差し入れて捕らえようとしてもどうしてもうまくいかない。指の前でするりと抜けていく。
　この時の二人のように、絡み合ったはずの指と指が、するりと抜けていく、離れていく。
source.english:
Or so it seemed.
Try to catch a shell sinking through water and somehow you never can; it slips away just before your fingers close.
So now the fingers that should have entwined slipped free and drew apart.

source.japanese:
もう一度試みる事も許されなかった。
　二人にその瞬間を引き延ばして味合わせてやりたかっただけ、と言いたげに世界の時間は巻き締まり、復調した。
source.english:
They were not allowed another attempt.
As though it had merely wished to prolong the instant for them to savor, the world's time wound tight and recovered its pace.

source.japanese: 朔屋は前のめりにクロを投げ出す形となっていたとはいえ、とすんと哀しいくらい軽い音で、少女が地に伏したのは、青年の前方、かなり離れた位置でそんなにも勢いが付いてしまっていたのか。
source.english: Sakuya had pitched forward and flung Kuro ahead of him. She struck the ground far in front with a little thud so light it was heartbreaking. Had his momentum truly thrown her that far?

source.japanese:
【直正】
「クロ、大丈夫かッ!?」
source.english: “Kuro! Are you all right!?”

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「朔屋さん、立ってぇ……っ。
　逃げて───」
source.english:
“Mr. Sakuya, get up…!
Run—”

source.japanese: クロは短い悲鳴をつまらせ顔を引き歪めたが、ぐっとこらえて朔屋へと手を差しのばす、が、腰から下は崩れたまま。恐怖と驚愕が立ち上がる力を奪っている。
source.english: A short cry caught in Kuro's throat. Her face twisted, but she swallowed the pain and reached for him. Her lower body remained collapsed beneath her; fear and shock had robbed her of the strength to stand.

target.text: No matter how tightly she thought she was holding on to him, ultimately, the strength in Kuro's arms just wasn't anywhere close to sufficient, and by the time she heard the impact that travelled through Sakyua's body from below his feet, she had already been torn apart from him───

When the light weight he had been carrying disappeared, Sakuya knew that an irremediable situation had befallen them, and Kuro was aghast, as if realizing anew how powerless her own arms were, so weak that they could not even hold on to someone so dear to her. And as if to carve that sensation of loss deep into the both of them, in a cruel turn of fate, right then, the speed with which the world itself turned approached zero.

Slowly, gently, Kuro's body slipped out from Sakuya's arms. And Kuro watched as Sakuya's face went blank with shock, then contorted into an expression of bitter remorse, every little movement of the muscles.

However, if they could both see and understand each other's movements so clearly, then surely, they both thought as they reached out to each other───their hands, the tips of their fingers reached, touched, intertwined!

───Or so it might have looked. For all that one reaches in and tries to catch a seashell falling into the water, it never goes well. It just slips right through your fingers. Like the two of them in this moment, fingers that were supposed to be intertwined slipped apart smoothly, separating.

They were never given a second chance to try. And as if all but saying that it merely wanted to prolong that moment so they could really savour it, the world's sense of time tightened once more, returning to its regular speed.

Granted, Sakuya had pitched forwards, flinging Kuro out ahead of him, but for the girl to hit the ground so far ahead of him with a thud so faint it was almost pitiful, had she truly carried that much momentum?
【Naomasa】 「Kuro, are you okay!?」
【Kuro】 「Sakuya-san, stand up……. Run away───」

Kuro choked back a short scream, her face contorting in pain, but she bit it back and reached a hand out towards Sakuya; however, her lower body had completely given out. Fear and shock was depriving her of the strength to rise to her feet.

source.japanese:
青年の背後には、獲物と認めて大海蛇の、その汚怪な雁首を蠕動させつつじり、じりと。
　怪物の巨体には一息に詰められない距離ではない。なのに様子を窺うように緩慢なのが、慎重さの表れというより、この怪生物の獲物を嬲[なぶ]る残忍性を示していた。
source.english:
Behind the young man, the sea serpent had marked its prey and was inching its foul head closer.
Its vast body could have closed the distance in an instant. That slow approach, as though waiting to see what they would do, suggested less caution than a cruel appetite for torment.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「いいからまずお前だっ。
　逃げてくれ、頼むから……っ」
source.english:
“You first!
Run, please…!”

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「た、立てないクロ、あしが、腰が、
　いごかないよう……っ」
source.english:
“C-can't get up. Kuro's legs, hips…
they won't move…!”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「動くッ。大丈夫だっ。嵐を呼ぶ船長、それがクロだろうっ！　あの時も今も、身体だけはおんなじなんだから！」
source.english: “They will! You're all right! You're the captain who calls the storms, remember? Your body's the same now as it was then!”

source.japanese: 大海蛇はもう背後で狙いを定めているはず、このように絶縁のスーツを着こんでいても、顔の露出した肌には雨の日に高圧電線の鉄塔の下を通った時のような電気の刺激をぴりぴりと感じている。スーツは同時に、体腔に侵入させようという大海蛇の口吻を防いでくれるかも知れないけれど、あの巨躯ではのしかかられただけで全身の骨が砕けるだろう。
source.english: The great sea serpent must already have been taking aim behind him. Even through the insulated suit, Sakuya could feel electricity prickling the bare skin of his face, like passing beneath a high-voltage tower on a rainy day. The suit might keep the creature from forcing its snout into a body cavity, but with that bulk it needed only to fall upon him to shatter every bone.

source.japanese:
恐怖は当然のようにある。恐ろしくないわけがない。けれど朔屋には、この時ここでクロまでこの怪生物に屠[ほふ]られてしまうのが、とてつもなく無念に感じられたのだ。
　それは幾らか、信天翁号の船員達への反感も手伝っていた。自分達をこの危地に送りこんだ者への。
source.english:
Of course he was afraid. How could he not be? But here, at this moment, the thought of Kuro being slaughtered too filled Sakuya with an extraordinary bitterness.
Part of it was resentment toward the Albatross's crew. The people who had sent them into this danger.

target.text: Behind the young man, the great sea serpent, having deemed them prey, slowly crept forward while that phallic abomination it had for a head wriggled along the floor. It was not a distance insurmountable for the monster's massive body to close in a single breath. Yet, its deliberately slow approach, as if sizing them up, was less an expression of caution and more a demonstration of the cruel nature of this monster, its desire to toy with its prey.
【Naomasa】 「It's fine, you go first! Just run away, I'm begging you……」
【Kuro】 「C-, can't stand, Kuro's legs, hips, they won't move……!」
【Naomasa】 「You can move! You're fine. The Storm-calling Captain, that's you, Kuro, right!? Your body's still the same now as it was then, so!」

Behind him, the great sea serpent must already have been taking aim, for even wearing an insulated suit like this one, the exposed skin of his face still tingled with electric stimulation akin to what you'd feel passing under a high-voltage line on a rainy day. While the suit might also protect against the great sea serpent's proboscis that would supposedly try to penetrate his body cavities, with that massive body, just being pinned under it would surely shatter every bone in his body.

Fear was present, naturally. It was impossible not to be afraid. Yet to Sakuya, the thought of even Kuro being slaughtered by this monster, right here and now, brought with it a crushing, bitter resentment. The animosity he felt towards the crew of the Albatross also had a role to play. What he felt towards they who had sent them into this peril.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「ほら、行くんだ、クロ!!」
source.english: “Come on! Go, Kuro!”

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「Come on, just go, Kuro!!」

source.japanese:
背後の怪生物を刺激してしまう事にもなろうが、知った事かと朔屋は、むらむらと滾[たぎ]る無念、反感を籠めて、拳をどんと板敷きの通りに叩きつける。
　朔屋の剣幕と、板伝いに拳の衝動伝ったか、クロの背筋にびしりと筋が通って、彼女を咄嗟に立ち上がらせた。
　となれば後は勢いが付けばいいと朔屋は顔の半分を口にして───
source.english:
It might provoke the creature behind him, but to hell with that. Sakuya poured his seething bitterness and resentment into his fist and slammed it against the wooden street.
Whether it was his fury or the blow transmitted through the boards, a jolt ran up Kuro's spine and sprang her to her feet. Now she needed only enough impetus to run.
Sakuya opened his mouth until it seemed to take up half his face—

target.text: It would surely also provoke the monstrous creature behind him, but Sakuya didn't care; filled with an unbridled, seething resentment and animosity, he slammed his fist down on the floorboards with all his strength. Perhaps it was the fierce intensity of Sakuya's glare, or else the impact of his fist travelling down the boards, for a sharp jolt shot straight up her spine, snapping her to her feet instantly. All he needed now was a bit of momentum, Sakuya thought, opening his mouth so wide it took up almost half his face───

source.japanese:
【直正】
「おがあああああ～～～～！」
source.english: “RAAAAAAARGH!”

source.japanese: 寝つきの悪い子供を脅しつける物怪声で、顔つきで、クロはひっと顔を引きつけると、反射的に飛び退いた、その一歩が弾みとなって、二歩、三歩と踏み出すうちに歩度が伸び、速さも増して、板敷きの通りの奥へ。その、スーツによって細さばかりが強調された背中を見送って、朔屋は。
source.english: With the monstrous voice and face of a bogeyman scaring a child who would not sleep, he made Kuro flinch and leap back. That first step carried her into a second, a third; her stride lengthened, her speed increased, and she fled down the boardwalk. Sakuya watched her go, the suit emphasizing only the thinness of her back.

source.japanese:
【直正】
（あああ……やっちゃったよ俺。
　何かっこつけてんの俺。俺、ここで死ぬの？
　やだよ、怖いよ、そんなの、怖い───）
source.english:
(Aah… I've done it now.
What am I playing the hero for? Am I going to die here?
No. I'm scared. I don't want to. I'm scared—)

target.text: 【Naomasa】 「GRAAAAAH～～～～!」

Confronted with a monstrous voice and expression of the kind used to terrify a restless child into going to sleep, Kuro let out a sharp gasp, her own face contorting as she reflexively jumped back; that single step gave her the momentum she needed, her stride lengthening as she took a second, then third step, her speed increasing as well, further down the boarded street. And as he watched her back, the thinness of which had only been accentuated by that suit, disappear, Sakuya thought to himself:
【Naomasa】 （Oh man……now I've really gone and done it. Who am I trying to impress here? Is this where I die? No way, that's scary, that's really scary───）

source.japanese:
少女を逃げ延びさせてから敢然と、あるいは逍遥と、朔屋は結末を受け入れるのにどちらの態度もとらなかった。
　クロが逃れたと見るや恐怖に眸[ひとみ]濁[にご]らせ、ばたばた手足で通りの床材を叩き、そのくせ立って逃げ出す事も怖くて出来ない、ただ怖い怖いと譫言のように呟き続ける情けなさを完全に露呈させ、不様極まりない最期を遂げようとしていた。
　大海蛇がその雁首を収縮させているのも、朔屋の醜態を楽しんでいるかのよう。
source.english:
Having let the girl escape, Sakuya did not accept his fate either bravely or serenely.
The moment she was clear, fear clouded his eyes. He thrashed his limbs against the boards, yet was too frightened even to stand and run. Scared, scared, he kept muttering, delirious. All his pitiful weakness laid bare, he was about to meet a supremely unseemly end.
The serpent contracted its head as though enjoying the spectacle.

target.text: After letting the girl make her escape, though Sakuya should have faced his fate with resolute bravery, or perhaps unbothered detachment, he chose neither. After seeing Kuro escape, his eyes clouded over with murky terror, his thrashing limbs struck the wooden street, but for all that, he was still too scared to even stand up and run away; continuing to mutter "I'm scared, I'm scared" over and over again like a desperate chant, his pathetic nature completely exposed, he was about to meet the most undignified of ends. Even the way the great sea serpent contracted its neck made it seem as if it took pleasure in Sakuya's disgraceful conduct.

source.japanese: 朔屋はがちがちいう音を聞いた。勝手に鳴りだした、恐怖に震えた歯列が鳴らすスタッカートだ。
source.english: Sakuya heard a chattering sound. His teeth had begun to rattle of their own accord, beating out a staccato of fear.

target.text: Sakuya heard a clacking. It was the staccato rattling of his teeth chattering in fear of their own accord.

source.japanese: 朔屋はとたとたいう音を聞いた。こちらの音は朔屋を別な意味で恐怖させた。なぜにと言って、そのとたとた、跫音は朔屋へと近づいていたから。せっかく一度は遠ざけたつもりだったのに。
source.english: Sakuya heard a pattering sound. This frightened him in another way. Why? Because the patter—the footsteps—was coming toward him. He had thought he had sent it away at last.

source.japanese:
【直正】
（なんで戻って来ちゃうかなあこいつは）
source.english: (Why does she have to come back?)

source.japanese: 朔屋の顔は恐怖によって、涙と鼻水と脂汗でどろどろぐちゃぐちゃ、それはもう目を背[そむ]けたくなるほどの有り様だったが、クロも似たようなものだった。啜り泣き、しゃくりあげて、ちょっと口をしっかり閉じていれば、ちょっと眼をぱっちり澄ましていれば、不健康そうな隈に目を瞑[つむ]れば、それなりに可憐な貌立ちが、もう台無しの、朔屋とクロで何もこんなところで不様の顔見本を競わせなくともよかろうにというほど。
source.english: Tears, snot and clammy sweat had made a dreadful mess of Sakuya's frightened face, enough to make anyone look away. Kuro was little better: sobbing, hiccuping, her mouth hanging open and her red eyes swollen above their unhealthy shadows. Under ordinary circumstances her features might have been called pretty. Now they were ruined. There was surely no need for Sakuya and Kuro to stage a contest in hideous faces here of all places.

target.text: Sakuya heard a light pattering. This sound horrified Sakuya in an entirely different sense. As for why, it was because that pattering was the sound of footsteps approaching Sakuya. And just as he thought he'd managed to get her away from all this.
【Naomasa】 （Why, oh why did that girl have to come back?）

Fear had reduced Sakuya's face to a sticky mess of tears, snot, and greasy sweat, already in a state so pathetic one could barely bear to look at it, but Kuro was not much better herself. Weeping, heaving with sobs, and if she just kept her mouth closed, opened her eyes wide, and one turned a blind eye to those unhealthily dark circles under her eyes, she would have a quite lovely countenance, but it was so utterly ruined now that one couldn't but think Sakuya and Kuro had no business competing over who could look the most unsightly at a time and place like this.

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「やっぱり、できない、朔屋さん置いてくの、
　クロはやだよぉっ、だって、そしたらきっと、クロは、どうやても、幸せ、なくなる」
source.english:
“Kuro can't do it. Can't leave Mr. Sakuya…!
Because then—then Kuro could never be happy again.”

source.japanese: 涙で湿った声、腫れぼったい瞼[まぶた]、夜鳴きする赤子をもっと歪めたような表情。そして全身覆うスーツからはきゅっきゅっとゴムが擦れる奇妙な音立てて、この時のクロはもう悲惨なくらいにみっともなく、もしかすると普段の朔屋なら、こんな形相で近づかれたならついうっかり蹴り倒してしまったかも知れない。それなのにこの今は、どうしてこんなにも嬉しいのか。
source.english: A voice wet with tears. Swollen eyelids. An expression more contorted than a baby crying in the night. And the strange squeak, squeak of the suit covering her whole body. Kuro looked so miserably dreadful that the ordinary Sakuya might accidentally have kicked her over if she approached him like this. Why, then, was he so happy now?

source.japanese: 朔屋の側まで、大海蛇に目がいってしまわないように硬い目つきで戻ってきてから、クロはぺたんと膝をつき、とすんと腰を落として、青年の前で項垂れて。
source.english: Kuro returned to his side with a rigid stare, trying not to look at the serpent. She dropped to her knees, settled on the ground and bowed her head before him.

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「もう。どうせ。
　ここでクロ、死んじゃったって。
　別にね、もういいかなって」
source.english:
“Now. Anyway.
Even if Kuro dies here…
maybe that's all right now.”

source.japanese:
だって、自分のために。
　こんなにも必死に、変梃な顔になってまで。
　喚いて叫んで、怒ってくれる人がいる。
　それが判ったから。
　その誰かが朔屋だと判ったから。
source.english:
Because she knew now.
There was someone who would shout and scream and rage for her sake—so desperately that he no longer cared what became of his face.
And that someone was Sakuya.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「おおう……そんなヤケ言うなよう。
　俺、クロに目の前でおっ死なれるなんていやだぞ……」
source.english:
“Oh…
Don't give up like that. I don't want to see you die right in front of me…”

source.japanese:
【直正】
「って、それはお前もおんなじ、なのか？
　俺にくたばられるのが厭[いや]だから？
　だからのこのこ戻って来ちまったってか？」
source.english:
“Wait. Is it the same for you?
You don't want me to die?
That's why you came wandering back?”

source.japanese: あい、とクロは素直に頷[うなず]いて。
source.english: “Yes,” Kuro said, nodding without guile.

target.text: 【Kuro】 「Just can't do it, can't leave Sakuya-san behind, Kuro doesn't want to, because, if Kuro does that, then Kuro will, no matter what, lose Kuro's happiness.」

Voice wet with tears, eyelids puffy, and an expression distorted into a grimace more twisted than even that of a baby crying at night. Not to mention the strange squeaking of chafing rubber coming from the suit covering her entire body; in this moment, Kuro was already unsightly to the point of tragedy, and perhaps, had Sakuya been approached by her wearing an expression like this while he was in his normal state of mind, he might well have accidentally kicked her down to the ground on instinct. And despite that, why was it that he was so happy to see her right now?

After returning to Sakuya's side with a firm look in her eyes, determined to not let her eyes wander to the great sea serpent, Kuro dropped to her knees, her behind following shortly after, then hung her head before the young man.
【Kuro】 「Enough. What's the point? Even if Kuro dies, right here. Don't really care anymore.」

Because, he did it for her sake. With such desperation, to the point he made so strange a face. There was someone who would scream and shout and get angry, for her. Because she realized. Because she realized that someone was Sakuya.
【Naomasa】 「Ugh……don't talk like you've given up on yourself. I really, really don't want to see you die right before my eyes, Kuro……」
【Naomasa】 「Wait, so do you also feel the same? Is it because you hate the thought of me dying? Is that why you came waltzing back here like it's nothing?」
With a soft "aye", Kuro gave an upfront nod in return.

source.japanese: ……二人の頭上で、大海蛇はさて、どちらからにしようかなと言わんばかりに鎌首を左右に巡らせている。そんな怪獣をクロは、怖々と見あげて、ちらりと見ただけでおぞましさに身を縮こまらせて、でもどこか観念したように、
source.english: Above their heads, the great sea serpent turned its raised head from side to side, as though deciding which to take first. Kuro looked fearfully up. The briefest glimpse of the horror made her shrink, but with something like resignation—

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「あー……さいごまで、いっしょかぁ。
　これ、たぶんしあわせなんだ」
source.english:
“Ah… Together to the end.
This is probably… being happy.”

source.japanese: えへへ、と思いもかけず素敵な貝殻でも拾ったように、赤い眸[ひとみ]に喜色を浮かべて。
source.english: Heh, heh. Delight shone in her red eyes, as though she had found an unexpectedly lovely shell.

target.text: ……Above their heads, the giant sea serpent swayed its own from side to side as if debating which of the two to start with. So terrifying a monster did Kuro timidly look up at, and just a slight glance was enough to make her huddle in fear from the sheer repulsiveness of the sight, but then, as if she had, in some respects, resigned herself to her fate,
【Kuro】 「Ah……so we're together until the very end. Guess this is what happiness is.」
She giggled, red eyes beaming with joy, as if she had unexpectedly picked up a lovely seashell.

source.japanese: 大海蛇は、食前の下処理のつもりで、何度か眼下の二人に電撃を送ってみたのだけれど、他の獲物のようには麻痺してくれないので、ちょっと考えこむ。
source.english: The serpent had sent several shocks down at the pair, by way of preparing its meal. They did not become paralyzed like its other prey. It stopped to think.

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「クロ、ほしかったのは、きっとこれ。
　みんなに、認めてもらうの、もういいや」
source.english:
“This must be… what Kuro wanted.
Kuro doesn't care anymore whether everyone else accepts Kuro.”

source.japanese: そして、うん、と一つこっくり頷[うなず]いて、クロは理解を得ていた。諦観、と言うべきか。分別、と言うべきか。結局自分が望んで得られるものは限られているのだと。でも、それが青年であるのなら、それになんの不足があるのだと───クロは理解して、諦めてそして、大いに満足していた。
source.english: Then Kuro gave one small nod and understood. Was it resignation? Good sense? In the end, there were only so many things she could hope to receive. But if what she received was this young man, what more could she want? Kuro understood, relinquished the rest, and was profoundly content.

target.text: With the intent of tenderizing its meal before partaking, the great sea serpent sent several electric shocks at the two sitting right under its nose, but unlike its other prey, they did not get paralyzed; it pondered the matter for a bit.
【Kuro】 「This has to be what Kuro wanted. Had enough of trying to get the approval of everyone else.」

And then, with a single nod of acceptance, Kuro reached understanding. Or perhaps fatalistic resignation is the word for it. Or maybe it is discernment. Ultimately, what you can obtain through your own desires is limited. But, if it meant she could have this young man, then what possible discontent could she feel───Kuro understood, gave up, and was exceedingly satisfied.

source.japanese: さて大海蛇君は、先ほどまでぴちぴち活きが良かった獲物達が、なんだかすっかり大人しくなっているのに不審の念を抱いていた。死んだふりだろうか。大海蛇の好みというのは、生に必死にしがみつこうとする獲物を追いかけ弱らせ、さんざんに嬲[なぶ]って然る後に孔に尖端を挿入してから、消化酵素で肉や内臓を溶かし尽くして吸いあげる事だが、少しは厭[いや]がってくれないと趣に欠ける。この獲物二体が捕食者を前にして逃げる風も見せないのは、あるいは病んでいるのだろうか。
source.english: Now, the great sea serpent had grown suspicious. The prey that only moments before had been so lively and fresh had gone strangely meek. Were they playing dead? The creature preferred to pursue prey that clung desperately to life, wear it down and torment it at length; only then would it insert its pointed tip into an opening, dissolve flesh and organs with digestive enzymes, and suck them out. Without at least a little resistance, the sport lost its savor. Could these two be diseased? Even with their predator before them, they made no attempt to flee.

source.japanese: が、何時まで逡巡していてもしかたがない。発電しうる最大の電撃をくらわせれば、少しくらい丈夫な皮膚を持っていたとてどうにもなるまい。大海蛇、畜勢に入り───
source.english: There was no point in hesitating forever. If it loosed the greatest shock it could generate, even somewhat resistant skin would avail them nothing. The great sea serpent began gathering its charge—

target.text: Now then, its prey, which was bursting with vitality until just moments ago, had suddenly grown entirely docile, which left our sea serpent friend feeling skeptical. They were playing dead, surely? While the great sea serpent's preference was to chase down its prey and weaken it while it desperately clung to life, toying with it to its sadistic heart's content, followed by inserting its tip into an orifice, using its digestive enzyme to fully dissolve all the flesh and organs within, and then slurping it all up, if they didn't resist at least a little, it simply lacked all its charm. Given that these two prey animals were showing no signs of fleeing in the face of their predator, maybe they were ill?

But there was also no sense in remaining indecisive forever. If it struck them with the strongest electric shock it could muster, then even should they have a slightly tough hide, it would amount to nothing. The great sea serpent began charging up───

source.japanese:
【クロ】
「なにやったって、怒らりるもの。
　なら、なにもしないで、朔屋さんと」
source.english:
“Whatever Kuro does, someone gets angry.
So… do nothing. With Mr. Sakuya.”

target.text: 【Kuro】 「Whatever Kuro does, just gets yelled at. Then, just won't do anything, together with Sakuya-san.」

source.japanese: 最期にクロは、身を乗りだし、それは嬉しそうに莞爾し、朔屋の首を抱きよせて、唇と唇を重ねようとした。好きな人同士がこうする事を知っていたから。
source.english: At the last, Kuro leaned forward with a delighted smile, drew Sakuya's neck toward her and tried to put her lips to his. She knew that people who liked each other did this.

source.japanese:
【直正】
「お、おい、よせやいこんな時に、
　いや、ま、いっかー……」
source.english:
“H-hey, stop it,
at a time like—well, oh, why not…”

source.japanese: 朔屋も、先ほどまであれほど躍起となってクロを逃そうとしていたけれど、もうどうでも良くなって、白状してしまえばクロが戻ってきたのが何やら嬉しくて、疲れきっていたのも手伝って、青年は、そしてクロは、極めて自堕落に、後の事は大海蛇の好きにしろと、いい加減に適当に生命を、投げ捨てた。
source.english: Only moments before, Sakuya had been frantic to make Kuro escape. Now nothing seemed to matter. If he admitted the truth, he was absurdly glad she had come back, and utter exhaustion did the rest. With consummate indolence, casually and carelessly, the young man and Kuro threw away their lives: afterward, the serpent might do as it pleased.

source.japanese:
───さて。
　身を捨ててこそ浮かぶ瀬もあれ、とは言うたものだが。
　二人の心境とは遠く隔たるところであろう。
　
　しかし───
source.english:
Now, then.
Only by casting life away may one find the shallows that bear one up, as the saying goes.
That was surely far removed from the state of these two.

And yet—

source.japanese: 朔屋とクロが覚悟、と言うか、もう色々とどうでもいいという投げ遣りな気分に陥ったその時。
source.english: At the instant Sakuya and Kuro came to their resolution—or rather, sank into a mood in which almost nothing mattered anymore.

target.text: In her last moments, Kuro leaned forwards, and with a gentle smile of bright contentment, she threw her arms around Sakuya's neck, pulled him closer, and moved to press her lips against his. Because she knew that this is what people who love each other do.
【Naomasa】 「O-oi, come on, cut it out, not at a time like this, well, nah, whatever……」

Sakuya, who had been so desperate to let Kuro escape just moments ago, had also ceased to care, and were he to confess, he was somewhat happy that Kuro came back to him, though being exhausted also played a part; thus, the young man, together with Kuro, in a manner as negligently self-indulgent as could be, telling the sea serpent to do whatever the hell it pleased with them after death, irresponsibly and perfunctorily threw away their lives.

───Now. It is only through throwing oneself into the waters that one manages to float, or so it is said. Nothing ventured, nothing gained. Though what occupied the minds of these two was surely far removed from any such concepts. However───
Right at that moment, when Sakuya and Kuro had resigned themselves, or rather, fallen into a state of total apathy where they no longer cared about anything anymore.

source.japanese:
覚悟めいた、気持ちといっても、望んでいたぞと微笑む魂などである筈はなく、二人はただただその瞬間がさっさと到来してくれよと。もう痛いだろうとか苦しいだろうとか、想像するのも厭[いや]で面倒くさくて。
　こういう厭[いや]なものを待ち受ける、鈍速化した時間の中で朔屋が、鼻の奥に刺してくるの感じる匂いは、大概消毒綿の刺激臭で、きっとこれは幼き日注射に泣いた頃の記憶なのだろう、それにしてもまだなのか、クロなんかまた震え始めてる、と苛立ちさえ小生意気に覚えた始めた時に、風切り音だ。
source.english:
Resolution, if one could call it that. Certainly theirs were no souls smiling, This is what we wanted. They merely wished the moment would hurry up and arrive. Imagining how much it would hurt, how much they would suffer, was itself too unpleasant, too tiresome.
In the sluggish time spent awaiting something dreadful, the smell that stabbed the back of Sakuya’s nose was, as usual, the acrid reek of antiseptic cotton—surely a memory of crying over injections as a child. Wasn’t it here yet? Kuro had even started trembling again. He was just beginning, with positively cheeky impatience, to feel annoyed when something whistled through the air.

target.text: Though they felt something akin to resolve, they were surely not souls smiling at the outcome they had desired, no, these two were simply hoping that moment would arrive without delay. They were reluctant to even imagine how painful or agonizing it would be; it was too tiresome.

In the midst of this dilated time that is observed by those who wait for this sort of unpleasant business, the scent that stung the back of Sakuya's nose was mostly the irritating smell of disinfectants, and surely this must have been a memory from when he had cried while being given some injection as a child; be that as it may, was it really still not over yet, Kuro was even beginning to tremble again, he thought, and just as he was even beginning to feel impudently impatient, he heard the sound of wind rushing past him.

source.japanese:
と、耳に認めて、一拍ほど間があったろうか───叩きつけられた塊！
　頭上からだったし、重く荒々しい威力、を即座に連想させたし、朔屋もクロも共に身構えたのだこれがきっと最大の電撃あるいは体当たりだから今は音だけだけれどその次に体をすごい痛みが襲う何処にくる腕か頭かお腹か背中かどれだけ辛いのか歯を食いしばるかそれとも堪えない方が一瞬ですむのか───
　襲いかかるであろう痛苦に身構えた二人なのだが、しかしこの時二人をまず叩いたのは、大海蛇の電撃でもその体躯を利した圧撃でもなく、音の一撃だ、ギュッと握って圧縮したのが弾けるような。
source.english:
He heard it. Perhaps a single beat passed—and then some great mass came smashing down!
It came from overhead, a sound that instantly conjured weight and savage force. Sakuya and Kuro both braced themselves: this must be the creature's greatest shock, or the impact of its body; now there was only sound, but next would come terrible pain—where would it strike, arm, head, belly, back, how bad would it be, should they clench their teeth or would it end sooner if they simply yielded—
They braced for the agony. Yet the first thing to strike them was neither the serpent's electricity nor the crushing blow of its bulk, but sound itself: a detonation like something clenched, compressed, and suddenly released.

target.text: Then, after his ears recognized the sound, there was a slight pause of about a single beat─── a mass slammed into him! It came from overhead, and it immediately conjured up images of heavy, brutal force; Sakuya and Kuro both braced themselves, this had to be the greatest shock it could muster or perhaps it had rammed them and that right now was just the sound of it so next a terrific pain would assault them and where would it come from their arm or their head or their stomach or their back how painful would it be should they grit their teeth or would not trying to endure mean it was over with in an instant───

The two of them had braced themselves for the intense pain that would surely assail them any moment, but the first thing that struck these two was not an electrical attack from the great sea serpent nor a crushing blow of pressure taking advantage of its enormous physique; it was an assault of sound, like something that had been tightly squeezed and compressed suddenly bursting open.

source.japanese: それは、二人と大海蛇が位置する区画、その頭上にさしかかる木造建築群を、正体不明の威力が爆砕した轟音。あまりの衝撃に朔屋とクロの体が横滑りしたほどで、二人とも完全に虚を衝[つ]かれ、周囲の状況と認識の接続が断たれた。猫の鼻先で思い切り手を打ち鳴らした時、動きが止まってしまう生理作用と同じだが、大海蛇の方さえ、瞬間に凝結していた。二人に狙い定めた形のまま。この生物の感覚知覚がどのような機構を取っているのか定かではないが、こういった捕食者も、獲物を襲うその瞬間には無防備になる、こちらもまさにその虚を衝[つ]かれた。
source.english: An unknown force had blasted apart the wooden buildings overhanging the section where they and the serpent stood. The roar was so violent that Sakuya and Kuro slid sideways. Taken wholly by surprise, they lost all connection between what surrounded them and what they understood. It was the same bodily reflex that stops a cat in its tracks when you clap hard in front of its nose. Even the serpent froze for an instant, still poised at the pair. Who knew how its senses worked? But a predator, too, is defenseless at the instant it strikes. This one had been caught at that very opening.

target.text: It was the thunderous boom of the area that both they and the sea serpent were currently in, as well as the cluster of wooden architecture hanging overhead, being blasted to smithereens by some unidentified force. The impact was so enormous that Sakuya and Kuro's bodies slid sideways, both of them were taken completely off guard, and the connection between the state of their surroundings and their perception of it was severed.

It was the same physiological reaction as when you clap your hands together as hard as you can right in front of a cat's nose and it comes to a complete stop, and even the great sea serpent froze in an instant. Still poised to strike the two of them. It wasn't clear what exact mechanism this organism relied upon for its sensory perception, but these sorts of predators also become vulnerable in that exact moment they are about to strike their prey, so it, too, had been caught completely off guard.

source.japanese: ごん、と朔屋達のすぐ脇に落ちた、木造家屋の梁材の太さに朔屋は震え上がった。ごんと落ちて、余韻を残して震えている。これがもし脳天に落ちてきたら、中身を撒き散らして悶死していただろうの想像の方が、大海蛇に襲われる瞬間より判りやすく朔屋に活を入れて、立ち上がらせて、もちろん忘れずクロの手を引っ張って。
source.english: A beam fell with a heavy thud beside them. Its thickness made Sakuya shudder; it lay there trembling from the impact. Had it landed on his skull, he would have scattered his brains and died in agony. That fate was easier to imagine than the serpent's attack, and the thought shocked life back into him. He scrambled up, remembering, of course, to pull Kuro to her feet by the hand.

target.text: Something fell right beside Sakuya and Kuro with a bang; seeing the sheer thickness of the beam from the wooden house sent a violent shudder through Sakuya. There had been a loud crash, and the tremor of its impact lingered. If that had fallen right on his head; the image that his imagination conjured up of his insides splattering all over as he suffered an agonizing death was something far easier to comprehend than the brief moment he would be assaulted by the great sea serpent, and it breathed life back into Sakuya, sent him flying to his feet, and naturally, he didn't forget to pull Kuro up by her hand.

source.japanese: その梁材を皮切りに、木造家屋の崩壊が始まった。ノアの言を信ずるなら、これら木造の建物はなまなかな腐食や衝撃などものともしないはずである。それが、朔屋達が立ち上がった、その位置にもごん、と角材を零し、もう連鎖的に降り注ぐ、構造的に弱い芯でもあってそこを射貫かれたのか、それとも飛来した衝撃がそこまでの威力を秘めていたのか。なんにしても、直撃でこそなかったものの、それが大海蛇には致命となった。
source.english: That beam was only the beginning. The wooden houses began to collapse. If Noah was to be believed, these buildings should have shrugged off ordinary rot or impact.
