ALB-A2-5007-005.japanese: あなた達の姿を思い浮かべれば、それが地球の似姿になる
ALB-A2-5007-005.argokaj: If you try to imagine how it looks to you in your head, that will share a close likeness with Earth.
ALB-A2-5007-005.explanation: The source asks the listeners to picture their own appearance as a likeness of Earth's inhabitants. The target instead asks how it looks to them, leaving the object a vague world or scene.
occurrenceQuotes: If you try to imagine how it looks to you in your head, that will share a close likeness with Earth.

ALB-A2-5007-006.japanese: 無理が通って非常識なのだ
ALB-A2-5007-006.explanation: 'An unreasonably absurdity' uses an adverb directly before the noun where an adjective is needed.
occurrenceQuotes: it was an unreasonably absurdity

ALB-A2-5007-007.japanese: 先ほどの筋がよいとの言に寄れば、一番そこに近い者
ALB-A2-5007-007.argokaj: the best candidate for what the stowaway mentioned earlier, having a good head on your shoulders
ALB-A2-5007-007.explanation: The source uses the earlier praise as evidence that the engineer is closest to the questioning investigator just described. The English makes him a candidate for the earlier praise itself.
occurrenceQuotes: the best candidate for what the stowaway mentioned earlier, having a good head on your shoulders

ALB-A2-5007-008.japanese: あの国へ帰るための大切なもの達。
ALB-A2-5007-008.argokaj: Those all-important people, whom she needed to return home to that country.
ALB-A2-5007-008.explanation: After listing crew and equipment together, the source's final precious things still encompasses both. The English conclusion narrows that final reference to people.
occurrenceQuotes: Those all-important people, whom she needed to return home to that country.

ALB-A2-5007-009.japanese: とはいかないのが、どうしようもない阿呆鳥。
ALB-A2-5007-009.argokaj: Trying to make sense of this hopeless fool of an Albatross was itself but a fool's errand.
ALB-A2-5007-009.explanation: The source's とはいかない retracts the advertised united cheer after the twins' deflating remarks. The target instead says understanding the ship is a fool's errand, leaving the earlier cheer un-retracted.
occurrenceQuotes: Trying to make sense of this hopeless fool of an Albatross was itself but a fool's errand.

ALB-A2-5008-001.japanese: 昼間みたいに事情ぶちまけちまえば
ALB-A2-5008-001.argokaj: like you did earlier at noon today
ALB-A2-5008-001.explanation: Daytime becomes noon today, adding an exact part of the day not specified by this reference or the preceding explanation scene.
occurrenceQuotes: like you did earlier at noon today

ALB-A2-5008-002.japanese: あの島にクロを閉じこめてきたのなら
ALB-A2-5008-002.argokaj: If Kuro had been imprisoned on that island
ALB-A2-5008-002.explanation: The self-directed recollection of having left Kuro confined becomes an agentless statement that she had been imprisoned.
occurrenceQuotes: If Kuro had been imprisoned on that island

ALB-A2-5008-004.japanese: 愛しい男に、胸ときめかせてのねだり言
ALB-A2-5008-004.argokaj: pleading words that would set the heart of her darling man aflutter
ALB-A2-5008-004.explanation: The source assigns the fluttering heart to the woman making the plea. The target makes her words flutter the man's heart instead.
occurrenceQuotes: pleading words that would set the heart of her darling man aflutter

ALB-A2-5008-005.argokaj: his own fists, his own fingers
ALB-A2-5008-005.explanation: The specific palms-and-fingers description becomes fists-and-fingers, changing the indicated form of the hand.
occurrenceQuotes: his own fists, his own fingers

ALB-A2-5008-006.explanation: Within the relative clause describing the woman, the source assigns the bodily response to her. The English assigns it to him.
occurrenceQuotes: send tingles through his spine

ALB-A2-5008-007.japanese: もう、君のこと、もらっちゃうね
ALB-A2-5008-007.argokaj: I've already taken you, all of you.
ALB-A2-5008-007.explanation: Her immediate nonpast announcement becomes an already-completed claim.
occurrenceQuotes: I've already taken you, all of you.

ALB-A2-5008-009.japanese: 捧げた場所に活きのよさにもほどがある産地直送
ALB-A2-5008-009.argokaj: the offering he'd given was in a place a bit too fresh for comfort
ALB-A2-5008-009.explanation: The commercial freshness metaphor belongs to the delivered offering. The English instead makes the place too fresh.
occurrenceQuotes: the offering he'd given was in a place a bit too fresh for comfort

ALB-A2-5009-001.japanese: それが孵化すればこちらでまずは二週間その後こちらで三週間
ALB-A2-5009-001.argokaj: another two weeks later over there, and in three weeks over yonder, and there they'd hatch into fully-fledged sailors
ALB-A2-5009-001.explanation: The imaginary hatchery hatches its eggs before the two- and three-week rearing stages in Japanese. English makes hatching the final event after those stages. The nest joke survives, but its deliberately concrete sequence changes.
occurrenceQuotes: another two weeks later over there, and in three weeks over yonder, and there they'd hatch into fully-fledged sailors

ALB-A2-5009-002.japanese: 遂に世界の南の果てへと踏み込んだ
ALB-A2-5009-002.argokaj: was approaching the southernmost end of the world
ALB-A2-5009-002.explanation: The Japanese says the ship has finally entered the southern extremity. English says it is approaching it. Retain only the local entry-versus-approach aspect change; the surrounding voyage and strange waters remain.
occurrenceQuotes: was approaching the southernmost end of the world

ALB-A2-5009-003.japanese: しぶといかと思えば、こりゃもういけない
ALB-A2-5009-003.argokaj: but you can't go thinking it's tenacious or anything
ALB-A2-5009-003.explanation: The source turns from an impression of tenacity to an explicit judgment that things are beyond hope. English only tells the listener not to think the world tenacious. The following stagnation passage preserves the pessimism but not the spoken concluding judgment.
occurrenceQuotes: but you can't go thinking it's tenacious or anything

ALB-A2-5010-001.japanese: 睦み合いの休憩時間に窓打ち眺めている
ALB-A2-5010-001.argokaj: during their intermissions, which were apt to take a turn for the intimate
ALB-A2-5010-001.explanation: Window watching occupies a rest interval from intimacy in Japanese. The English relative clause instead makes those intermissions turn intimate. Retain the small relation reversal, not a claim that the entire scene's alternation disappears.
occurrenceQuotes: during their intermissions, which were apt to take a turn for the intimate

ALB-A2-5010-002.japanese: おっとっと口から迎えに行って一息に
ALB-A2-5010-002.argokaj: slowly raised it to his lips, then drank it all in one gulp
ALB-A2-5010-002.explanation: Tomosato brings his mouth to meet the brim-full cup. English has him slowly raise the cup to his lips. This changes the concrete cautious gesture; his idle drinking in contrast to the working crew is preserved.
occurrenceQuotes: slowly raised it to his lips, then drank it all in one gulp

ALB-A2-5010-003.japanese: 皮膜が触れ合い破れる瞬間に
ALB-A2-5010-003.argokaj: come into contact with the surface of another and breaks
ALB-A2-5010-003.explanation: The grammatical subject of come is the plural molecules; breaks is coordinated with come in the same relative construction. The intervening surface of another supplies no separate subject for breaks. This is a local agreement/construction defect.
occurrenceQuotes: come into contact with the surface of another and breaks

ALB-A2-5010-004.japanese: 横取りされるとこだった!?
ALB-A2-5010-004.argokaj: you say they just snatch that from us!?
ALB-A2-5010-004.explanation: Kisara's line marks a narrowly avoided outcome with されるとこだった. English describes a present/general snatching instead. Limit the finding to the lost near-miss qualification in the response.
occurrenceQuotes: you say they just snatch that from us!?

ALB-A2-5010-006.japanese: 怒らないの、怒れないの？
ALB-A2-5010-006.argokaj: aren't you mad, doesn't that just make you seethe?
ALB-A2-5010-006.explanation: The paired source questions escalate from not becoming angry to inability to become angry. English repeats the prompt to anger and then tells him to consider his conditioning. Her contempt remains, but the specific willingness-to-capacity challenge is lost.
occurrenceQuotes: aren't you mad, doesn't that just make you seethe?

ALB-A2-5010-007.japanese: 踵鳴らそうとして要領を得ないものの
ALB-A2-5010-007.argokaj: although she didn't quite get the point and just hopped up and down
ALB-A2-5010-007.explanation: Kuro attempts the heel-stamping movement but cannot get the knack, so hops. Didn't quite get the point suggests not understanding its purpose instead. The small physical-comedy characterization changes; her participation survives.
occurrenceQuotes: although she didn't quite get the point and just hopped up and down

ALB-A2-5010-008.japanese: 道踏み外したのは自分の勝手と百も承知
ALB-A2-5010-008.argokaj: it was entirely for their own benefit that they had strayed from the right path
ALB-A2-5010-008.explanation: The source acknowledges that departing the accepted path was their own choice, before insisting they will choose their onward course. Entirely for their own benefit supplies an exclusive advantageous motive not entailed by that responsibility.
occurrenceQuotes: it was entirely for their own benefit that they had strayed from the right path

ALB-A2-5010-009.japanese: 朔屋、息を吸え、そして大声叫んで見せろ。
ALB-A2-5010-009.argokaj: Sakuya sucked in a deep breath, then yelled out loudly.
ALB-A2-5010-009.explanation: The narrator commands Sakuya to draw breath and shout. English reports those actions as completed. Earlier commands remain, so this is one local loss of the narrator's exhortative address, not the disappearance of the whole rallying voice.
occurrenceQuotes: Sakuya sucked in a deep breath, then yelled out loudly.

ALB-A2-5011-001.japanese: 或いは故あって放り出されたか
ALB-A2-5011-001.argokaj: had been abandoned due to unavoidable circumstances
ALB-A2-5011-001.explanation: The source leaves the reason some children were abandoned unspecified. Unavoidable circumstances adds necessity and implicitly excuses that act. The war and chaos support difficulty, not inevitability in every such case.
occurrenceQuotes: had been abandoned due to unavoidable circumstances

ALB-A2H-1014-001.argokaj: the day labourers in the mountainous valleys
ALB-A2H-1014-001.explanation: The urban day-labor district Sanya becomes generic mountainous valleys. The surrounding cheap lodging, bedbugs and drinking comparison remains, but its particular social-geographic reference is lost and rural terrain is introduced.
occurrenceQuotes: the day labourers in the mountainous valleys

ALB-A2H-1014-002.argokaj: a type of contemporary Japanese dance invented in 1963
ALB-A2H-1014-002.explanation: The translator's ancillary note gives 1963 as a categorical invention date. Keio's Butoh archive researcher instead dates the conventional starting performance to 1959 and distinguishes subsequent naming stages in 1961 and 1965. This is a factual defect in the added note, not a mistranslation of a date supplied by the Japanese scene.
occurrenceQuotes: a type of contemporary Japanese dance invented in 1963

ALB-A2H-1016-001.japanese: ウミはひどいな黄色いなぁ～っ
ALB-A2H-1016-001.argokaj: pus is such an ugly yellooow～!
ALB-A2H-1016-001.explanation: The source deforms the opening of the children's song Umi, exploiting the homophony of sea and pus and replacing the descriptive words with her panicked symptoms. The English retains the pus complaint and drawn-out voice but supplies neither the sea linkage nor an equivalent recognizable parody. One comic layer is lost; the panic remains.
occurrenceQuotes: pus is such an ugly yellooow～!

ALB-A2H-1016-002.argokaj: found in Kagawa prefecture on Tokushima
ALB-A2H-1016-002.explanation: The note puts the Kagawa shrine on Tokushima. The shrine is in Kotohira, Kagawa, on Shikoku; Tokushima is a neighboring prefecture, not the containing island. This is an added-note geographical error, not a source-supplied place mistranslation.
occurrenceQuotes: found in Kagawa prefecture on Tokushima

ALB-A2H-1016-003.japanese: 救助を焦る者と助けを希う者と差し合いなのに
ALB-A2H-1016-003.argokaj: though it was but a hindrance for both he impatient to offer aid and she who yearns for succor
ALB-A2H-1016-003.explanation: The source contrasts their complementary roles and shared rescue aim with their failure to communicate. The English selects the obstruction sense of 差し合い and says there is a hindrance for both, making the following communication failure a continuation of the problem rather than the source's concessive surprise.
occurrenceQuotes: though it was but a hindrance for both he impatient to offer aid and she who yearns for succor

ALB-A2H-2005-135.explanation: The inserted name of the wave classification is misspelled Douglass rather than Douglas. The scale selection and rough category are not the error.
occurrenceQuotes: Douglass Sea scale

ALB-A2H-2011-030.argokaj: low-pitched sounds of its vibrating bowstrings
ALB-A2H-2011-030.explanation: The source's low cello-string tones become sounds of vibrating bowstrings, confusing the instrument strings with the hair stretched on the bow. The specified mechanism inside the cello image is inaccurate.
occurrenceQuotes: low-pitched sounds of its vibrating bowstrings

ALB-A2H-2012-089.explanation: The added historical annotation misspells Philipp Franz von Siebold as Ziebold. The named person remains identifiable; only the spelling is retained.
occurrenceQuotes: Philipp Franz von Ziebold

ALB-A2H-3004-118.argokaj: a tincture of red iodine, a water solution of merbromin
ALB-A2H-3004-118.explanation: The note explicitly identifies akachin as iodine tincture while also naming merbromin. The historical name borrows from iodine tincture, but the pharmaceutical preparation is distinct.
occurrenceQuotes: a tincture of red iodine, a water solution of merbromin

ALB-A2H-3014-084.argokaj: is thin slices of chicken tenderloin
ALB-A2H-3014-084.explanation: The annotation defines sasami as thin slices of tenderloin, confusing the anatomical cut with a slicing preparation. Tenderloin itself is correctly identified; the added slicing restriction is not part of the word's meaning.
occurrenceQuotes: is thin slices of chicken tenderloin

ALB-A2H-4008-001.japanese: 推進軸に障害を受けている
ALB-A2H-4008-001.argokaj: The screw is experiencing a malfunction.
ALB-A2H-4008-001.explanation: The specifically named propulsion shaft becomes the screw/propeller. Both belong to propulsion, but the transmission component is replaced by what it drives; the general obstruction problem remains intact.
occurrenceQuotes: The screw is experiencing a malfunction.

ALB-A2H-4008-002.japanese: ゾウアザラシと同じ名を持つ監督
ALB-A2H-4008-002.argokaj: The kanji in Hayashi Kaizou's given name, "海象", means elephant seal.
ALB-A2H-4008-002.explanation: The added explanatory note defines 海象 as elephant seal. NDL's authority record equates 海象 with walrus. This is a factual lexical gloss in the note; the narration's elephant seal follows the source and remains uncharged.
occurrenceQuotes: The kanji in Hayashi Kaizou's given name, "海象", means elephant seal.

ALB-A2H-4014-002.explanation: In the circus-tent inventory, the round performance platform/ring becomes food-serving trays. This is the wrong contextual sense of the physical feature, independent of whether the inventory is absent or abandoned.
occurrenceQuotes: round serving trays

ALB-A2H-4016-087.japanese: 砂地の上に横たわって
ALB-A2H-4016-087.argokaj: he then laid down atop the sand
ALB-A2H-4016-087.explanation: In this elevated narratorial description, intransitive laid down departs from the standard past-tense lay down. Retain as copyediting only, not changed action.
occurrenceQuotes: he then laid down atop the sand

ALB-A2H-4016-202.argokaj: black hair cut in deep greens
ALB-A2H-4016-202.explanation: The conventional lush/glossy-black hair description becomes black hair qualified by literal deep greens. The neighboring glow remains; the defect is the extra color interpretation.
occurrenceQuotes: black hair cut in deep greens

ALB-A2H-4017-085.argokaj: The term used is here is
ALB-A2H-4017-085.explanation: The note opening contains a duplicated finite is. The identification that follows remains understandable and factually supported in the checked accounts.
occurrenceQuotes: The term used is here is

ALB-A2H-5002-184.explanation: An occupational transition in the comparison is partly misattached as baldness of the elderly man. Retain only the unsupported hair description. The target's subsequent description of former attendants means the historical transition has not vanished altogether.
occurrenceQuotes: the balding old retiree
